jobs.description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
jobs.description:
Lead Systems Engineer

We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces.

Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle.

  • Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops.

  • Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded.

  • Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme.

  • Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes.

  • Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system.

  • Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects.

  • A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects.

  • The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines.

  • Confidence facilitating technical decisions, managing competing subsystem needs, and driving interface issues toward resolution.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As a CEO Office Associate, you'll take on strategic problems that don't yet have a home and turn them into tangible outcomes, fast. From day one, you'll own complex, cross-functional projects end-to-end, stepping in wherever the business needs leverage most.

Areas of ownership:

  • Special Projects & Strategic Programs: Own CEO-sponsored programs that cut across the org end-to-end. You identify something that’s broken, diagnose the problem, build the plan, drive execution across functions, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Internal Communications: Own the company's heartbeat. Run the monthly All-Hands end-to-end (format, content, narrative, delivery), as well as other company-critical communication events, turning leadership intent into messages that land.

  • CEO Office Automations: You are constantly at the forefront of AI development & always aim to increase your own as well as the CEO Office’s leverage. You help the team rethink how it works, every single week.

Who you are:

  • Experience: 3+ years in a high-intensity environment (strategy consulting, VC/PE, or a high-growth startup) where you've owned outcomes, not just tasks. 

  • Academic Excellence: Strong academic credentials or an equivalent track record of exceptional achievement.

  • High IQ, Low Ego: High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the humility to step in wherever needed to help the team succeed.

  • Executive Presence: Strong communicator and storyteller who builds executive-grade decks, documents, and narratives that both convince and inspire. You’re comfortable interacting with senior internal & external stakeholders.

  • Builder Mentality: You don’t just strategize - you execute. You thrive in ambiguity, make the call when there's no playbook, and own the result. 

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don't inherit assumptions; you question why things exist before you rebuild them.

  • AI-native: You leverage AI tools and automation to work more effectively. Experience with platforms such as n8n is a plus.

  • Location: Able to work from our Berlin headquarters five days per week.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Team Member → Technical Interview → Bar Raiser 

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

● Track record of high performance, and self sourcing leads
● Highly motivated and committed to growth and development with excellent communication skills
● Solid network of potential prospects and partners within the payments landscape
● Tech-savvy, with a passion for Fintech and Payments

jobs.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

  • The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently

  • If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities:

  1. INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  2. INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  3. INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  4. INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management).

  5. INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more).

About the program:

AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. 

You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs.

Responsibilities:

Lead program delivery end to end 

Planning and implementation

  • Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder.

  • Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews.

  • Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report.

  • Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes.

  • Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team.

  • Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together.

Monitoring and evaluation

  • Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads.

  • Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way.

  • Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice.

Budget and resources

  • Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead.

  • Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests.

  • Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal.

Manage the consortium and partners 

  • Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements.

  • Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed.

  • Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones.

  • Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO.

  • Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment.

Manage the funder and stakeholders

  • Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early.

  • Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders.

  • Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership.

  • Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches.

  • Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break.

Coordinate the team

  • Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them.

  • Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR).

  • Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you.

Support growth 

  • Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over.

  • Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs.

  • Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem.


Essential

  • At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe.

  • Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance.

  • Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments.

  • At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage.

  • Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts.

  • High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity.

Desirable

  • Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants).

  • Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements.

  • Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC.

  • A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish.

  • A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2).

  • Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance.

Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice.

What you’ll be doing

  • Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings.

  • Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories.

  • Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs.

  • Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent.

  • Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance.

  • Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured.

Who we are looking for

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations.

  • You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion.

  • Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus.

What you’ll learn

  • Procurement category management and strategic sourcing

  • Supplier and contract management

  • Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes

  • Commercial negotiations

  • Procurement governance and stakeholder management

  • Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company

Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer:

  • Flexibility that fits your schedule. We'll coordinate your working hours around your studies, no forced trade-offs between work and university.

  • Daily lunches, snacks and drinks at our Amsterdam office.

  • Break a sweat and improve your well-being with our Urban Sports Club Subscription and additional weekly fitness classes (kickboxing & bootcamp) led by professional trainers.

  • Real responsibility from day one. At Fastned, we don't believe in busywork. We want you to think like a founder! Your input matters, and you'll be expected to take ownership. Your analyses will influence where Fastned builds next.

  • An hourly salary of €16,25 gross (+ holiday pay).

Apply today!

We would love to hear from you! Send us your CV along with a short motivation explaining why you're excited about joining our mission.

jobs.title: Social Media & Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) – Content & Performance
jobs.description:
Festanstellung · Vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München

Mach stickerfive sichtbar

Du hast Ideen für Inhalte, kannst aus vorhandenem Material gute Videos machen und hast bereits selbst Werbekampagnen umgesetzt? Bei uns kannst Du diese Fähigkeiten zusammenbringen und unseren Social-Media- und Online-Marketing-Bereich verantwortlich weiterentwickeln.

Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport. Vereinsmitglieder bekommen ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht. Auch die Bereiche Unternehmen, Schulen und Tourismus möchten wir verstärkt ausbauen.

Daraus entstehen viele Geschichten und Möglichkeiten, neue Kunden zu erreichen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der bei uns im Team vor Ort arbeitet, Ideen einbringt und deren Umsetzung selbst in die Hand nimmt.

Du hast Dich bereits bei uns beworben?
Durch ein Versehen bei der Verwaltung sind uns leider einige Bewerbungen verloren gegangen. Wenn Du weiterhin Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit hast, bewirb Dich bitte noch einmal bei uns. Entschuldige den zusätzlichen Aufwand!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unsere Social-Media-Kanäle betreuen: Du planst Inhalte für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok, entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan und kümmerst Dich um Veröffentlichungen sowie Kommentare und Nachrichten.

  • Aus Aufnahmen fertigen Content machen: Du sichtest das Material aus unseren Projekten und schneidest daraus Reels, Stories und Werbevideos. Dazu gehören passende Einstiege, Untertitel und Texte. Grafiken setzt Du selbst um oder stimmst Dich mit unserem Grafikteam ab.

  • Mit Creatorn zusammenarbeiten: Wir bauen ein Netzwerk aus Creatorn in verschiedenen Regionen Deutschlands auf. Du briefst sie für ihre Einsätze, koordinierst Termine und sorgst dafür, dass sie die Aufnahmen liefern, die wir für unsere Inhalte und Kampagnen benötigen.

  • Bezahlte Kampagnen betreuen: Du setzt Anzeigen auf Instagram und Facebook auf, steuerst das vereinbarte Budget und entwickelst die Kampagnen weiter. Ziel ist, passende Interessenten zu erreichen und konkrete Anfragen/Leads für unsere Sammelprojekte zu gewinnen.

  • Werbemittel testen und verbessern: Du probierst unterschiedliche Videos, Grafiken und Anzeigentexte aus und prüfst, welche Varianten bei unseren Zielgruppen funktionieren.

  • Ergebnisse auswerten: Du behältst Reichweite und Interaktionen ebenso im Blick wie die Kosten und Qualität gewonnener Anfragen. Mit unserem Vertrieb besprichst Du, welche Kontakte zu passenden Projekten führen, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

Was du mitbringst

Du hast bereits Social-Media-Kanäle betreut und selbst Inhalte umgesetzt. Außerdem hast Du praktische Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung im Meta-Werbeanzeigenmanager. Du kannst uns an einem Beispiel erklären, welches Ziel Du verfolgt hast, was Dein eigener Anteil war und was Du aus den Ergebnissen gelernt hast.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns:

  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit einem Videoschnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve.

  • Ein Gespür für Gestaltung und verständliche Texte sowie Erfahrung mit einem Grafiktool wie Photoshop oder Canva.

  • Ein Verständnis dafür, wie man Kampagnenergebnisse bewertet und das eingesetzte Budget sinnvoll verteilt.

  • Eine organisierte Arbeitsweise: Du hältst Absprachen ein, setzt Prioritäten und behältst auch mehrere laufende Projekte im Blick.

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Creatorn, unserem Team und den Menschen in unseren Partnervereinen.

  • Interesse daran, KI-Tools für Ideen, Content-Produktion und wiederkehrende Aufgaben sinnvoll einzusetzen.

Erfahrung mit Google Ads, Conversion-Tracking oder der Optimierung von Landingpages ist ein Plus. Du musst nicht jedes Tool bereits beherrschen. Für Social Media und Meta Ads solltest Du aber praktische Erfahrung mitbringen.

Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Uns interessieren Deine Fähigkeiten und Deine bisherigen Arbeiten. Wenn Du selbst gerne vor der Kamera stehst, kannst Du Dich auch dort einbringen. Voraussetzung ist das nicht.

So arbeitest Du bei uns

Dein Arbeitsplatz ist bei uns im Büro in Gräfelfing bei München. Wir möchten den Bereich intern aufbauen und suchen jemanden, der im Arbeitsalltag vor Ort mit unserem Team zusammenarbeitet.

Du stimmst Dich direkt mit Geschäftsführung, Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele, Budgets und Prioritäten fest. Innerhalb dieses Rahmens organisierst Du Deine Aufgaben eigenständig.

Für Aufnahmen bei unseren Partnervereinen bauen wir parallel das Creator-Netzwerk auf. Bei Dir laufen die Inhalte zusammen, damit daraus ein verlässlicher Auftritt und wirksame Kampagnen werden.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst unsere Kanäle und Abläufe von Anfang an mitentwickeln und eigene Ideen ausprobieren.

  • Projekte mit Geschichten: Vom ersten eigenen Sticker einer Jugendmannschaft bis zum Sammelalbum eines Profivereins gibt es viel zu erzählen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Team mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen.

  • Ausstattung für Deine Arbeit: Die benötigte Hard- und Software stimmen wir passend zu Deinen Aufgaben ab.

  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen. Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee gehören im Büro dazu.

Zeig uns, was Du schon umgesetzt hast

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie passende Arbeitsproben. Das können betreute Kanäle, Videos, Grafiken oder Beispiele aus Werbekampagnen sein.

Schreib bei gemeinsamen Projekten bitte dazu, welche Aufgaben Du selbst übernommen hast. Bei Kampagnen interessieren uns das Ziel, Dein Vorgehen und die Ergebnisse. Das kannst Du auch anonymisiert darstellen.

Sag uns außerdem, wann Du starten könntest, welchen Stundenumfang Du suchst und welche Gehaltsvorstellung Du hast.

Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich und Deine Arbeiten kennenzulernen!

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, German Speaking
IT Systems Automation Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
bonial helps you save time, money and paper!

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail?

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.


bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers!

About The Role

IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets.

What You’ll Do

  • Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment)

  • Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows.

  • Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant.

  • Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies.

  • Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate.

  • Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build.

  • Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly.

  • Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them.

  • Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value.

  • Agentic support: Design, build, and operate AI agents that resolve common IT support requests end-to-end (e.g., password resets, access and software requests, device troubleshooting) via Slack or the service desk, connecting them to M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, and Intune through APIs, with clear guardrails, approval steps, human escalation paths, and audit logging.

  • AI enablement: Roll out and administer AI tools across the organization (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI/Code, or similar), including license assignment, data access and governance settings, and usage policies, working closely with security, legal, and the works council where relevant, and support employees with onboarding guides, training materials, and best practices.



What We’re Looking For

  • Required:

    • Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility.

    • Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune.

    • Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script) and comfort using REST APIs.

    • Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance.

    • Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build.

  • Nice to Have:

    • Experience with Slack administration or Slack API/workflow automation.

    • Experience with a scripting/orchestration platform (e.g., Workato, Tines, Zapier, Azure Automation, or similar iPaaS tools).

    • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft MS-102/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator).

    • Familiarity with security/compliance frameworks relevant to endpoint and identity management (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

    • Experience working on a small IT team where you own end-to-end delivery rather than a narrow slice of a larger org.

What We Offer:

High growth story - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital.

Innovation & tech - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.

Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.

Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression.

Wellbeing - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement.

Sustainability - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet.

Flexibility - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).*

Modern office - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events.

Free lunch – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.*

Social Culture – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events.

Partner for retail - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.”

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.


If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!

You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

*as per our current Works Agreements

  • Selbstständige Konzeption, Umsetzung und Skalierung unserer mehrsprachigen Paid-Social-Kampagnen (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest) – von der Akquise bis zum Retargeting.
  • Unterstützung bei der operativen Aussteuerung in Paid Search Channels (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) und Generative Engine Advertising Channel (Chat GPT Ads).
  • Datenbasierte Analyse und Optimierung von Kampagnen und Landingpages (CRO, A/B-Testing) zur kontinuierlichen Generierung qualifizierter Leads (SQLs) und als Beitrag zum ARR-Wachstum von bexio.
  • Eigenständige Überwachung zugewiesener Mediabudgets im Rahmen unserer Performance-Roadmap sowie Übersetzung von Kohortenanalysen in konkrete Optimierungsmassnahmen.
  • Steuerung des gesamten Kreativprozesses, von der initialen Ideengenerierung über die Erstellung detaillierter Briefings bis zur erfolgreichen Ausspielung der Kampagnen-Assets.
  • Kontinuierliche Beobachtung aktueller Marketing- und AI-Trends (z. B. Generative Engine Advertising) sowie die schnelle Umsetzung innovativer Ansätze im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit und Austausch mit internen Stakeholdern (z. B. Content-, Social-Media- und Produkt-Marketing-Teams) sowie externen Plattform-Partnern und Agenturen für ganzheitliche Performance-Strategien.

Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle

  • Du besitzt einen Hochschulabschluss in BWL (Vertiefung Marketing/Analytik), Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung inklusive relevanter Plattform-Zertifizierungen (z. B. Google, Meta Blueprint).
  • Du verfügst über erste bis mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung (ca. 1–4 Jahre) in der Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Search-, Display- und Paid-Social-Kampagnen – idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-, E-Commerce- oder Agenturumfeld.
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für moderne MarTech- und Tracking-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Google Analytics 4, Tag Management, CRM-Integrationen wie Salesforce) sowie Disziplinen wie SEO und CRO mit.

  • Du bist ein engagierter Teamplayer, hast Mut zu neuen Ideen und interessierst dich aktiv für neue Technologien und AI-Tools.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut in Deutsch und Englisch (Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil).

jobs.title: Persoperator 2 ploegen
jobs.description: Ben jij klaar om als persoperator in een 2-ploegendienst aan de slag te gaan binnen de betonproductie? Als persoperator bij een productiebedrijf in de betonsector zorg je ervoor dat het productieproces vlekkeloos verloopt. Je bedient en stelt geautomatiseerde machines in, voert onderhoud uit en lost mechanische storingen zelfstandig op. jobs.title: HR officer - Vlaamse rand-Brussel
jobs.description:
// Functie-inhoud

Ben jij een administratieve duizendpoot met een passie voor correcte loonverwerking en een vlotte HR-administratie? Wil jij meebouwen aan een efficiënte en mensgerichte HR-dienst? Dan ben jij misschien onze nieuwe Payroll officer!

// Taken

Als HR Officer ben jij de spil van onze personeelsadministratie. Je zorgt ervoor dat alles – van onboarding tot uitstroom – correct en efficiënt verloopt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een foutloze payrollverwerking, een up-to-date personeelsdossier en het nauwkeurig opvolgen van sociale documenten en vergoedingen.

Je werkt nauw samen met interne collega’s en externe partners, zoals het sociaal secretariaat, en bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers met vragen over lonen, sociale documenten of HR-processen.

Jouw takenpakket in een notendop:

  • Correcte en tijdige verwerking van lonen en thema-afwezigheden (zoals ziekte, ouderschapsverlof…).

  • Administratieve opvolging van personeelsdossiers, contracten en juridische documenten.

  • Eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers bij vragen over salaris, sociale wetgeving en personeelsgegevens.

  • Aanvragen van opleidingssubsidies en opvolging van RVA- of mutualiteitsdossiers.

  • Opmaak van rapporten en analyses rond salariskosten en budgettering.

  • Toezien op naleving van arbeidswetgeving en sectorale afspraken.

  • Je werkt voornamelijk vanuit Kampenhout, maar verzorgt ook de HR administratie en lonen van Vlaamse rand/Brussel. Hierdoor zal je sporadis aanwezig moeten zijn in de stelplaatsen Dilbeek, Huizingen en Londerzeel vragen rond lonen te beantwoorden. 
  • Je hebt een sterke kennis van payroll en sociale wetgeving.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en met oog voor detail.
  • Je bent discreet, verantwoordelijk en kan goed prioriteiten stellen.
  • Je denkt in oplossingen, communiceert helder en schakelt vlot met interne én externe partners.
  • Je bent analytisch ingesteld en optimaliseert graag processen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.
  • Je bent leergierig en blijft op de hoogte van sociaal-juridische evoluties.
  • Je hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie als HR/payroll officer.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - HQ Antwerpen
jobs.description:
// Functie-inhoud

Als Business Development Manager Regio Antwerpen ben je verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële ontwikkeling van Hansea Commercial Mobility binnen de regio Antwerpen.

Je bouwt duurzame partnerships uit met bedrijven, industriële spelers en organisaties, met een sterke focus op personeelsvervoer binnen de Antwerpse haven en de omliggende industrie.

Je detecteert nieuwe commerciële opportuniteiten, ontwikkelt mobiliteitsoplossingen op maat van de klant en begeleidt het volledige commerciële traject, van eerste contact tot contractondertekening en overdracht naar de operationele organisatie.

Je vertegenwoordigt Hansea binnen relevante regionale netwerken en werkt nauw samen met het Commercial Mobility Coördinatiecentrum, Operations en andere interne expertisediensten om duurzame commerciële groei te realiseren.

// Taken

Business Development

  • Je realiseert de commerciële groeidoelstellingen binnen de regio Antwerpen.
  • Je ontwikkelt actief nieuwe business met een sterke focus op personeelsvervoer binnen de Antwerpse haven en de omliggende industrie.
  • Je identificeert commerciële opportuniteiten binnen andere marktsegmenten die aansluiten bij de strategie van Commercial Mobility.
  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert een gezonde commerciële pipeline.
  • Je werkt mee aan relevante aanbestedingen.

Accountmanagement

  • Je bouwt duurzame relaties uit met bestaande en nieuwe klanten.
  • Je onderhoudt een sterk netwerk binnen de Antwerpse haven, de industriële sector en regionale stakeholders.
  • Je detecteert nieuwe behoeften bij bestaande klanten en vertaalt deze naar passende mobiliteitsoplossingen.
  • Je bewaakt de klanttevredenheid en bouwt aan langdurige partnerships.

Offertes en contracten

  • Je stelt offertes en commerciële voorstellen op.
  • Je voert commerciële onderhandelingen en sluit contracten af.
  • Je vertaalt klantvragen naar haalbare en rendabele mobiliteitsoplossingen.
  • Je zorgt voor een kwalitatieve overdracht van nieuwe contracten naar het Commercial Mobility Coördinatiecentrum en de operationele organisatie.

Marktontwikkeling

  • Je volgt de mobiliteitsmarkt, economische ontwikkelingen en concurrentie actief op.
  • Je vertegenwoordigt Hansea op netwerkevents, beurzen en regionale overlegplatformen.
  • Je brengt marktinformatie en commerciële opportuniteiten actief terug naar de organisatie.
  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere positionering en groei van Commercial Mobility.

Rapportering

Je rapporteert hiërarchisch aan de Director Commercial Mobility.

Functioneel werk je nauw samen met het Commercial Mobility Coördinatiecentrum, Operations, Finance en andere interne expertisediensten.Je zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking tussen de commerciële en operationele organisatie en draagt bij aan een kwalitatieve implementatie van nieuwe contracten.

  • Je bent commercieel sterk en ondernemend.
  • Je beschikt over uitstekende netwerk- en relatievaardigheden.

  • Je houdt ervan te werken vanuit doelen en KPI’s.
  • Je bent klant- en marktgericht.
  • Je werkt resultaatgericht en neemt ownership.
  • Je bent zelfstandig en neemt initiatief.
  • Je communiceert vlot met klanten en interne stakeholders.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent sterk in kostprijsberekeningen en financiële analyse.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met mobiliteit, logistiek en personeelsvervoer.
  • Je komt idealiter uit de vervoersector.

Als operator, machineoperator of technisch productiemedewerker zorg je voor een vlotte opstart, controle en werking van het productieproces binnen een innovatieve productieomgeving.

  • Voorbereiden, opstarten en controleren van het productieproces
  • Ombouwen, testen en bedienen van afvulmachines
  • Registreren van productiegegevens en uitvoeren van zelfstandig onderhoud

Je zorgt voor een correcte montage en voorbereiding van de afvulmachine en grijpt in wanneer je kleine technische problemen of afwijkingen opmerkt. Daarnaast voer je eenvoudige onderhoudstaken uit en registreer je nauwkeurig de productiegegevens.  Je komt terecht in een vaste job met een afwisselend takenpakket.

Wie bieden zekerheid vanaf dag één met een vast contract in dagdienst.

  • Technisch inzicht,  interesse in machines en ervaring als operator of een technisch diploma
  • Jij spreekt vlot Nederlands

jobs.title: Schoonmaker
jobs.description: Zoek je een deeltijdse job waarbij je zelfstandig werkt en zorgt voor een schone en aangename werkomgeving? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.Als poetsmedewerker bij een van onze klanten help je mee aan het onderhouden van een nette en hygiënische omgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het schoonmaken van verschillende ruimtes, waarbij je zowel handmatig als met machines werkt. Je registreert dagelijks je werkzaamheden nauwkeurig en volgt de veiligheids- en hygiënevoorschriften strikt op. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar ook in goede samenwerking met je collega’s.- Schoonmaken en onderhouden van diverse ruimtes- Uitvoeren van handmatige en machinale reiniging, afhankelijk van de ruimte- Zelfstandig zorgen voor een grondige en correcte reiniging- Dagelijks bijhouden van een logboek met uitgevoerde taken- Naleven van hygiëne- en veiligheidsregels- Samenwerken met collega’s om een nette werkomgeving te behoudenJe komt terecht bij een klant die waarde hecht aan een schone en veilige werkplek. jobs.title: Projectleider - Industriële Reiniging | Gent & Antwerpen
jobs.description:
Als adjunct projectleider ondersteun je de projectleider bij de voorbereiding, organisatie en uitvoering van industriële reinigingsprojecten. Daarnaast neem je kleinere opdrachten en dagprojecten zelfstandig voor je rekening.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Industriële reinigingsprojecten praktisch en administratief voorbereiden

  • Kleinere opdrachten en dagprojecten zelfstandig coördineren

  • Personeel, materieel en materiaal afstemmen met de planning

  • Industriële reinigers briefen voor de start van de werkzaamheden

  • De uitvoering en voortgang van de werken op de werf opvolgen

  • Toezien op veiligheid, kwaliteit en naleving van de afgesproken procedures

  • Technische of organisatorische problemen tijdig signaleren en helpen oplossen

  • Contact onderhouden met klanten tijdens lopende projecten

  • Werkbonnen, prestaties en gebruikte materialen correct opvolgen

  • Projectgegevens verwerken en rapporteringen voorbereiden

  • De projectleider ondersteunen bij grotere en complexere opdrachten

Naarmate je ervaring groeit, neem je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid op. Het doel is duidelijk: doorgroeien naar een volwaardige functie als projectleider industriële dienstverlening.

Over het bedrijf

Heb jij technisch inzicht, organisatietalent en de ambitie om door te groeien naar projectleider? Voor onze klant zoeken we een Adjunct Projectleider Industriële Dienstverlening.

Je ondersteunt industriële reinigingsprojecten van voorbereiding tot uitvoering, coördineert zelfstandig kleinere opdrachten en leert stap voor stap alle aspecten van projectleiding kennen. Geen functie waarin je jarenlang vanaf de zijlijn mag meekijken: je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid, mét begeleiding.

Onze klant is een ervaren technische dienstverlener die industriële bedrijven ondersteunt met gespecialiseerde reinigings- en onderhoudswerken.

Veiligheid, kwaliteit en samenwerking vormen de basis van elk project. Je komt terecht in een stabiele organisatie met een sterk opleidingstraject en concrete doorgroeimogelijkheden.

We zoeken geen afgewerkte projectleider, maar iemand met een stevige basis en de ambitie om erin te groeien.

  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of graduaatsdiploma, bij voorkeur in een technische richting

  • Je kunt ook in aanmerking komen wanneer je gelijkwaardig bent door relevante ervaring

  • Je hebt interesse in industriële dienstverlening, techniek en projectorganisatie

  • Je organiseert vlot en bewaart het overzicht over verschillende lopende opdrachten

  • Je communiceert duidelijk met medewerkers, klanten en interne diensten

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en durft beslissingen te nemen

  • Je bent klantgericht, praktisch ingesteld en oplossingsgericht

  • Je beschouwt veiligheid altijd als de hoogste prioriteit

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands

  • Kennis van het Frans is een pluspunt

  • Je bent bereid om het VCA-VOL-attest te behalen

  • Je wilt je op langere termijn ontwikkelen tot zelfstandig projectleider

jobs.title: Lader/magazijnier
jobs.description: Ervaring met het laden van varkensvlees? Je gebruikt een railsysteem om het vlees netjes in vrachtwagens te plaatsen en zorgt dat alles goed blijft hangen. Als er een stuk vlees valt, ruim je dit direct op. Zit er iets vast? jobs.title: Kwery - IT System Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor onze klant, een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de technische sector met meer dan 200 medewerkers en een omzet van ruim EUR50 miljoen, ben ik op zoek naar een System Engineer voor hun kantoor in de regio Veurne. Om hun verdere expansie te ondersteunen, zoeken ze iemand met voldoende maturiteit en assertiviteit die mee instaat voor het operationele beheer van de IT-omgeving, maar vooral ook een actieve rol wil spelen in de verdere uitbouw ervan. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig verschillende IT-projecten op te nemen, verbeteringen door te voeren en mee na te denken over de technologische toekomst van de organisatie.

Hoe zal jouw takenpakket eruit zien?

  • Je bouwt een eigen, gestandaardiseerde IT-omgeving uit voor de internationale groep en maakt de bestaande infrastructuur stapsgewijs los van de huidige omgeving.
  • Je brengt de IT-omgevingen van overgenomen bedrijven in kaart, documenteert bestaande systemen en migreert deze naar één centrale structuur.
  • Je beheert en optimaliseert de infrastructuur rond Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure, netwerken, security, back-ups en monitoring.
  • Je neemt technische uitdagingen zelfstandig vast, van complexe storingen tot verouderde systemen, en werkt duurzame oplossingen uit.
  • Je automatiseert repetitieve processen met scripts, API's en AI-tools en bouwt mee aan slimme supportoplossingen, runbooks en selfservice.
  • Je coördineert externe IT-partners en volgt op of hun oplossingen voldoen aan de technische standaarden die je mee bepaalt.
  • Je beschikt over een IT-diploma of gelijkwaardige ervaring en hebt idealiter minstens 4 jaar ervaring in een brede System Engineer-rol.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van cloudtechnologieën en Microsoft-omgevingen, waaronder Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, netwerken, virtualisatie en back-ups.
  • Je hebt ervaring met IT-integraties, migraties of carve-outs en kan zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en structurele oplossingen uitwerken.
  • Je neemt ownership over projecten van begin tot einde, ontdekt zelf verbeterpunten en wacht niet op instructies om zaken in beweging te zetten.
  • Je hebt een sterke interesse in AI, scripting en automatisering, denkt graag mee over de toekomstige IT-strategie en voelt je comfortabel in een snelgroeiende organisatie waar nog niet alles vastligt. Kennis van PowerShell en vlotte communicatie in het Nederlands en Engels zijn belangrijk; Frans is een pluspunt.

jobs.title: Cegeka - Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor een klant in Antwerpen zijn we op zoek naar een Data Engineer die technische verantwoordelijkheid wil opnemen over een bedrijfskritisch real-time dataplatform. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar data dagelijks een belangrijke rol speelt. Je zorgt ervoor dat het platform stabiel, performant, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar blijft en dat gebruikers kunnen rekenen op correcte real-time data.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Technische ownership opnemen over de Elasticsearch-omgeving, inclusief architectuur, performance, scaling en troubleshooting
  • Instaan voor de real-time data pipelines en waken over datakwaliteit, latency en volledigheid
  • Proactief monitoren van het platform en analyseren van performanceproblemen, datagaps en productie-incidenten
  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van betrouwbare wijzigingen, inclusief testing, monitoring en rollback-strategieën
  • Verder uitbouwen van de real-time data-architectuur en API's
  • Werken aan integraties tussen Elasticsearch, Databricks en het bestaande platform
  • Bouwen en productioniseren van data workloads met Databricks en Apache Spark
  • Werken met streamingtechnologieën zoals Kafka en/of Azure Event Hubs
  • Waar nodig werken in een bestaande TypeScript / JavaScript / Node.js backend om problemen end-to-end te analyseren en oplossingen te implementeren
  • Verbeteren van observability, scalability en maintainability en tegelijk de operationele complexiteit verlagen

Praktisch

  • Locatie: Antwerpen
  • Werkregime: hybride
  • Onsite: 2 dagen per week in Antwerpen
  • Je bent een Data Engineer die zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid kan opnemen voor kritische productieomgevingen.
  • Je brengt bij voorkeur ervaring mee met:
    • Elasticsearch - architectuur, performance, scaling en production troubleshooting
    • Databricks & Apache Spark
    • Real-time en event-driven dataarchitecturen
    • Kafka en/of Azure Event Hubs
    • Monitoring, observability, debugging en performance-optimalisatie
    • Incidentanalyse en failure handling
    • JavaScript / Node.js - voldoende kennis om een bestaande backend te begrijpen, debuggen en aanpassen
    • Redpanda Connect / Benthos is een sterke plus
  • Daarnaast ben je iemand die graag ownership neemt, zelfstandig werkt en niet terugdeinst voor een omgeving waarin betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit belangrijk zijn
  • Talen: je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels

jobs.title: DigiTribe - Solution Architect .NET / Azure / Kafka
jobs.description:
Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.

What you'll do

  • Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose
  • Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built
  • Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

Zo wordt er een oplossing gevonden die haalbaar is en waar de verschillende partijen zich in kunnen vinden.

  • Diverse opleidingen op maat van jouw ambities
