jobs.title: Kripos søker politioverbetjent til Passasjerinformasjonsenheten (PIU)
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Kripos søker tre engasjerte og analytiske politioverbetjenter til Passasjerinformasjonsenheten (PIU). Hos oss får du en unik mulighet til å arbeide med informasjonsanalyse som kan få direkte betydning for myndighetenes evne til å forebygge, avdekke og bekjempe alvorlig kriminalitet og terrorhandlinger.

Stillingene innebærer operativ saksbehandling, analyse og informasjonsutveksling med nasjonale og internasjonale samarbeidspartnere. Herunder vurdering, prioritering og behandling av anmodninger, analyse av passasjeropplysninger, identifisering og vurdering av relevante treff, samt enkildeanalyse. Stillingene har videre et særskilt ansvar for utvikling, vedlikehold og kvalitetssikring av risikoprofiler og watchlister, integrasjon mot etterlysningsregistrene SIS/Interpol/Elys samt andre utviklingsoppgaver.

Gjennom analyse av passasjerinformasjon bidrar PIU til å identifisere personer og reisemønstre av betydning for kriminalitetsbekjempelsen, på vegne av Politiet, Tolletaten og PST. Arbeidet kan være avgjørende for å avverge alvorlige voldshandlinger, avdekke kriminelle nettverk og understøtte nasjonale og også internasjonale operasjoner. Kriminaliteten er grenseløs og PIU har derfor en internasjonal rolle, med ansvar for å utveksle informasjon og analyseresultater med tilsvarende enheter i andre land og Europol. 

Du blir en del av et spesialisert fagmiljø med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, korte veier til samarbeidspartnere og mulighet til å se konkrete resultater av arbeidet ditt.

PIU er en nasjonal enhet og organisert som et avsnitt under Seksjon for Desken. Enheten er en del av fagmiljøet ved Kripos' responssenter. Responssenteret er et døgnbemannet kontaktpunkt (24/7) som håndterer nasjonale og internasjonale henvendelser, forespørsler, bistandsanmodninger og etterretningsoppdrag.

PIU er en enhet med ambisjoner og i stadig utvikling. Vi styrker nå kapasiteten og utvider den operative tilgjengeligheten. Vi søker derfor medarbeidere som ikke bare ønsker å løse viktige oppgaver i dag, men som også vil bidra til å utvikle enhetens kompetanse og fremtidige oppgaveløsning. Hos oss får du mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi arbeider, bidra med egne ideer og være en del av et fagmiljø som skal videreutvikles i takt med politiets behov. 

Stillingen innebærer to-skift turnusarbeid. Det planlegges for en turnus med arbeidshelg hver fjerde uke.

Fleksibilitet med hensyn til arbeidsoppgaver og organisering er en forutsetning. Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes. Personlig egnethet og motivasjon for fagområdet vil bli særlig vektlagt og vurdert. I tillegg vil vi vektlegge at du passer inn i avsnittets sammensetning og portefølje. 

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke.

Vi er på jobb for et trygt Norge. Som en del av politiets viktige samfunnsoppdrag, skal vi forebygge og bekjempe kriminalitet, skape trygghet og ivareta rettssikkerheten. Vi tror at mangfold bidrar til bedre oppgaveløsning, og søker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, perspektiv og kompetanse. Dersom du har behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen eller arbeidshverdagen, vil vi gjøre vårt beste for å gi deg det du trenger.

Dette ser vi etter hos en ny medarbeider

Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, analytisk og nøyaktig, og som har erfaring med å bearbeide og formidle informasjon på en tydelig og presis måte, både internt og eksternt. PIU er en enhet i utvikling, og vi ønsker medarbeidere som er faglig engasjerte, tar initiativ og ønsker å bidra til videreutvikling av enhetens arbeidsmetoder og oppgaveløsning.

Arbeidet stiller høye krav til faglig kompetanse, motivasjon, arbeidsmoral og etisk integritet. Vi forventer at du opptrer profesjonelt og bidrar til å ivareta politiets tillit og omdømme gjennom holdningene og handlingene dine i det daglige arbeidet. I vurderingen av kandidater vil vi også legge vekt på personlig egnethet, samarbeidsevner og evnen til å bidra til et inkluderende og respektfullt arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • vurdere innkomne anmodninger og foreta hensiktsmessige prioriteringer
  • behandle enhetens saker både fra nasjonale og internasjonale samarbeidspartnere, herunder vurdere og berike relevante treff
  • analysere passasjeropplysninger for å svare ut informasjonsbehov fra anmodende kompetent myndighet inkl Europol
  • utarbeide enkilderapporter ved behov eller på anmodning
  • ansvarlig for arbeidet med å utvikle, oppdatere og kvalitetssikre risikoprofiler og watchlister
  • identifisere potensielle saker for enheten
  • gi råd og veiledning om hva enheten kan bidra med, samt bidra med kompetanseoverføring
  • bistå i arbeidet med å etablere og videreutvikle interne arbeidsprosesser og rutiner samt bistå i samhandlingen med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere
  • delta og bidra i relevante samarbeidsfora nasjonalt og internasjonalt
Kvalifikasjoner

Dette må du ha for å være kvalifisert:

  • eksamen fra Politi(høg)skolen
  • minimum fem års arbeidserfaring fra politiet. I enkelte tilfeller kan det være tilstrekkelig med færre års arbeidserfaring, gitt at du kan vise til særskilt relevant erfaring og kompetanse.
  • erfaring med å behandle, analysere og videreformidle informasjon både skriftlig og muntlig
  • god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk
  • god datateknisk forståelse

Det er også ønskelig med:

  • relevant erfaring fra etterforskning og/eller etterretning
  • erfaring fra internasjonalt politisamarbeid
  • etter og videreutdanning innen etterretning og/eller analyse
  • erfaring med bruk av relevante analyseverktøy

Du må ha plettfri vandel og være skikket for tjeneste i politiet og politiattest (uttømmende og utvidet) må innhentes ved ev. ansettelse jfr. politiloven § 18 og politiregisterloven § 41. Du må kunne sikkerhetsklares for Hemmelig.

Personlige egenskaper
  • gode analytiske evner
  • initiativrik - evne til å se og ta arbeidsoppgaver, evne til å være konstruktiv og selv initiere tiltak innenfor fagfeltet
  • gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner 
  • evne til å jobbe både selvstendig og i team 

Som medarbeider i politiet har du høy etisk bevissthet, du kjennetegnes av å være modig og helhetsorientert, du viser respekt og er tett på. Du kan lese mer om våre etiske retningslinjer og medarbeiderplattform her.

Dette kan vi tilby om du velger oss
  • stillingen lønnes som politioverbetjent (0287) med årslønn: kr. 720 000 - 900 000.
  • medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, med blant annet gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger (www.spk.no)
  • et utviklingsorientert og spennende arbeidsmiljø
  • turnustjeneste 
  • arbeidet krever hovedsakelig fysisk tilstedeværelse på kontoret, men hjemmekontor kan være et alternativ når tjenesten tillater det
  • nye og moderne kontorlokaler 
  • en dynamisk organisasjon i kontinuerlig utvikling
  • sentralt beliggende på Bryn med gode tog-, t-bane- og bussforbindelser
  • trening i arbeidstiden
  • planmessig HMS-oppfølgning
Mangfold i politiet

Dersom du har funksjonsnedsettelse, innvandrerbakgrunn eller hull i CV-en, er det anledning for å krysse av for dette i søknaden. Er du kvalifisert for stillingen, vil du bli vurdert for positiv særbehandling. Det innebærer at minst én søker fra hver av disse gruppene blir innkalt til intervju.

Les mer om positiv særbehandling når man søker jobb i staten her. 

Opplysningene du gir, brukes til å utarbeide anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uUTjHmSB_WcSlik søker du

Du søker ved å fylle ut CV i Jobbnorges CV-skjema og skrive et kort søknadsbrev. I tillegg må du legge ved relevante vitnemål og attester. Relevante kandidater vil bli kalt inn til intervju.

Søknader uten vitnemål vil ikke bli behandlet.

Opplysninger om deg kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge, vil du bli varslet om dette.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kripos er politiets nasjonale kompetansesenter i kampen mot organisert og annen alvorlig kriminalitet. Vi yter bistand til politidistriktene og har spisskompetanse blant annet innen taktisk etterforskning, kriminalteknikk, elektroniske spor, særskilte etterforskningsmetoder, kriminaletterretning og -analyse.Vi er dessuten behandlingsansvarlig for politiets sentrale registre og nasjonalt kontaktpunkt for internasjonalt politisamarbeid. Det nasjonale kriminaltekniske laboratoriet ligger også ved Kripos.

jobs.title: Copenhagen Bikes søger en cykelmekaniker
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Bikes søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker med ansvar for den daglige drift

Har du solid teknisk erfaring med elcykler og almindelige cykler, og kan du samtidig tage ansvar for den daglige drift af en cykelbutik? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Copenhagen Bikes søger en erfaren, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst cykelmekaniker, der har indgående teknisk forståelse for forskellige typer elcykler og kan varetage både værkstedsopgaver, kundeservice og den daglige drift af butikken.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der er teknisk stærk, løsningsorienteret og trives med at tage ansvar.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Teknisk arbejde og cykelreparationer

  • Fejlfinding, diagnosticering og reparation af forskellige typer elcykler.

  • Teknisk service og vedligeholdelse af elcykler, herunder motorer, batterier, elektroniske systemer og styreenheder.

  • Arbejde med forskellige elcykelsystemer og motortyper.

  • Reparation og vedligeholdelse af almindelige cykler.

  • Udskiftning, montering og justering af komponenter og reservedele.

  • Klargøring og kvalitetssikring af cykler inden levering til kunder.

  • Sikre, at reparationer udføres professionelt og efter gældende sikkerhedsstandarder.

Daglig drift og butiksansvar

  • Varetage den daglige drift af butikken og værkstedet.

  • Modtage kunder og rådgive om reparationer, service og tekniske løsninger.

  • Håndtere serviceaftaler, reparationer og kundehenvendelser.

  • Planlægge og prioritere værkstedsopgaver.

  • Håndtere lagerbeholdning samt bestilling af reservedele og udstyr.

  • Sikre, at butikken og værkstedet fremstår organiseret og professionelt.

  • Tage ansvar for den daglige drift og bidrage til butikkens udvikling.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring som cykelmekaniker, særligt med elcykler.

  • Har indgående teknisk kendskab til forskellige typer elcykler og deres systemer.

  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding på motorer, batterier, elektronik og elektriske komponenter.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for både tekniske opgaver og den daglige drift.

  • Er struktureret, effektiv og løsningsorienteret.

  • Har gode kommunikations- og kundeserviceevner.

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og har en professionel tilgang til dit arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • En ansvarsfuld stilling med stor selvstændighed.

  • Mulighed for at stå for den daglige drift af Copenhagen Bikes.

  • Et varieret job med både tekniske, praktiske og administrative opgaver.

  • Mulighed for at præge butikkens udvikling og arbejdsgange.

  • Et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og god kundeservice.

Arbejdssted: Copenhagen Bikes

Ansættelse: Fuldtid

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning

Har du den tekniske erfaring, vi søger, og lyst til at tage ansvar for den daglige drift? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til os.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Analyste M&A - Stage fin d'études - Janvier ou Février 2027
jobs.description:
À propos de Clairfield

Clairfield International est une banque d'affaires de référence sur le segment mid-market, forte de 40 bureaux et +500 collaborateurs dans 35 pays (Europe, Amériques, Afrique et Asie). Clairfield International conseille plus de 300 opérations par an (transmission, capital-développement, croissance externe et financement).

Vos missions

Vous participerez à la conduite des opérations M&A dans un environnement international très fort, et serez directement impliqué(e) dans l’origination et l’exécution des missions de l’équipe parisienne (cession, acquisition, levée de fonds, opération LBO…) :

  • Analyse sectorielle (tendances de marché, positionnement concurrentiel…) et l’identification de sociétés (cibles / acquéreurs)

  • Préparation de « pitchs » et rédaction de documents de présentation (mémorandum d’information, business plan…) en français et/ou anglais

  • Analyse financière

  • Évaluation d’entreprise (approche de valorisation, multiples boursiers, transactions comparables, DCF…)

  • Suivi des opérations en cours (data room, présentation management…)

  • Accompagnement dans la coordination avec les bureaux de Clairfield à l’international

  • Développement de nos outils internes : base de données, veille métier….

Vos compétences

  • Stage pour les étudiants en fin d’études

  • Début janvier ou Février 2027, durée 6 mois

Profil

  • Etudiant(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d’un 3e cycle / master en finance

  • Première expérience au sein d’une banque d’affaires, cabinet de conseil, ou en private equity

  • Solides connaissances techniques (analyse et modélisation financière, valorisation de sociétés, principes comptables), esprit d’analyse et de synthèse

  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, ainsi que des principaux outils technologiques

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow "AI seller" title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.
  • Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.
  • Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.
  • Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.
  • Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.
  • B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

jobs.title: Koordinator for velferdsteknologi og digital hjemmeoppfølging
jobs.description:
Om stillingen og litt om oss

Stillingen er et 80 % vikariat til og med 31. januar 2028, med ønsket tiltredelse snarest mulig og etter nærmere avtale.

Stillingen innebærer en kombinasjon av praktiske og administrative oppgaver, opplæring, veiledning, system oppfølging og samarbeid på tvers av tjenesteområdene.

Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til at teknologien fungerer godt i hverdagen, både for brukere og ansatte.

Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og aktuelle kandidater kan bli kontaktet og innkalt til intervju før søknadsfristens utløp. Endelig ansettelse foretas etter søknadsfristens utløp.                                Det kreves gyldig politiattest for stillingen.

Steigen kommune arbeider aktivt med utvikling og digitalisering av helse- og omsorgstjenestene. Velferdsteknologi er et viktig satsingsområde for å møte fremtidens behov og sikre gode, trygge og bærekraftige tjenester.

Vi er i en utviklingsfase med innføring og videreutvikling av blant annet digitale varslings- og responssystemer, trygghetsalarmer, sensorteknologi, digitalt tilsyn og andre løsninger som støtter både hjemmeboende og beboere i institusjon.

Kommunen har flere superbrukere i helse- og omsorgstjenestene som bidrar med lokal støtte og praktisk oppfølging av velferdsteknologiske løsninger. Som koordinator vil du samarbeide med disse og øvrige fagpersoner for å sikre god bruk av teknologien i den daglige tjenesten.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som koordinator for velferdsteknologi og DHO-ressurs vil du blant annet:

  • Koordinere og følge opp kommunens velferdsteknologiske løsninger, herunder trygghetsalarmer, varslingssystemer, GPS, sensorteknologi og digitalt tilsyn.
  • Bidra til stabil drift og praktisk oppfølging av løsningene i samarbeid med IKT, leverandører og kommunens superbrukere.
  • Bistå med feilsøking, brukerrettigheter, tilganger og systemoppfølging.
  • Koordinere og følge opp arbeidet med digital hjemmeoppfølging (DHO) i samarbeid med aktuelle tjenester.
  • Bidra ved innføring og videreutvikling av digitale løsninger.
  • Samarbeide med superbrukere og ressurspersoner om opplæring, veiledning og praktisk oppfølging.
  • Bidra til utarbeidelse og oppdatering av rutiner, prosedyrer og opplæringsmateriell.
  • Bistå tjenestene med å kartlegge behov og finne hensiktsmessige teknologiske løsninger.
  • Gi veiledning og bistand til ansatte, brukere og pårørende, også ved behov for oppfølging ute hos brukere.
  • Bidra til at personvern, informasjonssikkerhet og kvalitet ivaretas.
  • Delta i relevante fagnettverk og samarbeid med andre kommuner og fagmiljøer.
Kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Relevant fagbrev, fagutdanning eller annen relevant utdanning innen helse- og omsorgsfag, IKT, velferdsteknologi eller tilsvarende.
  • Erfaring og interesse for teknologi og digitale løsninger, og motivasjon for å lære nye systemer.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Førerkort klasse B

 

Det er ønskelig med:

  • Videreutdanning eller kurs innen velferdsteknologi, digitalisering eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • Erfaring fra kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester.
  • Erfaring med bruk av velferdsteknologiske løsninger.
  • Kjennskap til digital hjemmeoppfølging (DHO).
  • Erfaring med opplæring, veiledning eller samarbeid på tvers av fagområder.
Hvem vi ser for oss og hva vi kan tilby

Du er:

  • Engasjert, nysgjerrig og interessert i teknologi og utvikling.
  • Strukturert, selvstendig og løsningsorientert.
  • God til å samarbeide og bygge relasjoner.
  • Tålmodig og pedagogisk i møte med ansatte, brukere og pårørende.
  • Fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig, med evne til å lære nye oppgaver og systemer.
  • Initiativrik og god til å finne praktiske løsninger.
  • Opptatt av kvalitet, trygghet og gode tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper vil bli vektlagt.

 

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En spennende og meningsfull stilling innen et viktig utviklingsområde.
  • Mulighet til å bidra til utviklingen av fremtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester.
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver med både praktisk og administrativt innhold.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kollegaer.
  • Samarbeid med kommunens superbrukere, ulike fagmiljøer og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.
  • Opplæring og støtte i aktuelle systemer og arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk, ut fra utdanning og erfaring.
  • En IA-bedrift med fokus på nærvær, arbeidsmiljø og utvikling.

Du trenger ikke å kjenne alle systemene fra før. Vi legger vekt på relevant kompetanse, praktisk forståelse, samarbeidsevner og motivasjon for å lære.

Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag der du samarbeider med ansatte og ledere i helse- og omsorgstjenestene, kommunens superbrukere, IKT og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.

jobs.title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Marseille
jobs.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage dans la région marseillaise est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et agrandissons notre équipe à Marseille.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région Marseille.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.


Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering

  • Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications.

  • Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis.

  • Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows.

  • Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features.

  • Review and improve our development workflows, continuous integration checks, deployment pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Keep up to date with technology and bring in new standards and practices for improved user or developer experience

Performance, Quality, and Reliability

  • Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently.

  • Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show.

  • Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge.

  • Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.

  • Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation.

Collaboration and Craft

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts.

  • Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming.

  • Define and communicate frontend standards and best practices, and hold the team to them in review.

  • Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover.

  • Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change.

Requirements

  • Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale.

  • Sound grasp of UI, UX and accessibility considerations, with the judgement to improve a design before building it rather than implement it exactly as drawn.

  • Demonstrable experience diagnosing and fixing page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, or New Relic, and of CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, New Relic or other tools used to monitor, diagnose and fix issues

  • Hands-on background with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions or ArgoCD) as well as modern frontend architecture patterns.

  • Practical awareness of common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF, and how to design against them.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years of commercial React and TypeScript.

  • Experience shipping and operating production frontends for customer-facing SaaS products, including monitoring, incident response, and performance improvement.

  • Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase where design patterns, testability, and maintainability genuinely matter.

  • Experience consuming and shaping REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, ideally backed by Django REST Framework or an equivalent.

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers and designers on shared customer outcomes, not only technical delivery.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A salary package aligned to the role and market

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored dinners and social gatherings

jobs.title: People Partner, Germany
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our People Operations Team

Help shape how we support and grow our teams in Germany. As our People Partner, Germany, you’ll combine deep local expertise with the opportunity to build and improve the People foundations of a fast-changing business. Reporting to Josh Gladwin, you’ll strategically partner with Fleet Operations Germany and be a visible, trusted point of contact for employees and managers across the country. You’ll work closely with our global People Partner team and local leaders to turn compliance requirements into practical processes while building a strong employee experience.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

Audit and strengthen German People policies, processes and regulatory compliance, owning improvements through implementation.

Manage employee relations cases end to end, including probations, grievances and exits.

Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and provide responsive local guidance to employees and managers across Germany.

Collaborate with departmental People Partners to deliver consistent global practices that meet local requirements.

Build trusted relationships with local leadership, communicate clearly and contribute to a visible, people-oriented culture.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

Auditing German People processes, identifying compliance gaps and project-managing improvements from recommendation through rollout, including policies, regulatory reporting, health checks and exit processes.

Owning employee relations cases end to end, including probations, probation exits, grievances and other exits, working with works councils.

Acting as the visible first point of contact for employees and managers across Germany, including local benefits, time off and day-to-day guidance.

Strategically partnering with Fleet Operations Germany and operational stakeholders.

Working with departmental People Partners on employee relations and process rollouts, and influencing leaders through clear individual and group communications.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Deep practical expertise in Germany’s employment, regulatory and People compliance landscape.

End-to-end employee relations experience, including exits, probations and grievances, plus experience working with a works council.

A track record of independently building or improving People processes in a fast-paced, changing organisation.

Experience partnering with operational stakeholders and influencing leaders.

Fluent written and spoken German, with English sufficient for effective collaboration with global colleagues.

An approachable, visible partnering style and the ability to attend the office 2–3 days per week, ideally 3.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interview with the hiring manager

  • Deep-dive interviews: an in-person office interview and a presentation / panel

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
jobs.description:
Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there.

Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors.

You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

  • Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

  • Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO.

  • Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language.

  • Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

  • Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

  • Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

  • Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

  • A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

  • Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more.

  • Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

  • Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal.

  • An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

  • Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever energy and defence customers, partners and industry events take us.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in two sectors from their first deals.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Energy and defence businesses manage complex projects, contracts and entities on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn both sectors inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there.

jobs.title: AI & Revenue Operations Lead

We are looking for an ambitious leader with practical AI expertise, sharp commercial judgement and the ability to turn strategy into execution. Working directly with the VP Sales, you will help shape where we invest, identify what holds us back and build the systems that move us forward.

You will be a close strategic and execution partner: prepared, proactive and comfortable challenging constructively. Bring a clear point of view, turn decisions into owners and deadlines, and drive work across teams through to adoption.


What you’ll own

  • AI and automation. Build reliable AI agents and connected workflows for account research, meeting intelligence, opportunity inspection, follow-ups, forecasting and reporting. Connect models to business data and systems, evaluate accuracy and measure the time saved and commercial impact.

  • Growth planning and market intelligence. Partner with GTM and Finance on territories, capacity, hiring, quotas and investment. Identify patterns in the customers we win and the problems they buy us to solve. Turn regional, industry and partner opportunities into credible operating plans.

  • Revenue performance and board reporting. Own a trusted view of pipeline, conversion, win rates, sales cycles, productivity, retention and expansion. Help the VP Sales and Finance prepare the commercial board pack, translating performance and forecasts into a clear narrative and recommendations. Participate in relevant board discussions as required.

  • Sales execution and systems. Improve HubSpot, lead routing, attribution, data quality and handoffs across Lead → Close → Renew → Expand. Embed MEDDIC, stage gates, economic buyer engagement, pricing approvals and forecast discipline. Make direct and partner performance visible.

  • Leadership and scale. Drive weekly reviews and quarterly execution plans with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, Implementation and Finance. Give managers actionable insight into pipeline, coaching and capacity. Strengthen onboarding, the sales playbook and prospect-specific demo workflows.

What you bring

  • Practical AI expertise. You have built and deployed working AI workflows, connected tools and data through APIs or automation, and managed accuracy and reliability. You can show what you built, who uses it and what improved.

  • Commercial and analytical strength. You understand recurring revenue and pipeline economics. You can build planning models independently, interrogate assumptions and turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are expected; SQL, BI and scripting are valuable.

  • Hands-on delivery. You are comfortable improving CRM systems, ideally HubSpot, and connecting the GTM stack. You have owned a meaningful initiative from diagnosis to implementation, adoption and measurable results.

  • Leadership and judgement. You earn trust, influence across functions and challenge senior colleagues with evidence. You set priorities, bring people with you and know when to act or escalate.

  • Ambition and discipline. You learn quickly, seek responsibility and maintain high standards at pace. Your background may be in RevOps, GTM engineering, AI, strategy or consulting. Evidence of impact matters more than a fixed number of years or a particular degree.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: understand the revenue engine, establish performance and workload baselines, and agree the highest value priorities with the VP Sales.

  • 60 days: deliver a trusted performance view, strengthen the forecast cadence and put the first priority AI workflows into use.

  • 90 days: demonstrate adoption and measurable improvement; deliver a quarterly operating plan and a prioritised automation roadmap with clear owners.

What success looks like

Leadership makes better decisions with trusted data. Forecasts become more reliable, opportunities move with stronger evidence and managers know where to focus. jobs.title: Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
jobs.description:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live.

In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed.

Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. You'll own the relationships with our first Italian customers, and build a network of local labour specialists, consultancy-based, whilst you deliver those first implementations.

This role isn't for everyone. If you want a defined process and clear direction on what to do next, you'll find it frustrating. If you love ambiguity and changes of plan, take ownership of every implementation and make the next one better than the last, you'll shape how Sona implements in Italy from the start.

Responsibilities

  • Work out how Sona implements in Italy, and capture what you learn so each implementation starts from a better place than the last.

  • Own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live, adapting the plan as things change.

  • Build and manage relationships with stakeholders across our customers, Product and internal teams, keeping many workstreams moving at once.

  • Own the relationships with our first Italian customers.

  • Build a network of local labour specialists in Italy, consultancy-based, whilst delivering implementations.

  • Bring in the right people at the right moment, and make calls without waiting to be told what to do.

  • Manage risks, dependencies and scope, and communicate changes clearly to everyone affected.

  • Keep finding better ways to implement, and put them into practice on the next project.

Requirements

  • You're a native Italian speaker with fluent English.

  • You've delivered complex enterprise software implementations, and you can do it without a playbook handed to you.

  • You love ambiguity and changes of plan, and you stay clear-headed when many things are moving at the same time.

  • You're relentless about finding the fastest route to the outcome, and you work out quickly who needs to be involved.

  • You navigate complex stakeholder relationships well, across customers, Product and internal teams, including at C-level.

  • You have a founder's mentality. You take ownership of the whole outcome, and you keep looking for ways to do it better.

  • Bonus: experience setting up delivery in a new market, product or growing team.

  • Bonus: other European languages, or existing relationships with labour or employment specialists in Italy.

Benefits

  • Salary: £80,000 - £95,000

  • London office & regular travel to Italian customers (4 days a week)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.

  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.

  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).

  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.

  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.

  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).

  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.

  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.

  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members

  • Increased accountability in project leadership

  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

 

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)

  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools

  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team

  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

  • Are fluent in English (French is a plus)

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

jobs.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

As Global Head of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead customer success across all our markets, with the UK, Poland and Germany as the largest.

  • Lead a global client success team of around 15 people, with 3–6 direct reports

  • Harmonise our customer success function globally: one model, one set of standards and one way of measuring outcomes, applied with judgement to each market.

  • Own the post-sale experience for customers across Singu and its group businesses.

  • Shape how the customer success organisation is structured, whether by geography, industry or contract size, and the role of country leads within it.

  • Report to the Chief Customer Officer and work closely with your peers in Sales, Professional Services, Support and the Executive Leadership Team.

Your first priorities:

  • Own the organisational design of client success and the operations that support it.

  • Implement repeatable, scalable processes that create predictable outcomes.

  • Harmonise the client experience across all teams involved in the client journey.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, own, and execute a single global customer success strategy and operating model.

  • Build on Singu’s market leading position and continue to deliver elite performance on GRR, NRR, Churn, and NPS.

  • Lead and develop customer success leaders and teams across markets, including country and segment leads who also manage their own customer portfolios.

🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

jobs.title: Er du en dyktig samfunnsviter som brenner for gode velferdstjenester og en tillitvekkende forvaltning?
jobs.description:
Har du i tillegg erfaring med prosjekt- og prosessledelse samt kunnskapsbasert utredningsarbeid? Da kan du være den vi ser etter. En av våre kollegaer skal ut i permisjon, og vi søker derfor en vikar fra januar 2027 til utgangen av 2027. Dette er en spennende mulighet til å arbeide tett på utviklingen av Oslo kommunes velferdstjenester og bidra med analyser og utredninger som gir beslutningsgrunnlag for ledelse og tjenesteutvikling.Velferdsetaten har oppdrag innen velferdssektoren i Oslo kommune, og er kommunens fagetat på rusfeltet. Vi driver spesialiserte bolig- og institusjonstilbud, lavterskel helsetjenester og forebyggende og oppsøkende arbeid overfor utsatte grupper. Etaten har også forvaltningsoppgaver innen boliglån og støtteordninger. Vi bidrar med tjenesteutvikling og støtter bydelene med kompetansetiltak, statistikk og analyse innen bolig-, sosial-, flyktning- og arbeidsfeltet.

Analyse- og utredningsseksjonen har ansvar for å utarbeide kunnskapsgrunnlag innen velferdstjenestene. Vi utarbeider statistikk og analyser og ser på utvikling, resultater og sammenheng i tjenestene. Vi gjennomfører utredninger, kartlegginger og evalueringer, utarbeider beslutningsgrunnlag og høringssvar, og bistår etatens ledelse i ulike prosesser i organisasjonen. Målet er å bidra til gode, likeverdige og effektive velferdstjenester som møter fremtiden. 

Den som tilsettes vil lede og bidra i ulike prosesser i hele etatens tjenesteportefølje. Du vil se på organisering, forvaltning og oppfølging av de ulike velferdstjenestene i Oslo kommune, og vurdere systemer og strukturer som kan forbedre tjenestene. Arbeidet innebærer å belyse rammebetingelser, muligheter og begrensninger, samt å innhente innspill fra praksisfeltet i etaten, andre deler av kommunen og innbyggerne. Du vil også bidra inn i vårt arbeid for mer datadrevne velferdstjenester. Som del av arbeidet behandler vi personopplysninger og personvernarbeid vil bli en del av dine oppgaver. 

Vi ser etter deg som er en dyktig og fleksibel samfunnsviter, som er utviklingsorientert, har god organisatorisk forståelse og trives med tverrfaglig samarbeid. Vi kan love spennende og varierte oppgaver, et hyggelig og faglig ambisiøst arbeidsmiljø og en unik mulighet til å bidra til kunnskapsbasert utvikling av Oslo kommunes velferdstjenester.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gjennomføre utredninger om organisering, tildeling og oppfølging av sosial-, helse- og omsorgstjenester i Oslo kommune. 
  • Lede, koordinere og delta i arbeidsgrupper og prosjekter
  • Gjennomføre kartlegginger, evalueringer og utarbeide høringsinnspill
  • Utarbeide kunnskapsgrunnlag og dokumentasjon
  • Vurdere egnet metode og innhente data og dokumentasjon 
  • Vurdere personvern og delta i personvernarbeid
  • Bidra i utvikling av systemer og prosesser
  • Kommunisere med ledelse og organisasjonen
  • Bidra inn i avdelingens øvrige arbeid
  • Bidra til kunnskapsbasert utvikling av velferdstjenestene og tillitvekkende forvaltning
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fullført relevant utdanning på masternivå, gjerne innen offentlig forvaltning, statsvitenskap, styring og ledelse
  • God kompetanse i kvalitativ metode. Fordel med kompetanse i kvantitativ metode
  • Minst to års relevant arbeidserfaring 
  • God erfaring fra prosjektledelse 
  • God erfaring fra offentlig forvaltning  
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk tilsvarende minimum C2 i henhold til Det felles europeiske rammeverket for språk
  • Fordel med kunnskap om kommunale velferdstjenester 

Vi ber deg legge ved vitnemål og dokumentasjon på relevant arbeidserfaring sammen med søknad innen søknadsfristen. Søkere med utenlandsk utdanning må også legge ved generell godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.

Personlige egenskaper
  • Selvstendig og ansvarsfull. Du tar initiativ og eierskap og fullfører oppgaver. 
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner. Du lytter til andre og tar innspill. Du kan formidle fagstoff til ulike målgrupper. 
  • God organisatorisk forståelse. Du har forståelse for kommunal forvaltning og kan forholde deg til ulike roller ut fra aktuell kontekst.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt 
Vi tilbyr
  • En selvstendig stilling med mulighet til å bidra i utviklingen av viktige velferdstjenester for Oslo kommune   
  • Utfordrende, varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver   
  • Hyggelige, dyktige og samfunnsengasjerte kollegaer   
  • Fleksitidsordning  og mulighet til hjemmearbeid
  • IA-bedrift   
  • Lekre lokaler og bedriftsrestaurant sentralt i Oslo 
  • Gode tjenestepensjons- og forsikringsordninger i Oslo pensjonsforsikring – som ansatt i Oslo kommune betaler arbeidsgiver i tillegg hele pensjonspremien din etter nettolønnsordningen, det vil si at det ikke trekkes 2 prosent av din brutto lønn til pensjonsinnskudd 
  • Stillingen lønnes som spesialkonsulent II i lønnstrinn 50 - 54 (kr 844 000 - kr 909 000 per år) i Oslo kommunes lønnsregulativ, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner og kompetanse. 
KontaktinformasjonHedda Aas, Seksjonssjef, 41 24 61 72 ArbeidsstedHausmanns gate 21 0101 OSLO Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune Referansenr.: 5212517498 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.01.2028 Søknadsfrist: 04.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

På vegne av kommunen gir Velferdsetaten tjenester til innbyggere med rusavhengighet, bidrar til et tryggere sentrum og forvalter sosiale og økonomiske boligvirkemidler. Vi har ansvar for kommunens satsing innen mangfold og inkludering og har flere tiltak for å få flere i arbeid. Vi har kriminalitetsforebyggende tiltak, forvalter store tilskuddsordninger, og vi bistår NAV og bydeler med tall og analyser. Vi er ca. 1050 ansatte fordelt på rundt 35 tjenestesteder i tillegg til administrasjonen.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

Les mer om Velferdsetaten på www.oslo.kommune.no/etater-foretak-og-ombud/velferdsetaten/
