jobs.title: AI Agent Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Ready to help AI take flight — and keep it on course? Join an engineering project in the aviation industry, where the challenge is taking AI beyond the demo and into dependable, everyday use. As an AI Agent Platform Engineer, you’ll build the foundations that help teams bring agents to production safely, understand how they behave and keep their costs under control. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with a voice in platform design, working alongside experienced engineers and the teams building AI applications. Apply today and help turn AI ambition into production reality!Key responsibilities    Build and run the platform that supports AI agents in production.    Contribute to platform design decisions and help turn them into working solutions.    Set up secure access so agents can act on behalf of users with only the permissions they need.    Build secure deployment pipelines across AWS accounts and regions, including signing and scanning shared software components.    Maintain infrastructure that keeps customers’ environments separate and their data in the required regions.    Introduce monitoring, tracing and safeguards to track agent behaviour, limit repeated actions and control model costs.    Support teams building AI agents, helping them use the platform and resolve technical challenges.Ideal candidate profile    Hands-on experience running LLM applications or AI agents in production, beyond prototypes and demos.    Strong AWS experience, including platforms serving multiple customers, private networking and infrastructure as code.    Practical knowledge of delegated access and on-behalf-of token flows, so agents can act within a user’s permissions.    Experience building secure CI/CD pipelines, including deployments across multiple AWS accounts and regions.    Experience monitoring production systems, investigating issues and tracing activity across services.    A collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to help different engineering teams move forward without directly managing them.    Nice to have: experience with Auth0.Conditions    Location: Gothenburg, Sweden,    Work model: Flexible hybrid arrangement (typically, 2-3 days from office)    Contract: Regular employment or through your own company (your choice)Recruitment steps    Initial call with a KUBO recruiter to discuss your experience, strengths and development interests.    Two interviews with the client.    Decision and feedback.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
jobs.description:
Ben jij ready voor Change?
Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat.

Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken.


Hier ga je werken:

Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving.

Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen.

Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change.

Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor?

Actieve sourcing en hunting

Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change.

Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam

Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap.

Operationele aansturing

Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen.

Businesspartner voor sales en operatie

Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties.

Candidate experience

Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen.

Procesverbetering en data

Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren.

Talentpools

Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven.


Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden?

Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. 
Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project. 
Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch. 
Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af. 

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt.

  • Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak.

  • Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven.

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters.

  • Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt.

  • Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata.

  • Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat.

  • Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit.

  • Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal.

  • Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen.

Wat wij jou bieden!

  • Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie.

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis).

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten.

  • De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie.

Ready for Change?

Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead – Connectivity Domain
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy helping engineering teams grow while keeping a close eye on technical quality? Are you a servant leader who leads through influence rather than authority? Then you could be the Engineering Lead we're looking for.

As Engineering Lead, you'll lead and coach three back-office engineering teams in our connectivity domain. Each team has about three developers, plus outsourced developers. You'll make sure the teams deliver predictably and to a high technical standard, that people keep growing, and that the work stays aligned with product goals. You'll be part of a group of six Engineering Leads, working together on team effectiveness, technical improvements and tech alignment across teams.

Location: Sunweb Group office in Rotterdam (Hybrid)
Start Date: Asap

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead, coach and develop three engineering teams, and build high-performing teams with a growth and blameless mindset

  • Ensure predictable delivery while balancing speed with sustainable engineering practices

  • Drive technical improvements and engineering excellence, and promote software best practices

  • Simplify complex technical solutions and help teams make sound technical decisions

  • Guide teams through change and build a culture of continuous improvement

  • Align multiple stakeholders across business and technology, and drive tech alignment on cross-team initiatives

  • Work with external technology partners and suppliers when needed

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with other Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, Architects and Product Owners. You'll also work with technicall stakeholders from Hotels, Transport, Ancillaries and Purchasing.

Who you are

You're a servant leader with strong people skills, technical curiosity and high quality standards, and you take a pragmatic approach. You work independently, take ownership and stay resilient when you meet resistance. You hold teams accountable, balance business and technical needs, and are always looking for the next step to improve.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Fluency in English

  • Dutch and/or Spanish is a big plus

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams, and you're comfortable managing several teams at once

  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams and with Product and Architecture stakeholders

  • Strong skills in people leadership, coaching, stakeholder management and Agile delivery

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, plus experience with change management

  • A lean approach to problem solving and decision making

  • Solid technical knowledge of:

    • Software engineering and modern cloud-native architectures

    • CI/CD, DevOps and software delivery practices

    • Software quality, observability, security and operational excellence

    • AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering productivity

    • Lean software craftsmanship and continuous improvement

Your toolbox

Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, observability and monitoring platforms, and collaboration and documentation tools.

Not ticking every box? At Sunweb Group, we believe curiosity, energy, and the right mindset matter more than meeting every single requirement. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear your story — let’s explore the journey together.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Yearly gross salary between 85K and 100K plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Engineering Lead? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 7 November

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Nomios, our mission is to build a secure and connected future. We work with organisations across the UK and Europe to protect and connect their digital environments, bringing together leading cybersecurity and networking technologies with specialist expertise and managed services.

As we continue to grow our UK business, we’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our Sales team and develop new Commercial and Enterprise customer relationships.

This is a new business-focused position for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening new conversations and turning prospects into long-term customers. You’ll be responsible for creating and developing your own pipeline, while also making effective use of the support available through our Business Development, Marketing, Solutions and strategic vendor teams.

You’ll take ownership of opportunities throughout the sales journey, from initial prospecting and customer engagement through discovery, solution development, proposal and commercial negotiation to successful close. We’re looking for someone who understands how to maintain momentum throughout a complex sales cycle and is confident taking responsibility for progressing their own deals.

Success in this role will also come from being highly visible in the market. You’ll spend time each week engaging directly with customers, prospects and our technology partners, developing relationships, uncovering new opportunities and building a strong network within the cybersecurity and networking community.

Cybersecurity sales experience is an important requirement for this position. You’ll need the industry knowledge and commercial credibility to understand customers' security and networking challenges and work with our technical specialists to turn those challenges into valuable solutions.

Your role as an Account Executive

As an Account Executive at Nomios, you’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and contributing directly to our continued growth across Commercial and Enterprise accounts.

You’ll have the autonomy to develop your territory and target accounts, supported by an established team around you, but we are looking for someone who is proactive and takes ownership of generating and progressing their own opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Creating and developing your own new business pipeline across targeted Commercial and Enterprise organisations

  • Identifying target accounts, researching potential opportunities and confidently establishing new relationships with prospective customers

  • Driving new logo acquisition and converting prospective organisations into long-term Nomios customers

  • Managing opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from first engagement and qualification through to discovery, proposal, negotiation and close

  • Taking ownership of deal progression, maintaining momentum and ensuring clear next steps throughout the sales process

  • Building a strong, qualified pipeline and maintaining accurate and realistic sales forecasts

  • Working closely with our Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify priority accounts, coordinate outbound activity and maximise new business opportunities

  • Developing strong relationships with our strategic technology partners and identifying opportunities to collaborate on target and whitespace accounts

  • Building regular face-to-face engagement with customers, prospective customers and vendors, with an expectation that you will be active in the market each week

  • Understanding customers' cybersecurity, networking and broader business priorities and identifying where Nomios can make a measurable difference

  • Partnering with our Solutions specialists to shape and position appropriate cybersecurity, networking and managed services propositions

  • Coordinating internal expertise across Solutions, Managed Services, Operations, Business Development and leadership to support opportunities

  • Developing persuasive commercial propositions and articulating the value of working with Nomios

  • Building relationships across customer organisations, engaging confidently with technical stakeholders, security and networking teams, procurement and senior/C-level decision-makers

  • Identifying opportunities to broaden the relationship and introduce additional Nomios solutions and services as accounts develop


We’re looking for someone who combines strong cybersecurity sales experience with a genuine new business mindset. You’ll be comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to come to you, with the commercial skills and resilience needed to progress complex sales conversations through to close.

You should have:

  • Proven sales experience within cybersecurity, networking, managed security services or a closely related technology environment

  • A successful track record of developing new Commercial and/or Enterprise customers

  • Demonstrable experience of self-generating opportunities and building pipeline, alongside opportunities generated through BDR, Marketing or vendor activity

  • Experience of taking ownership of opportunities and successfully progressing and closing complex technology deals

  • Expertise in security and networking solutions, ideally with experience working with two or more of the following vendors: Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Rapid7, Netskope, SentinelOne, Wiz or Abnormal

  • Experience collaborating effectively with BDRs, including developing target-account activity and converting prospecting activity into qualified opportunities

  • Experience developing productive relationships with technology vendors, using those partnerships to identify and create new business opportunities

  • A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to take ownership of your market and pipeline

  • Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building capabilities

  • The willingness and confidence to regularly get out into the market and meet customers, prospects and vendor partners

  • The ability to communicate credibly with stakeholders ranging from technical specialists and security architects through to senior executives and C-level decision-makers

  • A consultative approach to selling, with the ability to identify customer challenges and bring together the right people and solutions to address them

  • Strong commercial judgment and confidence negotiating and closing business

  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting disciplines

Job Specifics

  • Location: This is a hybrid role, requiring attendance at our Basingstoke office (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!)

  • Hours: Full-time, Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

  • Travel: The role includes travel within the UK, with some overnight stays, and occasional international trips if required

  • Requirements: You will be required to attend customer sites across the UK and must therefore have a full UK driving licence

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

We invest in our people. You will get to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where you are free to use your initiative in support of our strategic objectives. You will work alongside high calibre sales, technical, and operational experts as part of a supportive, tight-knit team, within which every individual has an important part to play and makes a real difference. Nomios offers a highly competitive salary and commission scheme along with industry-leading benefits.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now!

 

Nomios is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and sustaining an environment in which everyone is provided with an equal opportunity to grow and develop, and no individual will be unjustly discriminated against. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion and belief, sex and sexual orientation.

Management

  • Être force de proposition et contribuer à la construction et l’application de la feuille de route de l’ensemble de l’équipe R&D.

Dans un souci d’accessibilité et de clarté, l’écriture inclusive n’est pas utilisée dans cette annonce. Les termes employés au masculin se réfèrent aussi bien au genre féminin que masculin.

De formation Bac +4/5, vous disposez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en R&D agroalimentaire.

Vous maîtrisez les procédés agroalimentaires, la gestion de projet et le pilotage d’activité, avec des compétences en management.

Votre appétence pour la cuisine est essentielle ; une expérience des produits frais, une expertise culinaire ou des connaissances en nutrition et en analyse sensorielle seront des atouts supplémentaires.

Rejoindre Fleury Michon, c’est intégrer une entreprise engagée, où les projets se construisent collectivement et où chacun peut apporter sa contribution, prendre des initiatives et participer concrètement au développement de ses produits et de sa catégorie.


Et parce que le quotidien au travail, ce sont aussi tous ces petits + qui font la différence :

  • CSE et ses avantages.

  • Un cadre de vie privilégié : Nantes ou le bord de mer à moins d’1h15, à vous de choisir votre environnement !

Et surtout, une équipe accueillante, une ambiance chaleureuse et de belles occasions de partager, d'échanger et de faire avancer les projets ensemble. 💚

💬 Notre processus de recrutement

1️⃣ Un premier échange téléphonique 

2️⃣ Un entretien avec l'experte recrutement

3️⃣ Un entretien avec votre futur RRH et votre futur Directrice R&D

jobs.title: Responsable Marketing Digital
jobs.description:
🎯 Ton objectif :

Définir et piloter la stratégie marketing digital d'un groupe de centres de radiologie, pour développer sa visibilité, son acquisition et l'expérience de ses patients en ligne.

En 5 hashtags, ça donne 👉 #StratégieDigitale #Acquisition #SEOGEO #Contenus #Santé

🍒 sur le 🎂 : ce job est une création de poste ! Tu arrives avec une vraie latitude pour poser les bases de la stratégie digitale, définir tes priorités et construire un dispositif qui aura un impact concret sur le développement des centres.

🚀 Tes missions principales :

  • Définir la stratégie marketing digital du groupe et sa feuille de route : objectifs, priorités et actions à mener pour développer la visibilité des centres et l'acquisition de patients.

  • Identifier, tester, activer et optimiser les leviers digitaux les plus pertinents, dans le respect des contraintes propres au secteur médical.

  • Développer le SEO et expérimenter le GEO pour renforcer la visibilité du groupe sur les moteurs de recherche et les outils d'IA générative.

  • Optimiser Doctolib comme partenaire stratégique d'acquisition : visibilité des centres, qualité des fiches et des informations transmises, positionnement et bon fonctionnement du parcours de prise de rendez-vous. Tu travailleras avec le support d’un account manager.

  • Optimiser la stratégie “Google My Business” des centres pour que leurs fiches Google soient complètes et attractives, et les avis traités positivement.

  • Faire évoluer le site web pour améliorer la visibilité des centres, l'information des patients et leurs parcours en ligne.

  • Définir le calendrier éditorial et créer des contenus et relayer les actualités du groupe et des centres sur les canaux digitaux.

  • Développer la présence du groupe sur les réseaux sociaux, en définissant les sujets, les formats et les actions adaptés.

  • Mener des appels d’offres pour choisir les prestataires en marketing digital les plus pertinents (ex : agence SEO, freelances…).

  • Analyser les données du site, les parcours utilisateurs et la performance de chaque levier, notamment leur rentabilité, pour orienter les décisions et améliorer les résultats. Coconstruire des tableaux de bord à co-construire avec Doctolib.

💛 Ton équipe :

🏙️ L'entreprise : un acteur majeur de l’imagerie médicale France, en plein développement. Le groupe rassemble une quarantaine de centres de radiologie et s'est construit par rapprochements successifs de cabinets. Au siège, une équipe support accompagne les centres dans leur fonctionnement et leur développement. Le groupe se dote aujourd'hui des compétences digitales nécessaires pour accompagner sa croissance.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Ton équipe : tu rejoins une équipe support à taille humaine au siège. En tant que référent·e marketing digital, tu disposes d'une grande autonomie pour définir et mettre en œuvre tes actions, en lien avec les autres équipes.

👩 Ta manager : l’une des membres du CODIR du groupe, avec un périmètre lié au développement. Tu travailles à ses côtés pour définir les priorités digitales et apporter ton expertise dans les décisions.

🙌 Tes principaux interlocuteurs : l'équipe support au siège (30 personnes), le call-center qui traite les appels entrants, des partenaires externes, comme l'agence SEO et bien sûr les centres de radiologie. En interne, les équipes reconnaissent l'utilité du marketing digital : ton arrivée sur ce poste clé est attendue !

💻 Tes Conditions de travail :

  • 📍 Ton bureau : actuellement à La Défense, avec un déménagement prévu sur Saint-Lazare au printemps.

  • 🖥️ Modalités de travail : sur site, possibilité de télétravail de façon ponctuelle.

  • Package de rémunération :

    • 📄 Contrat : cadre au forfait jours

    • 💰 Salaire fixe : entre 45 et 55k€, payés sur 13 mois, selon ton expérience.

    • 💸 Salaire variable : jusqu’à 15% de ta rémunération fixe, versés chaque trimestre.

    • 💎 Autres avantages : prise en charge à 100% de ton Pass Navigo, à 67% de ta mutuelle (mono, duo ou famille) et à 60% de ta carte tickets resto.

    • 🌴 Repos : 8 semaines par an : 5 semaines de congés payés + 3 semaines de RTT/an


Tes expériences & compétences :

  • Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience post-études en marketing digital et tu sais définir une stratégie autant que la mettre en œuvre.

  • Tu maîtrises le SEO et tu sais le travailler sur un secteur contraint, comme ici dans le médical. Tu as expérimenté de premiers tests ou projets en GEO et tu as envie d'aller plus loin sur le sujet.

  • Tu as déjà piloté un partenariat online stratégique de génération de leads ou un partenariat avec une marketplace qui vendait tes produits ou services : comprendre son fonctionnement et ses algorithmes, optimiser la visibilité et veiller à la qualité des flux, des contenus et des informations transmis.

  • Tu sais analyser les données de chaque levier et du site, suivre les parcours utilisateurs et transformer les résultats en arbitrages concrets.

  • Tu as un profil 360 : évolution de site, création de contenus et développement des réseaux sociaux font partie des sujets que tu sais aborder.

Ta personnalité :

  • Autonome et débrouillard·e, tu sais prendre des initiatives, structurer tes priorités et faire avancer tes projets.

  • Proactif·ve et curieux·se, tu testes, tu mesures, tu recommences, et tu sors volontiers des sentiers battus quand le levier classique ne donne rien. Changer de cap ne te fait pas peur : tu es une personne agile, qui sait rebondir rapidement si c’est nécessaire.

  • Pragmatique, tu aimes mettre les mains dans le cambouis et construire ce qui n'existe pas encore plutôt que d'optimiser l'existant à la marge.

  • Pédagogue, tu sais adapter ton discours au niveau de connaissances de tes interlocuteurs sur tes sujets et vulgariser les concepts du marketing digital.

Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job :

C'est un poste rare : toute la stratégie marketing digital est à construire, avec un enjeu fort d'acquisition mais aussi de visibilité, de contenus et d'expérience en ligne. Tu auras une vraie latitude pour décider par où commencer et faire avancer des sujets variés, dans une structure en croissance où ton expertise est attendue. Un beau terrain de jeu pour un profil 360 qui aime autant définir un cap que le concrétiser.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to our team!

WHO WE ARE :

eCential Robotics develops and markets a unique platform that combines robotic 2D/3D imaging, real-time navigation, and surgical robotics.

With over 100 patents and 7 registered trademarks, our company provides orthopedic surgeons and neurosurgeons with cutting-edge, user-friendly technology that enables them to visualize and optimize their procedures, particularly in minimally invasive surgery.

As a leader in the rapidly growing field of surgical robotics, eCential Robotics is committed to shaping the future of healthcare innovation and aims to become the global leader in open robotic platforms.

JOB SUMMARY :

The Quality Assurance Manager provides day-to-day leadership, guidance and support to the Quality Assurance team while remaining actively involved in supporting operational activities.

This role leads the Quality Management System and serves as a key quality partner across the organization, overseeing audits and inspections, non-conformities, complaints, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and change control. The Quality ssurance Manager drives continuous improvement, supports compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, and promotes a proactive, solution-oriented quality culture. In partnership with the VP of Quality Assurance, the manager sets team priorities, supports employee development, and translates quality objectives into effective departmental actions.

MISSIONS :

Partner cross-functionally with all company departments including Regulatory affairs, Purchasing, Production, and Engineering to resolve quality issues and support all QMS related activities. Serve as Top Management Representative:

  • Monitor quality data to identify emerging risks and trends; communicate key metrics and escalate significant quality concerns as appropriate.
  • Prepare and lead Management Reviews, update the quality policy and objectives.


Define, manage and lead the Quality Management System with support from the QA team:

  • Support product and QMS compliance with applicable internal requirements and regulatory standards, including FDA requirements, and ISO 13485.
  • Lead the preparation, conduct, and follow-up of audits and inspections, including internal audits.
  • Develop and recommend updates to quality standards, procedures, work instructions, and processes.
  • Manage non-conformities and complaints, and track the associated corrective and improvement actions. Lead or support complaint and CAPA investigations, including root cause analysis, using structured problem-solving methods. Ensure that corrective actions are implemented and their effectiveness is verified.
  • Oversees the change control process including, but not limited to, QMS and design changes.


Accountable for the quality assurance activities relative to operations:

  • Responsible for ensuring that the conformity of the device is appropriately checked, in accordance with the quality management system under which the devices are manufactured, before a device is released (PRRC).
  • Support supplier quality activities.
  • Validate the supplier audit program.
  • Oversee management of measurement/testing equipment as well as software validation.


Leader of the Design Quality team responsible to:

  • Ensure compliance with the design quality procedure, both in the design process and in the preparation of design deliverables.
  • Support Design Transfer, equipment qualification, and DMR.


Quality culture driver:

  • Promote a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Lead complex projects and quality initiatives as assigned.
  • Train and upskill the company on quality: onboard all new hires on QA practices and processes, run regular training and refreshers for existing teams as needed, train and drive process pilots.


Team management:

  • Translate business and quality goals into team priorities, resource allocation, and employee development priorities. Manage the execution of team objectives to ensure these goals are achieved.
  • Supervise assigned personnel and manage individual performance. Support employees through coaching, training, development planning, and employee engagement activities.


PROFILE :

  • Master’s degree (five years of higher education) in Quality, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in medical device quality assurance, including experience leading audits.
  • Significant experience with team management.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, MDR, and quality systems.
  • Knowledge of relevant FDA requirements is a strong asset.
  • Fluency in English is essential (professional communication and documentation).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Natural leadership and the ability to bring people together.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach.
  • Ability to influence and work cross-functionally in an international environment.
  • Results-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on approach and close involvement with operations.

jobs.title: Lärare i svenska och/eller svenska som andraspråk på gymnasial nivå
jobs.description: Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för vuxnas lärande och etablering i samhället? Som lärare på Komvux Helsingborg spelar du en avgörande roll i att stödja elevers utveckling och att bidra till deras framtida möjligheter inom studier och arbete. Komvux Helsingborg växer och vi söker nu engagerade lärare med behörighet inom svenska och/eller svenska som andraspråk på gymnasial nivå.Om arbetsplatsenFramtidens välfärd är vår stora utmaning. För att klara den har vi på arbetsmarknadsförvaltningen ett mycket viktigt uppdrag: Vi ska göra det möjligt för invånare med ekonomiskt bistånd att bli självförsörjande så snabbt som möjligt, men även bidra till att arbetsgivare hittar rätt kompetens. Vi möter utmaningen med ett brett utbud av vuxenutbildningar och arbetsmarknadsinsatser – och provar nya sätt att arbeta tillsammans med näringslivet, andra förvaltningar, myndigheter och civilsamhället. För att lyckas måste vi våga, testa nytt och hitta smarta lösningar. Vi är cirka 400 kollegor på förvaltningen, och vår roll är att ge invånare de rätta verktygen så att de kan ta ansvar för sin egen utveckling och försörjning. Dessutom samordnar vi stadens arbete med migrations- och etableringsfrågor.ArbetsuppgifterKomvux Helsingborg är Helsingborgs stads egen anordnare av vuxenutbildning och erbjuder SFI, föräldrasvenska, grundläggande och gymnasial vuxenutbildning samt Komvux som anpassad utbildning. Som en del av arbetsmarknadsförvaltningen bedriver vi även undervisning inom arbetsmarknads- och integrationsinsatser. Vår storlek och bredd ger många möjligheter till ett omväxlande och spännande arbete.  Vi söker nu nya kollegor som företrädelsevis kommer att undervisa enligt Skolverkets kurs- och ämnesplaner men som också kan komma att arbeta med orienteringskurser som stärker elevernas förutsättningar att studera. Gymnasiala ämnen erbjuds i huvudsak med ett 10-veckorsupplägg och inom grundläggande svenska och svenska som andraspråk har vi starter var femte vecka. Som lärare hos oss ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisningen med fokus på att se hela progressionslinjen från grundläggande till gymnasial nivå. Tillsammans med arbetslaget arbetar ni med inkluderande lärmiljöer som främjar elevernas språkutveckling och måluppfyllelse. Vuxenutbildningens målgrupp har varierande behov och förutsättningar, vilket ställer krav på att du kan anpassa undervisningen och upplägg för den enskilde eleven. Komvux elevgrupp består idag också av fler yngre elever som kommer direkt från gymnasieskolan. Undervisningen bedrivs både dag- och kvällstid, vilket innebär en varierad och flexibel arbetsvardag. Du ingår i ett arbetslag med lärare i svenska och svenska som andraspråk, där samarbete och erfarenhetsutbyte är en viktig del av arbetet.  Utöver undervisningen bidrar du aktivt till att utveckla verksamheten både utifrån styrdokument samt stadens och förvaltningens mål. Vad vi erbjuder Hos oss erbjuds du bl.a. ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, en förmånsportal och möjlighet till fler semesterdagar. Du kommer att leda undervisningen i våra fina lokaler på Campusområdet med närhet till Knutpunkten/Helsingborg C. Välkommen till oss! KvalifikationerVi söker dig som:     Har svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa på gymnasial nivå i svenska och/eller som andraspråk på gymnasial nivå. Kopia på sådan lärarlegitimation ska bifogas ansökan.     Har minst 2 års erfarenhet av att undervisa antingen på gymnasiet eller inom vuxenutbildning.     Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med utvecklingsarbete kopplat till undervisning.     Har god digital kompetens och vana av att arbeta och dokumentera i administrativa system.     Har god erfarenhet av att arbeta med kollegor i olika professioner och med föränderliga arbetsuppgifter. Det är meriterande om du:     Har dokumenterad kompetens/fortbildning i att möta elever med NPF.     Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med ungdomar i behov av stöd Vill du vara med och skapa en bättre stad tillsammans med helsingborgarna? Då ska du jobba i Helsingborgs stad. Här kan du använda din kreativitet och drivkraft till att göra livet lättare och tryggare för våra invånare, besökare och näringsliv. Tillsammans med nyfikna och hjälpsamma kollegor gör du skillnad i människors liv, både idag och i framtiden. Ett bra jobb idag, en bättre stad imorgon.Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att jobba i staden: https://helsingborg.se/arbete/sa-ar-det-att-jobba-i-staden/Övrig informationUrval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-11-29Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning (semestertjänst). Timvikariat Omfattning: HeltidTillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelseAntal tjänster: 3 För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Helsingborgs stad använder vi rekryteringsverktyget ReachMee. Därför ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan via ReachMee genom att klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. I ansökan ska CV och övriga för tjänsten relevanta handlingar bifogas, exempelvis utbildningsbevis eller yrkeslegitimation. Du kommer även få besvara urvalsfrågor. Om du saknar svar från oss, kontrollera skräpposten då mejl ibland sorteras dit. Du som söker jobb och har skyddade personuppgifter ska kontakta rekryterande chef i annonsen som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess. Du ska inte ansöka digitalt via ansökningslänken. Fackliga företrädare https://intranat.helsingborg.se/hr/samverkan-och-delaktighet/fackliga-foretradare/

jobs.title: Oppsøkende miljøterapeut
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til å styrke den forebyggende innsatsen rettet mot ungdom i risiko? Vi søker nå to engasjerte og robuste oppsøkende miljøterapeuter til prosjektstillinger knyttet til Oslostandard – Oslomodell for én-til-én-oppfølging, kombinert med arbeid i Utekontakten.

Om tjenesten Utekontakten i Bydel Nordstrand er organisert i Team Ung, som er en del av seksjon Forebyggende helsetjenester barn og unge i avdeling Oppvekst og velferd. Seksjonen består av blant annet skolehelsetjenesten, helsestasjon for ungdom, helsestasjon, fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten, fritidsklubbene, Oslohjelpen og rådgivende enhet for russaker.

Utekontakten arbeider for å skape trygge oppvekstvilkår og forebygge negativ utvikling i barne- og ungdomsmiljøer gjennom oppsøkende sosialt arbeid, individuell oppfølging, gruppetiltak og aktivitet som metode. Tjenesten samarbeider tett med skoler, fritidsklubber, barneverntjenesten, politi, helsetjenester og øvrige aktører i bydelen.

Om stillingen Stillingene er knyttet til arbeidet med Oslostandard – Oslomodell for én-til-én-oppfølging. Dette innebærer oppfølging av ungdom i risiko for kriminalitet og negativ utvikling. Oslomodellen er utviklet for å gi ungdom med sammensatte utfordringer tett, strukturert og individuelt tilpasset oppfølging. Målet er å forebygge kriminalitet, vold og videre negativ utvikling gjennom å styrke ungdommens mestring, sosiale ferdigheter og fremtidshåp. Oppfølgingen er helhetlig og fleksibel, og foregår på ungdommens egne arenaer i tett samarbeid med familie og relevante tjenester. Som oppsøkende miljøterapeut vil du kombinere én-til-én-oppfølging med ordinært oppsøkende arbeid i Utekontakten.To kveldsvakter per uke inngår i stillingen.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Tett, strukturert og målrettet én-til-én-oppfølging av ungdom med sammensatte utfordringer
  • Kartlegging, tiltaksplanarbeid og systematisk dokumentasjon
  • Samarbeid med foresatte og familie
  • Koordinering og tverrfaglig samarbeid med skole, barnevern, politi, helsetjenester og øvrige aktører
  • Oppsøkende sosialt arbeid på ungdommens arenaer
  • Gruppeleder for samtale- og/eller aktivitetsgrupper for ungdom
  • Bidra i utvikling og implementering av Oslomodellen i bydelen
  • Delta i fagutvikling og systematisk erfaringsdeling
  • Informasjonsarbeid om tjenesten og én-til-én oppfølgingen ut til innbyggere og samarbeidspartnere
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Krav til utdanning: Bachelorgrad innen helse- og sosialfag, kriminologi eller pedagogikk.
  • Bred erfaring fra arbeid med ungdom i risiko er et krav
  • Erfaring med oppsøkende sosialt arbeid er et krav
  • Erfaring med gruppemetodikk og å lede grupper er et krav
  • Erfaring knyttet til arbeid med én-til-én oppfølging er et krav
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne
  • Det er ønskelig med kompetanse innen relasjonsarbeid, traumesensitiv tilnærming, motiverende intervju (MI) eller annen relevant metodikk
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskferdigheter, samt god kommunikasjonsevne
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav
  • Gyldig politiattest kreves ved ansettelse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er trygg, robust og relasjonssterk
  • Du evner å stå i krevende situasjoner over tid
  • Du arbeider strukturert og målrettet
  • Kunne omstille seg i takt med nye utfordringer og endringer i behov
  • Du har god rolleforståelse og samarbeider godt med andre
  • Du har evne til å skape tillit hos ungdom og familier
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt
Vi tilbyr
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø
  • En meningsfull og samfunnsviktig jobb
  • Mulighet til å bidra i videreutviklingen av forebyggende arbeid i bydelen
  • Et sterkt og engasjert fagmiljø
  • Gode forsikrings og pensjonsordninger
  • Bydelshytter på Beitostølen
  • Bedriftsmedlemskap på SATS
  • Lønn etter Oslo kommunes lønnsregulativ i l.tr 26-38 (kr. 552 000 - kr. 650 500)
KontaktinformasjonLise-Lotte Ramdahl, 99285126 ArbeidsstedLangbølgen 2A 1154 OSLO Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune Referansenr.: 5212984921 Stillingsprosent: 100% Midlertidig Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2027 Søknadsfrist: 29.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Nordstrand ligger sydøst i byen og har rundt 52 500 innbyggere. Bydelen ligger nær sjøen og marka og har flott utsikt over fjorden. Det er kort vei til sentrum med offentlig kommunikasjon.

Bydel Nordstrand består av fem avdelinger. Avdelingene er Oppvekst og velferd; Tilrettelagte tjenester og psykisk helse; Helse og mestring; Organisasjon og samfunn. Bydelen arbeider aktivt for å sikre at bruker er i sentrum. Vi har etablert en unik plattform for innovasjon. Vi skal være endringsdyktige for å møte morgendagens utfordringer. Som medarbeider i bydelen vil du være en viktig brikke i dette endringsarbeidet.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

Les mer om Bydel Nordstrand på Oslo kommunes nettside, samt bydelens nettside.

jobs.title: Assistent horecamanager
jobs.description:
Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistant Manager bij Foodstation ben je de rechterhand van de manager en speel je een cruciale rol binnen ons gloednieuwe foodconcept.

Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • het coördineren van de foodservice
  • helpen bij het bereiden en serveren van gerechten wanneer nodig
  • het aansturen, motiveren en ondersteunen van het team
  • het voorraadbeheer en de bestellingen opvolgen
  • toezien op netheid, hygiëne en veiligheid in de keuken en de foodcorner
  • klanten vriendelijk ontvangen en een uitstekende service garanderen
  • samen met de manager zorgen voor een vlotte werking en fijne werksfeer

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Manager van het Foodstation herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in de horeca of catering, je bent bij voorkeur vertrouwd met healthy fast food
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent flexibel inzetbaar en kan ook in het weekend werken
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren

De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een enthousiaste en gedreven teamplayer die energie haalt uit afwisseling en het coachen van een team.

Je hebt een passie voor voeding en de bereiding ervan en vindt het leuk om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar geen dag hetzelfde is.

Je kan terugkijken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring in een horeca-keten, waarin het aansturen van collega's zeker aan bod kwam.

Organiseren, delegeren en actie ondernemen zijn jouw tweede natuur.

Je bent flexibel ingesteld en vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend te werken. Ook vroege en late uren (tussen 5u en 23u) schrikken jou niet af.

Je kan ook op vroege en late uren vlot ter plaatse zijn.

Je zoekt een vaste job waar je kan groeien binnen een gezonde en innovatieve organisatie.

jobs.title: Tandlääkare
jobs.description: Vill du arbeta på en klinik där du får förtroende, frihet och möjlighet att utvecklas?Är du tandläkare och söker en arbetsplats där din kompetens uppskattas, dina idéer tas tillvara och du får möjlighet att påverka din egen arbetssituation? Då kan Mariastaden Tandvård vara rätt plats för dig!Mariastaden Tandvård i Helsingborg söker en engagerad och kvalitetsmedveten tandläkare som vill bli en del av vårt team och vara med och utveckla framtidens tandvård.Hos oss får du mer än bara ett arbete. jobs.title: Front Office Medewerker The CORNR Hotel 4* superior
jobs.description:
Til jij onze gastenbeleving naar een hoger niveau?

Werken bij The CORNR Hotel betekent werken in een omgeving waar gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en persoonlijke service centraal staan. Voor ons 4-sterren superior hotel in Nieuwpoort-Bad zoeken we een ervaren Front Office Medewerker die hospitality écht begrijpt, graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en voldoening haalt uit een gastenervaring die tot in de details klopt. Onze receptie is veel meer dan een plek waar gasten in- en uitchecken. Het is het kloppende hart van ons hotel, waar persoonlijke aandacht, professionaliteit en een vlotte organisatie samenkomen.

Jouw rol

Als Front Office Medewerker ben jij een van de eerste én laatste gezichten die onze gasten zien. Je zorgt voor een warm onthaal, een vlotte check-in en check-out en een persoonlijke service die het verschil maakt. Je beheert reservaties, beantwoordt vragen en helpt gasten met plezier verder. Je denkt vooruit, merkt op wanneer iets beter kan en neemt zelf initiatief om problemen op te lossen, liefst nog voordat de gast ze ervaart. Ook achter de schermen houd je het overzicht. Je werkt nauwkeurig met ons hotelmanagementsysteem, communiceert vlot met andere afdelingen en zorgt ervoor dat belangrijke informatie correct wordt doorgegeven. Je begrijpt dat echte hospitality niet alleen draait om vriendelijk zijn, maar ook om verantwoordelijkheid nemen, commercieel meedenken en consequent kwaliteit leveren.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken iemand die al ervaring heeft binnen de hotelsector en zich thuis voelt in een professionele omgeving waar de verwachtingen hoog liggen.

Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding, bij voorkeur binnen hotelmanagement of hospitality, of je hebt relevante en stevige praktijkervaring opgebouwd binnen de sector. Een diploma is dus niet doorslaggevend, maar de juiste kennis en ervaring zijn dat wel.

Je communiceert vlot en professioneel in het Nederlands, Frans én Engels. Onze gasten komen uit verschillende landen en verwachten dat ze in hun eigen taal correct en gastvrij geholpen worden.

Je bent zelfstandig, georganiseerd en stressbestendig. Ook wanneer meerdere gasten tegelijk je aandacht vragen, behoud je het overzicht en stel je de juiste prioriteiten.

Je hebt een verzorgd voorkomen, een natuurlijke commerciële ingesteldheid en oog voor detail. Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren, maar ziet zelf waar je het verschil kunt maken.

Ervaring met Mews is een pluspunt. Belangrijker is dat je vlot met digitale systemen werkt en nieuwe werkwijzen snel oppikt.

Je werkt vanuit The CORNR Hotel, maar ondersteunt waar nodig ook de receptiewerking van The CORNR Seaview. Onze hotels zijn zeven dagen op zeven geopend, waardoor wisselende shifts en weekendwerk deel uitmaken van de functie.

jobs.title: GL Accountant

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Puurs and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

  • You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
  • You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
  • You align accounting and operational processes.
  • You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
  • You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
  • You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
  • You participate in the annual budgeting process.
  • You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
  • You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
  • You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
  • You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
  • You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
  • You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • You are fluent in English.
  • You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
  • SAP experience is advantageous.
  • You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

jobs.title: Data Analyst/ Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data and data analysis, and do you enjoy combining functional insight with technical depth? Do you get energy from engaging with stakeholders as well as from structuring and modelling data into a reliable foundation for insights and reporting? Do you enjoy considering how business needs and data from different sources can be brought together in clear, scalable data models? Then a role as a Data Analyst within our Data & AI team might be the perfect fit for you!

  • You work closely with experienced colleagues on Business Intelligence, Data and AI projects, primarily within the Microsoft Cloud
  • You analyse business questions and translate them into clear functional requirements, data requirements and technical specifications for the further development of the data solution
  • You facilitate workshops with stakeholders to identify information needs, KPIs, definitions and business rules
  • You design and optimise conceptual, logical and dimensional data models that provide a reliable foundation for reporting and analytics
  • You map data sources, data flows and their interrelationships, while ensuring data consistency and quality
  • You collaborate closely with business stakeholders, data engineers and data architects to deliver scalable data solutions
  • You document data definitions, business rules and models and contribute to clear data governance agreements
  • You support the translation of data models into user-friendly analyses and reports.
What you need to succeed:
  • You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Business IT & Management, Data Science or a related field
  • You have several years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst or in a similar data-focused role, preferably within a consultancy environment
  • You have experience with functional analysis and with gathering, analysing and structuring business and data requirements. You can translate business needs into clear functional and technical solutions
  • You have strong knowledge of data modelling, including dimensional models, star schemas and data warehousing concepts. Knowledge of Kimball and Data Vault is a strong asset
  • You are proficient in SQL and can analyse, validate and prepare datasets for analytical use
  • You have experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including building data models, reports and dashboards. You also have a good knowledge of DAX
  • Experience with Python for data analysis, data transformation or automation is an asset.
  • You understand how data sources, data flows, data quality and data governance come together in a reliable data environment. Data engineering experience is an asset
  • You have strong communication skills and can clearly explain complex business and data challenges to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You feel comfortable in a client-facing environment and confidently facilitate workshops and requirements sessions
  • You communicate fluently in Dutch and can also express yourself professionally in English
  • You are flexible and willing to travel, as you will regularly work on-site at client locations. When your presence at the client is not required, you can combine working from home with working from the Cegeka office closest to you (Antwerp, Ghent, Diegem, Hasselt or Leuven).

Je begeleidt hen bij vragen rond persoonlijke assistentie en ondersteunt hen bij het vinden en organiseren van passende ondersteuning.

Je werkt zelfstandig binnen jouw regio, met de expertise en ondersteuning van Aut of the box achter je.

We zoeken een collega die onze visie deelt en zich herkent in het volgende profiel:

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, empathisch en professioneel.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig.

  • Je hebt een goed organisatorisch inzicht en neemt initiatief.

jobs.title: Shift Leader
jobs.description: Mister York  söker nya ledare till stockholm sveavägen.    Mister York är en växande hamburgerkedja som utmanar branschen och erbjuder vad vi kallar den nya generationens fast food. Vi tycker att en burgare gjord på kvalitativa råvaror inte skall behöva kosta en förmögenhet, det ska inte heller ta lång tid att få den i handen.Mister York serverade sin första burgare sommaren 2020 ur en foodtruck. Idag öppnar vi fullskaliga snabbmatsrestauranger samtidigt som vi driver vidare och utvecklar våra mindre containerhus. Mister York har utsetts till Sveriges bästa burgarkedja 3 år i rad av burgerdudes, något vi är väldigt stolta över! Är du den vi söker? Vi söker dig som är ansvarstagande, utåtriktad, engagerad & bra på att samarbeta i grupp. Som person är du driven, sprider en positiv energi omkring dig till resten av arbetslaget och sätter laget före jaget. Du är resultatinriktad och inspirerar teamet till att ständigt uppnå högre resultat. Du förstår vikten av att vara en god förebild och tycker om att se dina kollegor växa och utvecklas. Vad innebär rollen som Shift Leader på Mister York? En Shift Leader har ansvar för att den dagliga driften drivs enligt Mister Yorks rutiner för att uppnå uppsatta KPIer och att restaurangen under skift når fastslagna försäljningsprognoser. Tillsammans med Managers och övriga Shift Leaders ingår du i restaurangens ledningsgrupp. Som Shift Leader leder du skift där du är ansvarig för hela restaurangens drift. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar följande:    Leda skift genom ansvar, medverkan och delegering av arbetsuppgifter    Rutinmässig rapportering till Manager    Sprider energi och glädje till medarbetarna som för detta vidare till gäst    Coachning av medarbetare    Ta emot och kontrollerar leveranser från leverantörer    Inköp av varor    Utbildning av nya medarbetare    Ansvar för egenkontrollprogram, checklistor och att rutiner följs     En Shift Leader har fullt ansvar för resultatet på enheten under sitt ledda pass. Resultatet innefattar kundnöjdhet, väntetider, renlighet och kvalitet.    Hög kvalitet är något som genomsyrar hela vår företagskultur. Alla som arbetar inom vår verksamhet ska veta varför de går till jobbet varje morgon och hur de är med och bidrar.   TJÄNSTAnställningsform: ProvanställningAnställningens omfattning: 70-100%Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelseLöneform: TimlönArbetstider: Varierande; dag, kväll och helg.  Mister York är anslutna till kollektivavtal.

You are empathic, but also confident enough to challenge others when needed.WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of broad HR experience, with strong understanding in labor law and occupational health care. - Proven track record in developing work ability management and related KPIs. - A strong business mindset and the ability to support leaders in aligning people and operations. - Strong ability to collaborate and build trust on all levels of the organization. - Support and challenge leaders in a bold and positive way. - Relevant academic background or equivalent practical experience. - Full professional fluency in both Finnish and English.Salary: The salary will range between 4500eur-5500eur. Fantastic! Please apply through the link above. Feel free to send your application in either Finnish or English.Scandic is the leading hotel company in the Nordics. We want to be like a friend in town for people on the road – and friends know what friends need. We believe that great hospitality starts with us, in every role and every interaction. What you do here makes a real difference. A warm welcome, a thoughtful detail or support for a colleague – your actions shape the moments that matter for our guests, for each other and for the world around us. At Scandic, you can be yourself, use your strengths and let your passion create experiences people want to return to. Together, we make everyone feel welcome and at home – just like friends do.

jobs.title: PhD Research Scholar positions - Department of Strategy and Management
jobs.description:
The PhD specialisation

NHH is pleased to announce vacancies in the Department of Strategy and Management. Candidates admitted to the PhD program will receive the title of PhD Research Scholar. The department welcomes applications specialising in several fields of research such as strategy, innovation, management, organizational behaviour, and marketing. The research areas described below represent research opportunities emphasised by the Department, but applications within other relevant research areas are also welcome.

Start date: August 2027Digital Innovation for sustainable GrowthDigital Innovation for sustainable Growth (DIG) is a research center at the Department of Strategy and Management, focusing on sustainable growth and transformation enabled by digital technologies. As a PhD Research Scholar, you will join an ambitious research community with access to leading organizations, national register data, and advanced AI infrastructure. We invite applications on the following major grand challenges: AI for Business and the Silver Economy. AI is reshaping organizations, strategies, and workforce skills, while demographic aging creates both challenges and opportunities for business innovation and sustainable growth. These shifts call for new insights into strategy, competition, and organizational adaptation.

The center’s research focuses primarily on five key areas:

  • Business intelligence
  • Consumer Psychology and Technology Adoption
  • Creating and capturing sustainable value
  • Governance Leadership and Change
  • Future of Work

Applications within all these areas are welcome. E-mail: bram.timmermans@nhh.no or lasse.lien@nhh.no

Global Strategy / International Business – with a focus on digital transformation and geopoliticsGlobal Strategy investigates how the global context shapes firms’ strategies and strategic management. Recent geopolitical events, rising populism that weakens global institutions, and the urgency of grand social and environmental challenges are redrawing that context and creating rich research opportunities. In parallel, advances in digital technologies - including AI and Industry 4.0 - challenge core assumptions in International Business, reshaping where firms expand, how they organize cross-border activities, and how they compete. We welcome proposals that explore these themes and their intersections using primarily quantitative methods. We are explicitly open to candidates from adjacent disciplines - such as political science, international relations, or information systems - who seek to integrate their perspectives to advance Global Strategy and International Business research.E-mail: bjorn.schmeisser@nhh.no

Productive Alone but Wiser Together? AI and Collective Knowledge Building in OrganizationsMeeting, learning from, and sharing with colleagues is central to how organizations build collective knowledge. As employees increasingly turn to AI and large language models as sparring partners, these interactions may be quietly displaced. Organizations want to encourage AI use for productivity and efficiency, yet they also need to preserve the organic social interactions through which collective knowledge is built. Early evidence highlights this tension: AI assistance can raise individual performance while narrowing the knowledge groups draw on, and contributions to public knowledge-sharing communities have fallen since generative AI arrived. Far less is known about how this plays out inside organizations. The project will examine what organizations can do, and which work designs can help balance individual productivity with collective knowledge building in the age of AI. We especially welcome candidates interested in Information Systems, Systems Thinking or Organization Theory, and in qualitative research within organizations adopting AI.Email: vidya.oruganti@nhh.no

The Future of Human Resource Management (HRM)Rapid technological change is transforming how we work, organize, and lead. Remote and hybrid work, digital collaboration tools, and AI are creating new opportunities and challenges for organizations and employees. We invite PhD candidates to develop original research on these transformations in a Nordic context, where collaboration among employers, employees, and labor unions plays a central role. As a PhD Research Scholar, you will join an active research environment, work closely with experienced faculty, and contribute new knowledge about how technology is shaping HRM and the future of work.E-mail: karen.olsen@nhh.no

The Board of Directors (BoD) as Strategic Partner and Change AgentThe role of the Board of Directors has evolved from monitoring performance, controlling the financials and approving strategy to becoming increasingly involved in and responsible for the strategic direction of the firm, particularly as a partner to the top management team supporting strategic renewal and innovation in the established firm. Research questions of interest include: exploring the processes through which BoDs initiate and influence strategic change and renewal, the collaborative dynamics between BoDs and senior management, and internal board dynamics.E-mail: inger.stensaker@nhh.no

Teams and cooperationMuch of the value-creating work in organizations takes place in teams, from project and product teams to top management teams and corporate boards. We invite proposals that examine what makes teams work effectively, and how relationships, norms and patterns of interaction within teams form, develop and change over time. Possible areas include, but are not limited to:

  • Team start-up and development: How do early interactions and launch processes shape later team dynamics and performance?
  • Psychological safety: How does psychological safety emerge, vary and erode over time, and how does it relate to learning, error handling, voice and performance?
  • Boards as teams: What characterizes boardroom dynamics? How do interpersonal processes in boards, such as trust, dissent, information sharing and the board–CEO relationship, affect board effectiveness and the quality of governance?
  • Humans and AI in teams: What opportunities and challenges emerge when AI is integrated into teamwork? How does it change coordination, roles, trust and learning?
  • Emotions in teams: What role do emotions and emotional dynamics play in team processes and performance?

We welcome a range of methodological approaches, including experiments, longitudinal field studies, qualitative research and multi-method designs. Applicants are encouraged to develop their own research questions within this broad area.E-mail: therese.egeland@nhh.no

Consumer trust in AI agentsArtificial intelligence is increasingly taking on roles traditionally performed by humans in marketing, including recommending products, generating advertising content, handling customer service interactions, and personalizing communications. As consumers encounter AI more frequently throughout the customer journey, researchers are seeking to understand how they perceive, evaluate, and respond to AI-based interactions. Key issues include consumer trust; perceived competence and warmth in AI systems; algorithm aversion versus algorithm appreciation; and the conditions under which consumers prefer AI agents over human employees. In this project, the main questions are: What factors facilitate trust in AI agents? Under what conditions do consumers prefer AI agents over human representatives for marketing-related tasks such as product recommendation, customer support, and service recovery?E-mail: magne.supphellen@nhh.no

Export brandingMany exporters in B2C and B2B markets use country-of-origin information in foreign-market communication. Previous research shows that such information can significantly affect brand evaluation and sales of export brands. Origin is often communicated as a simple extrinsic cue, for instance, through a made-in label. However, exporters can achieve greater leverage from origin by including favorable origin elements in export brand positioning. More research is needed on exporters' current practices and how they can leverage origin more effectively: To what extent do exporters include origin information in the brand positioning? When is this more and less effective? How is this practice different in B2B and B2C markets? What procedures do exporters use to integrate origin, and which normative, theory-based procedures can be developed?E-mail: magne.supphellen@nhh.no

The PhD programme

The PhD programme at NHH is a four-year fully-funded programme, which combines an intensive course component and research, preparing the school’s graduates for scholarly positions at reputable research institutions and positions in knowledge-intensive organisations both within and outside academia. Former PhD graduates have been hired by renowned institutions such as Harvard University, The University of Sydney’s Business School, University of Amsterdam, University of St. Gallen, Tilburg University, Stockholm School of Economics, Copenhagen Business School, Hanken School of Economics, Norwegian universities and business schools, as well as by government, banking, finance and consulting industries.

The PhD research scholars will be included in a highly stimulating and rewarding research environment, working closely with faculty members and fellow PhD research scholars. PhD research scholars participate actively in faculty and research seminars, as well as in workshops. As part of the position, the PhD research scholars allocate 25% of their time to career promoting work such as teaching assistance. They also receive pedagogical training. The place of work is at NHH in Bergen, where the PhD research scholars will have their own office space at their department.

The PhD programme gives preference to applicants who address research questions that align with the department’s research interests and the available resources for supervision. As the school aspires gender balance and diversity, female applicants will be given preference if applicants are otherwise equally qualified.

NHH offers
  • annual salary of NOK 600 000 (equivalent to approximately EUR 55 946 or USD 61 457) pr. August 2027. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Thereafter annual adjustment of minimum 3%. The salary ensures a fair standard of living in Norway and is subject to Norwegian taxes and benefits, including public health care benefits and pension savings
  • career guidance and an individual career development plan
  • opportunity to take basic Norwegian language courses
  • research funds for travels and funding for conference participation and research stays abroad to build a wider network and strengthen the research of the PhD research scholar

Bergen provides a vibrant cultural scene with easy access to mountains, fjords and a wide range of outdoor activities. The city offers a family-friendly environment and was ranked the best city in Europe for quality of life in Oxford Economics’ 2026 Global Cities Index. Most public services, like healthcare and schools are free in Norway. To explore Norway and the city of Bergen, go to visitnorway.com.

Eligibility requirements

Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for the PhD programme. Applicants must normally have completed a five-year Master of Science (MSc) degree in Economics and Business Administration or a comparable degree. The average grade must normally correspond to a minimum of B (4.0) in the Norwegian grade system. 

The Department of Strategy and Management requires you to demonstrate both an adequate level of academic skills and an adequate level of English language proficiency (unless you are exempt). We accept the following tests:

  • GMAT or GRE tests to measure your academic skills
  • TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic to measure your English language proficiency

When applying, you are required to upload a copy of your unofficial test scores in Jobbnorge before the deadline. If you are shortlisted, NHH will ask you to give us access to your official test scores without delay.

Exemptions:

  • You are waived from the GMAT or GRE tests if you hold a qualifying master’s degree from a Nordic institution.
  • You are waived from TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic tests if you are a native English speaker, if you have a qualifying master’s degree from a Nordic institution or if you have a qualifying master’s degree where the language of tuition was English.

For more detailed information about the tests and their minimum scores, please visit our webpage: Admission to the PhD programme| NHH. If you have questions, you may contact phd@nhh.no.

Application requirements

You are required to upload the following documents with your application in Jobbnorge:

  • Certificate of your master’s degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records. You need to have completed your master’s degree prior to the starting date for the position. If you have not completed your degree when applying for the position, please attach a transcript of records of the courses and grades that you have completed so far.
  • Certificate of your bachelor’s degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records.
  • Other relevant certificates or transcripts (e.g. courses completed at the PhD level).
  • If the issuing authority of grades and degrees does not use the ECTS grading scale, include an official description of the grading scale used.
  • Statement of purpose describing your motivation for applying for this position (250-300 words).
  • A research proposal (2000-4000 words). The research proposal should describe the aims, research questions, and motivation of the proposed research. Please note that your research proposal is tentative and often needs adjustments after your acceptance into the programme. 
  • Curriculum vitae.
  • A list of all publications and/or other documented research activities.   

Please upload the documents in separate files, not combined in one single file.

Letters of recommendation and contact details of references:

Letters of recommendation and/or contact details of references may strengthen your application, but they are not mandatory. If you choose to include letters of recommendations, the references should send their letter of recommendation in PDF format to hr-phd@nhh.no by latest 15 January 2027. Contact details of references may be included in Jobbnorge when you apply. 

General information

For more information on the PhD programme and the submission procedure, please consult the NHH PhD website. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Please note that applicants for the PhD research scholar position do not need to apply separately for admission to the PhD programme.

NHH emphasises diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of gender, age, disability and cultural background.

In accordance with §25 (2) of the Freedom of Information Act, information about applicants may be made public even if they have requested not to have their names entered on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request is not granted.

As part of the recruitment process, a background check may be conducted with the candidates' consent.

For questions and inquiries about the NHH PhD programme, please contact phd@nhh.no.

Applications must be submitted through the Jobbnorge online portal. To open the application, please click ‘Apply for this job’. For the English version, go to the menu at the top right side.

Application deadline: 15 January 2027
