jobs.title: Researcher in Quaternary Geology and Paleoclimate
jobs.description:
About the position

Starting date as soon as possible. The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period 6 months.

Place of work is Department of Geosciences, Section for Meteorology and Oceanography at Blindern, Oslo Norway.

The position is associated with the NORCLI (Nordic Climate History) project.

NORCLI is an interdisciplinary project led by Prof. Dominik Collet at the Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History and co-lead by Professor Kirstin Krüger at the Department of Geosciences, Section for Meteorology and Oceanography, at the University of Oslo. It is financed by the University of Oslo Thematic Research Group.

NORCLI is investigating Nordic Climate History: What happened the last time Nordic societies encountered rapid climate change? How did natural and social environments interact during the Little Ice Age (1300-1900), also in response to major volcanic events (i.e., 1690s, 1783-1783 Laki)? What can be learned from the ways people adapted to challenges that are in many ways similar to the ones we face today? The Nordic Climate History (NORCLI) research renders these fundamental questions researchable, using a novel 'socionatural' approach that integrates climatology and history and connects them to museology. NORCLI is working in three steps: (1) reconnecting available data from both the archives of nature (lake sediments, tree-rings, ice cores), climate physics (climate model data) and of society (historical records, material culture) with a focus on extreme events initiated by abrupt climate change in the last two millennia; (2) integrating interactions ‘from agriculture to culture’ bringing natural scientists and historians together; and (3) narrating results to a wider museum and societal audience.

The Quaternary Geology and Paleoclimate Researcher is expected to contribute to the working steps (1) and (2). The researcher shall be an experienced independent scientist within quaternary geology and paleoclimate specialized on varved lake sediments and their analyses in the Nordic countries. In addition, expertise on floods, hydroclimate variations, and natural hazards in particular in Norway during the Holocene are expected as well. As the candidate will be working closely with the other NORCLI positions on history, ice cores, tree rings, and climate modelling, we are seeking for a team player with an interdisciplinary background. Previous documented experience with the analyses of varved lake sediments in Norway next to other paleo climate proxies, and the historical archives on climate is required.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition of being a leading research faculty. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Paleo Climate. 
  • Background in Quaternary geology, paleoclimate and hydroclimate variations during the past 2000 years and Holocene in Norway and other Nordic countries.
  • Experience in analyzing varved lake sediments in Norway including field, lab and data work.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and Norwegian.

Desired qualifications:

  • The potential to integrate and develop interdisciplinary approaches and to work in multi-disciplinary teams.

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer / We can offer you / Why should you choose us?
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK 650 000 - 850 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records 
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability. The Department is also connected to other research centers.The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.description: We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!We are now looking for a PhD in Environmental Science with focus on chemical characterization of effluent organic matter.Your work assignmentsYou will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system (http://www.biogasresearchcenter.se). It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency. This position is announced as part of the research area "Substrates,  Processes, and Products" within BSRC.Processing of biomass residues for material and energy recovery generate effluents containing complex organic mixtures. The main purpose of the PhD project is to investigate molecular complexity of effluent organic matter from sources such as agricultural, municipal and industrial activities and to assess their characterization and transformation where these materials are processed, with emphasis on anaerobic bioprocessing technologies. Current understanding of the dynamics of effluent organic matter mainly refers to change of bulk properties. The proposed research aims to advance this science to knowledge of transformation processes at the molecular level using advanced analyses like nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and high-resolution mass spectrometry (MS). This knowledge will enable defining strategies to promote the utilization of effluent organic matter as potential valuable products.Understanding the molecular complexity of effluent organic matter has a particular relevance due to the significance of these material streams as biofertilizers and sustainable sources of nitrogen, phosphorus, and carbon. The PhD project intends to assess utilization of effluent organic matter as biofertilizers for enhancing the soil health and carbon stock, promoting circular bioeconomy principles for sustainable food production.As a PhD student you will be expected to conduct independent research in line with the research focus. The work assignments particularly relate to the focus area on interplay between physicochemical and microbiological parameters with dynamics of organic matter in anaerobic bioprocesses. Also, it includes the management and feeding of biogas reactors with the focus of production of specific organic molecules of interest. This includes responsibility for research that involves planning, sampling, reactor maintenance, overall laboratory work connected to biogas processes, data processing and writing scientific articles.As a doctoral student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research project of which you are a part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20% of full-time.Your qualificationsRelevant subjects for eligibility include, for example, analytical chemistry, environmental chemistry, chemical biology, chemical engineering, or an equivalent field. You have graduated at Master´s level or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be on advanced level. Alternatively, you have gained corresponding knowledge in another way. Special qualifications: 90 credits of your total credits should be in a subject of central importance to the research area.Documented practical experience and theoretical knowledge in advanced chemistry, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, and the planning and execution of laboratory studies are particularly merited. Documented practical experience and theoretical knowledge in the operation and monitoring of bioreactors are merited.Great importance will be placed on personal qualities and suitability. You are independent, responsible, and meticulous, with the ability to structure and drive your work forward. You have a strong focus on quality, pay close attention to detail, and regard accurate laboratory documentation as an important part of your work. We also expect you to have the willingness and ability to learn new techniques and concepts, particularly in chemistry, and to apply them in an interdisciplinary research environment. You have good collaboration skills and contribute to a supportive and open working environment. You readily share knowledge and information and enjoy collaborating with others on joint projects. You are attentive and respectful in your interactions with others and communicate clearly and naturally, both individually and in groups.Your workplaceEnvironmental Change carries out research and education on the interaction between environment and society in an analytically innovative way. Third cycle and first cycle studies specialising in environmental science are carried out at the department.The employmentWhen taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies. More information about the doctoral studies at each faculty is available at https://liu.se/en/research/doctoral-studiesThe employment has a duration of four years’ full-time equivalent. You will initially be employed for a period of one year. The employment will subsequently be renewed for periods of maximum duration two years, depending on your progress through the study plan. Starting date by agreement.Salary and employment benefitsThe salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression. The initial salary from October 1st 2026 is 33700 SEK/month. The salary progression is renegotiated once every year.Application procedureApply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than January 31st, 2027.Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

Er du serviceinnstilt, strukturert og trives med en variert arbeidshverdag?

Vi søker en engasjert og fleksibel medarbeider til en kombinert stilling som Kursvert / Meeting & Events Coordinator ved våre hoteller på Oslo Lufthavn Gardermoen.

Med et stort konferanse- og møteområde håndterer vi daglig alt fra mindre møter til store konferanser og arrangementer. Vi er opptatt av å skape gode gjesteopplevelser gjennom profesjonell service, effektiv planlegging og godt samarbeid.

Dette er en spennende kombinasjonsstilling hvor du primært vil arbeide operativt som kursvert, samtidig som du får opplæring og ansvar innen koordinering og administrasjon av møter og arrangementer.

Ved ferie, sykdom og annet fravær i koordinatorteamet vil du kunne tre inn som M&E Coordinator og bidra til å sikre kontinuitet i kundeoppfølging og planlegging.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

Som kursvert – din hovedoppgave:

  • Være hotellets ansikt utad og sørge for at våre konferansegjester får en profesjonell og positiv opplevelse.
  • Klargjøre og kontrollere møterom, konferanseområder og pausebuffeter i henhold til bestillinger og standarder.
  • Følge opp gjester og arrangører gjennom dagen og være tilgjengelig for spørsmål og praktisk bistand.
  • Sørge for etterfylling av mat, drikke og nødvendig utstyr.
  • Håndtere endringer, omrigging og uforutsette situasjoner på en effektiv og løsningsorientert måte.
  • Samarbeide tett med kjøkken, restaurant, teknisk avdeling, resepsjon og øvrige avdelinger.
  • Bidra til orden, kvalitet og effektiv drift av konferanseområdet.

Som M&E Coordinator – ved behov og fravær:

  • Følge opp kunder og arrangører via e-post, telefon og møter.
  • Planlegge og koordinere møter, konferanser og arrangementer.
  • Sikre at bestillinger, deltakerantall, møteromsoppsett, tekniske behov og serveringer er korrekt registrert.
  • Oppdatere arrangementer og relevant informasjon i hotellets bookingsystem.
  • Sikre god informasjonsflyt mellom kunden og hotellets operative avdelinger.
  • Håndtere endringer og tilleggsbestillinger.
  • Bidra til mersalg og gode kundeopplevelser.
  • Kontrollere fakturagrunnlag og følge opp kunder etter gjennomførte arrangementer.

Hva kan vi tilby?

  • En variert og spennende arbeidshverdag i et stort og aktivt konferansemiljø.
  • En kombinasjon av operativ gjesteservice og administrativt koordineringsarbeid.
  • Mulighet til å utvikle kompetanse innen Meetings & Events.
  • Opplæring i hotellets systemer, rutiner og standarder.
  • Et internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer.
  • Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling innen Radisson Hotel Group.
  • Et arbeidsmiljø hvor samarbeid, fleksibilitet og gode gjesteopplevelser står sentralt.

 

En stilling med variasjon og utviklingsmuligheter

 

Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å være der det skjer, og som samtidig ønsker å utvikle deg innen planlegging og koordinering.

Hoveddelen av arbeidshverdagen vil være knyttet til den operative gjennomføringen av møter og konferanser. Ved behov vil du også få muligheten til å arbeide med den administrative delen av arrangementene.

Du vil derfor få en bred forståelse av hele kundereisen – fra planlegging til gjennomføring og oppfølging.

 

Arbeidssted: Radisson RED Oslo Airport & Radisson Hotel & Conference Centre Oslo Airport, Gardermoen

 

 

Stillingsprosent: 100 %

 

 

Søknadsfrist: Snarest – søknader vurderes fortløpende.

 

 

Tiltredelse: Etter avtale.

 

 

Arbeidstid: Etter gjeldende arbeidsplan og hotellets behov.

 

Ønsker du å bli en del av vårt Meetings & Events-team? Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg! 

Qualifications

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som liker å være tett på gjestene, men som også trives med administrative oppgaver og planlegging.

Du er en person som tar ansvar, ser løsninger og klarer å bevare oversikten selv når det skjer mye samtidig.

Vi ønsker at du:

  • Har erfaring fra hotell, konferanse, restaurant, kundeservice eller tilsvarende.
  • Er serviceinnstilt og har et genuint ønske om å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.
  • Arbeider strukturert, selvstendig og nøyaktig.
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Er komfortabel med bruk av PC og digitale arbeidsverktøy.
  • Er fleksibel og trives med både praktiske og administrative arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Er løsningsorientert og håndterer endringer på en profesjonell måte.

Erfaring fra kurs- og konferansevirksomhet, arrangementsplanlegging eller bookingsystemer som EMMA er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt.

Additional Information

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development—helping you reach your full potential.Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwideGuaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & FamilyExclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and moreJoin us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. jobs.title: Er du vår nye løsningsorienterte og positive Driftsmedarbeider?
jobs.description:
Handelsstedet Bærums Verk er en unik handels-, kunst-, og opplevelsesdestinasjon med industrihistorie tilbake til 1600-tallet. Bærums Verk har også et moderne nærsenter med butikker og spisesteder som treffer mange.

Vi søker nå en praktisk anlagt driftsmedarbeider med god fysisk form som vil bidra til å drifte og vedlikeholde Bærums Verk, og sørge for at området er trivelig og attraktivt for både besøkende og leietakere.Vi håper du motiveres av varierte arbeidshverdager med stor grad av selvstendighet og et positivt engasjement. Du vil bli et viktig tilskudd til vårt driftsteam.

Driftsteamet sørger for at eiendommene er godt vedlikeholdt, fungerer som de skal og er attraktive for leietakerne, besøkende og ansatte. Stillingen innebærer praktiske driftsoppgaver og vedlikehold av bygningsmassen og de velstelte uteområdene.  Bygningsmassen spenner fra vernede og fredede bebyggelser til moderne bygningsteknisk infrastruktur. Du vil også delta aktivt i planlegging og gjennomføring av større og mindre arrangementer som bidrar til å gjøre Bærums Verk til et levende og inkluderende besøkssted. For å sikre høy kvalitet og service, tenker vi det er fordel om du har erfaring fra en lignende driftsstilling innen eiendom, kjøpesenter eller besøksdestinasjon. Stillingen rapporterer til driftsleder, og samarbeider tett med øvrige ansatte, leietakere og eksterne leverandører.

 

Stilling: Driftsmedarbeider, 100 % stilling Arbeidsgiver: Bærums Verk Drift As / Handelsstedet Bærums Verk Sted: Bærums Verk

 

Ansvarsområder:

Drift og vedlikehold

  • Utfører daglige driftsoppgaver og vedlikehold av bygninger, tekniske installasjoner og uteområder.
  • Gjennomføre forebyggende vedlikehold og mindre reparasjoner.
  • Følge opp feil og avvik samt bidra til rask utbedring av disse.
  • Delta i sesongrelaterte oppgaver som snørydding, strøing, våropprydding og grønt vedlikehold.

Uteområder

  • Sørge for at uteområder, gangveier, parkeringsplasser og fellesområder er trygge, ryddige og presentable.
  • Bidra til vedlikehold av grøntområder og annen utendørs infrastruktur.

Tilsyn med eiendommer og tekniske anlegg

  • Bistå med regelmessig tilsyn med bygninger, tekniske anlegg og utstyr.
  • Kontrollere lys, varme, ventilasjon, sanitæranlegg og øvrige tekniske installasjoner.
  • Melde fra om behov for større vedlikeholds- eller rehabiliteringstiltak.

HMS og sikkerhet

  • Medvirke til at HMS-rutiner følges.
  • Bidra til brannvernarbeid og kontroll av sikkerhetsutstyr.

jobs.title: GLA’ GUTT og humørspreiar søkjer gode, trygge assistentar - helsefagarbeiderstilling
jobs.description:
Jeg er en gutt på 6 år som bor sammen med mamma og min storebror. Jeg har flere diagnoser, men det som du bør vite spesielt om er epilepsien min. Jeg er multisyk og lungesyk/hjertesyk. Jeg kan bevege meg, men trenger assistanse til alt av forflytning og personlig hygiene. Medisinske apparatet som vi sammen må bli venner med er bi-pap (pustemaskin) og forstøver som er i daglig bruk. Trenger bistand til forflytning og mobilisering, stimulering, og noen flere bestevenner på laget. Jeg har også CVK, PEG, og er på matpumpe hele døgnet.

Pusten min kan skremme oss, og noen ganger snur tilværelsen svært fort og du som skal bli min venn: må ha tæl til og stå i dette sammen med meg! ALT dette får du opplæring til!

Jeg elsker alt i fra å sitte på fanget og få kos, til å ligge på gulvet og leke. Her kan jeg leke med heisekranen og klosser. Selv om jeg har en fysisk funksjonsnedsettelse skjønner jeg alt det som foregår rundt meg og jeg klarer å kommunisere det jeg ønsker - mye med tegn til tale.

Livet mitt kan snu på sekunder, slik at det er viktig at du kan tørre å stå sammen med meg uansett hvor jeg er. Sykehuset er i perioder mitt andre hjem.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver blir

  • overvåke meg på natt og endre stilling
  • leke med meg på dagtid
  • utføre personlig hygiene
  • være avlaster for mamma
  • lage sondemat
  • ellers være der jeg er og sikre at jeg er trygg

Du må være

  • Fleksibel
  • glad i å være med barn
  • tålmodig
  • ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • ha førerkort
  • ha plettfri vandel

Hva kan Prima Assistanse tilby:

  • Egen kontaktperson i Prima Assistanse
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du kan gjøre en forskjell
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver hvor ingen dag er helt lik
  • Ansattfordeler
  • Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse
  • Lønn og andre vilkår ihht. helsefagarbeider.

Erfaring med PEG, CVK og metningsmåler er en fordel, men ikke noe krav. Du vil få opplæring i det du trenger, men du må være tøff nok til å tørre dette.

God kjemi mellom deg og meg er alfa omega for at vårt samarbeid skal fungere godt.

Jeg har nå ulike ledige stillingsstørrelser (30-60%) knyttet til helsefagarbeider.

Du må fremvise kompetansebevis.

Arbeidstiden blir i hovedsak natt.

Mamma vil være arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse arbeidsgiver.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

  • Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment.

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Selvstændig og serviceminded centerleder til LOOP center i Hedehusene
jobs.description:
Vi søger en daglig leder på ca. 20 timer ugentligt til LOOP Fitness i Hedehusene

Stillingen er for dig som motiveres af at yde god service og skabe gode oplevelser for medlemmerne, og som vil sætte en ære i at være med til at udvikle centeret med tiltag og medlemstilgang. 

Det vil være dit ansvar, at både eksisterende og potentielle medlemmerne oplever et højt niveau af service, nærvær og professionalisme i forbindelse med deres træning og deres kontakt med centret.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Afholde prøvetimer og vejlede medlemmer i deres træning

  • Yde god service i kontakten med medlemmer og potentielle medlemmer i centret eller via mail, telefon eller Facebook

  • Branding af centret via Facebook samt planlægning og afholdelse af aktiviteter målrettet både eksisterende og nye medlemmer

  • Sørge for at centret fremstår pænt, rent og ryddeligt til enhver tid

  • Holde møder og planlægge markedsføring i samråd driftschefen.

Vi forventer ikke nødvendigvis, at du har erfaring fra branchen. Vi skal nok sørge for at klæde dig på til jobbet. Hvis du ikke allerede har en fitnessinstruktøruddannelse, forventes du at gennemføre en sådan i forbindelse med din opstart i jobbet.

Stillingen kræver, at du agerer selvstændigt, har en vis modenhed og er bevidst om dit ansvar som centrets primære ansigt udadtil. I LOOP Fitness skal mennesker af alle aldre, typer og motivationer kunne få en god oplevelse med deres træning og føle sig velkomne og godt tilpas.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra jobs, hvor salg og god service er i højsædet – og at du kan lide og er god til den del af jobbet. Samtidig er det en en fordel at du har kendskab til personaleledelse, men ikke en forudsætning. Du skal have flair for IT, da du skal kunne håndtere administration af medlemskaber og booking af tider i vores IT-system.

Hvis du har tilknytning til og/eller har et netværk i lokalområdet - enten via dit tidligere eller nuværende job, eller som ildsjæl i foreningslivet vil det også være en fordel.

Til gengæld for alt det, du kommer med, kan vi tilbyde dig et job i en spændende og anderledes fitnesskæde i vækst. Du vil få en høj grad af frihed til at sætte dit præg på centret og centrets aktiviteter inden for de rammer, som LOOP konceptet tilbyder.

LOOP-medlemmer er livsglade og loyale, og det giver en herlig atmosfære i centret og masser af sjove og spændende udfordringer. Stillingen er på deltid med et forventet timeantal på +/-20 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Er ovenstående profil bare lige dig, så send din ansøgning til christian@dreams.nu

Har du spørgsmål, eller vil du vide mere om jobbet og LOOP Fitness er du velkommen til at sende en mail på christian@dreams.nu

LOOP er et unikt træningskoncept, der sikrer en velafbalanceret træning af hele kroppen på kun 24 minutter– både fysik og kondition. Træningen bygger på de anerkendte principper i cirkeltræning og giver gode resultater i en gennemtænkt kombination og variation af udvalgte øvelser på nøje udvalgte fitnessmaskiner

jobs.title: Ingénieur Data & IA – DevOps / MLOps (H/F)
jobs.description:

Nous recherchons pour notre client, acteur national spécialisé dans les services : un Ingénieur Data & IA – DevOps / MLOps (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI.

Dans un contexte de transformation complète de sa DSI, notre client construit une nouvelle plateforme Data & IA, développe une IA Factory et modernise son système d'information.

Vous rejoignez une équipe technique en cours de structuration, aux côtés d'un Tech Lead Architecte, d'un Product Owner Data et d'un Product Owner Applicatif.

Votre enjeu : industrialiser, fiabiliser et exploiter cette nouvelle plateforme pour accompagner la transformation technologique de l'entreprise.

Démarrage souhaité : au plus tard au premier trimestre 2027.

VOS MISSIONS :

-Exploiter et fiabiliser la plateforme Cloud Data & IA hébergée sur Scaleway, en garantissant sa disponibilité, ses performances et sa sécurité.

-Industrialiser l'IA Factory en mettant en place les pipelines CI/CD, les environnements automatisés et les processus de déploiement des applications.

-Déployer et superviser les services IA en production : LLM, RAG, bases vectorielles, avec un suivi des performances, des coûts et de la qualité.

-Automatiser et sécuriser les infrastructures grâce à Terraform, Docker et Kubernetes, tout en développant l'observabilité et les dispositifs de reprise d'activité.

-Accompagner la modernisation du SI en assurant la migration et l'évolution des API, des flux d'intégration et des traitements historiques.

-Participer au décommissionnement des applications legacy et à la migration progressive vers la nouvelle architecture.

-Garantir l'autonomie technique de la DSI en documentant les infrastructures, les procédures d'exploitation et les mécanismes de déploiement.

-Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Tech Lead Architecte, qui définit les orientations techniques, et les Product Owners Data et Applicatif.

Environnement technique :

-Cloud & Infrastructure : Scaleway, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

-DevOps : GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code

-Data & IA : Airflow, LLM, RAG, bases vectorielles, plateformes Data

-Développement & Intégration : API REST, Python / Java / Node.js, architectures événementielles

-Sécurité & Observabilité : IAM, SSO, API Gateway, monitoring, logs et alerting

VOUS :

De formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5 ou parcours équivalent), vous justifiez d'au moins 6 années d'expérience en DevOps, SRE ou ingénierie plateforme, avec une solide expérience de l'exploitation d'infrastructures Cloud en production.

Vous maîtrisez les environnements conteneurisés (Docker, Kubernetes), l'Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), les pipelines CI/CD ainsi que les problématiques d'intégration et de développement d'API.

Une expérience en MLOps, dans l'exploitation de solutions d'IA générative ou sur des plateformes Data modernes constitue un véritable atout.

Une connaissance de Scaleway, OVHcloud ou d'environnements Cloud souverains sera également appréciée.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre capacité à prendre en charge un environnement technique stratégique.

Ce qui rend ce poste intéressant :

-Une création de poste au cœur d'une transformation complète de la DSI.

-Une plateforme Data & IA à industrialiser, avec de véritables enjeux de production.

-Un environnement technique moderne et des projets autour de l'IA générative.

-Un rôle transverse avec une forte autonomie et un impact direct sur les choix d'industrialisation.

-L'opportunité de contribuer à la construction d'un SI moderne, évolutif et maîtrisé en interne.

PROCESS :

Après une première visio avec un membre de notre équipe, vous rencontrerez :

- Un 1er entretien en visio avec RH et DSI

- Un 2nd sur site avec la DSI

Retour sous 48h à l'issue du processus.

Envoyez-nous votre CV et si votre profil correspond, vous serez contacté par un membre de l'équipe dans les 24h.

Au plaisir d'évoquer votre projet,

S-quaar

jobs.title: Cost Engineer, Granlund
jobs.description: **Do you enjoy working with numbers, technical details and cost estimates in large and complex projects? Were looking for a Cost Engineer to join Granlunds growing Cost Management team and work on demanding data center and industrial projects.****_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our 1,800 experts serve clients across Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands, and the UK._**Would you be our new Cost Engineer?**As a Cost Engineer, you work hands-on with cost engineering and estimating throughout different stages of complex projects. Your work includes preparing accurate and well-documented cost estimates, measuring and quantifying works from drawings and models, comparing supplier and subcontractor quotations, and maintaining project cost data. Your role combines detailed cost analysis with a practical understanding of project scope, helping ensure that cost information is accurate, transparent and up to date throughout the project.Your responsibilities also include supporting tendering, procurement and project cost control. You participate in tender evaluations, review contractor and supplier pricing, track costs against budgets and support the management of variations and changes. You also prepare cash flow forecasts and cost reporting material. The role involves close collaboration with the Cost Manager, project management, procurement, design teams and other project stakeholders. Depending on the project, you may also work with cost estimates for MEP, OFCI and CFCI procurement packages.The position is full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. You can work from any Granlund office in Finland or remotely. The role includes occasional travel to project sites and client meetings across Finland.**What are we looking for?**We are looking for a professional with experience in cost engineering, estimating, quantity surveying or commercial management in project-based environments. Your background may come from construction, industrial, energy, data center or other technically demanding projects. You are comfortable working with detailed cost information and understand how drawings, specifications, quantities and project scope translate into costs. You have a relevant educational background, such as industrial engineering or a similar field, and a structured and accurate way of working.Experience with tendering, tender evaluation and procurement is considered an advantage, as is knowledge of MEP systems and their key cost drivers. Familiarity with RICS or AACE methodologies, contractual frameworks such as FIDIC or YSE, or OFCI/CFCI procurement is also beneficial. Strong Excel skills are essential, while experience with BIM-based quantity take-off, ERP systems or Power BI is considered an advantage. You communicate fluently in English, and Finnish is considered a plus.As a person, you are analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable working with numbers and technical information. You work accurately even with tight tender and reporting deadlines and are able to identify inconsistencies, cost trends and potential risks early. You collaborate effectively with different stakeholders and have the confidence to question contractor and supplier pricing when needed.**Why join us?**At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and industrial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.**Interested?**Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 3.12.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator (**elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi**)._Please note that we only process applications submitted through our recruitment system. We are unable to accept applications sent by email._

jobs.title: DGI Storkøbenhavn søger løbekonsulent
jobs.description:
Deltidsstilling med tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027

Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeningerne? Har du en faglighed inden for løb og et stærkt foreningskendskab? Har du erfaringer med funktionel træning og udvikling af træningstilbud? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Storkøbenhavn.

Vi søger en konsulent, som kan arbejde strategisk og er en drivkraft i udviklingen af løbeklubberne i Storkøbenhavn. Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med klubberne om udvikling, aktiviteter og uddannelse af trænere og ledere. Du understøtter dem i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner. 

Udover et tæt makkerskab med atletikkonsulenten og den administrative koordinator vil du indgå i teams med kolleger, som dækker andre idrætter. Generelt søger vi at skabe et godt arbejdsfællesskab med masser af mulighed for sparring og samarbejde.

Det er især vigtigt, at du kan drive og udvikle vores kursus- og uddannelsesområde, så vores tilbud til løbeklubber, frivillige og trænere er relevante og af høj kvalitet. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • kvalificere vores udbud af kurser og uddannelser
  • afdække behov hos foreninger og omsætte dem til relevante tilbud
  • udvikle nye kurser, uddannelser og skræddersyede forløb
  • rekruttere de rette undervisere og samarbejde tæt med dem
  • arbejde med synlighed og øge deltagelsen på vores kurser

Cirka halvdelen af stillingen er varetagelse af vores indsatser i Trackfit, som udrulles nationalt. Trackfit er et træningstilbud til alle, der har lyst til en solid og sjov grundtræning, hvor hele kroppen aktiveres. Konceptet har mange variationsmuligheder og kan målrettes både unge og voksne. Du skal sætte fart på udbredelsen af Trackfit i både atletik- og løbeklubber. 

Din profil:

  • Faglig viden om Løb og gerne også funktionel træning
  • Et skarpt blik for både udvikling og udbredelse af kurser og uddannelser
  • Erfaring som konsulent eller projektleder; du ved, hvordan man skaber fremdrift og resultater
  • Erfaring med foreningsudvikling og gerne kendskab til løbeklubberne i Storkøbenhavn
  • En udadvendt og opsøgende tilgang; du trives med at skabe relationer og netværk
  • Kompetent bruger af administrative systemer

Læs mere om DGI Løb & Gang samt Trackfit og DGI Atletik 

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 25 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse d. 1. februar 2027

Aften-/weekendarbejde kan forekomme.

DGI Storkøbenhavn

Som idrætsforeningernes udviklingshus arbejder vi for at understøtte og udvikle idrætsforeningerne i en by i konstant forandring. Vi dækker 11 kommuner og repræsenterer over 650 idrætsforeninger, der har mere end 300.000 medlemmer. Vi tilbyder et godt arbejdsmiljø med ca. 50 passionerede medarbejdere. Kontoret ligger i moderne lokaler centralt i København på Vesterbrogade. AnsøgningSpørgsmål vedrørende stillingen kan rettes til idrætschef Bettina Güleryüz på bdg@dgi.dk, tlf. 28 30 50 51

jobs.title: HR-Verantwortliche/-r 100% (Dillhaus/Bauma)
jobs.description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden FBB Unternehmen suchen wir eine:n HR-Verantwortliche/-r 100% (Dillhaus/Bauma)

Die FBB-Gruppe ist ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit einer bald 100-jährigen Geschichte. An mehreren Standorten in der Deutschschweiz beschäftigen wir rund 200 Mitarbeitende. Wir gewinnen Kies, produzieren Beton, Strassenbeläge und Kalksandsteine und bieten Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Aushub, Abbruch, Transport, Recycling und Entsorgung an.

Infolge einer Nachfolgeregelung suchen wir eine engagierte, belastbare und zuverläs­sige Persönlichkeit mit Organisationstalent.

Deine Aufgaben

Lohn- und Sozialversicherungswesen

  • Du verantwortest die monatliche Lohnverarbeitung von der Erfassung der Mutationen bis zur Vorbereitung der Lohnauszahlung.
  • Du erledigst die Abrechnungen und Meldungen an Sozialversicherungen und Pensionskasse sowie die Quellensteuerabrechnungen.
  • Du führst die Jahresabschlussarbeiten im Lohnbereich durch.

Personaladministration und -betreuung

  • Du betreust die gesamte Personaladministration vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt und erstellst Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen und Arbeitszeugnisse.
  • Du unterstützt die Vorgesetzten bei der Rekrutierung und koordinierst den Bewerbungsprozess.
  • Du bearbeitest und überwachst Unfall- und Krankheitsmeldungen.
  • Du pflegst die Personalstammdaten und digitalen Personaldossiers.
  • Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Vorgesetzte bei Personal- und Lohnfragen.

HR-Prozesse und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du entwickelst unsere HR-Prozesse weiter und wirkst bei deren Optimierung und Digitalisierung mit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung als HR-Fachfrau/-mann mit eidg. Fachausweis oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Personaladministration und der Schweizer Lohnverarbeitung
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Mass an Diskretion
  • Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, Kommunikationsstärke und eine dienstleistungsorientierte Haltung
  • Bodenständigkeit, Eigeninitiative und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität

Das erwartet dich

  • Bei uns übernimmst du die Verantwortung für einen vielseitigen HR-Bereich mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Kontakt zu den Vorgesetzten unserer Geschäftsbereiche. jobs.title: Er du pædagogen, der tør sætte farten ned for at skabe udvikling?
jobs.description:
Hos Løvehjerte leder vi ikke efter en pædagog, der kan løbe hurtigere. Vi leder efter en pædagog, der ved, hvornår man skal gå langsomt. ❤️

De seneste år har mange talt om mere læring, flere indsatser og højere tempo. Vi tror på noget andet.

Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst, når de mødes af nærværende voksne, stærke relationer og legeparate læringsmiljøer. Vi tror på, at kvalitet opstår, når faglighed og hjerte går hånd i hånd. Og vi tror på, at børn gør det bedste, de kan.

En af vores pædagoger har fået andet arbejde tættere på hendes hjem og vi søger derfor nu en pædagog på 37 timer til børnehaven i Daginstitutionen Løvehjerte.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en daginstitution normeret til 37 børnehavebørn og 15 vuggestuebørn fra januar 2027.

Vi er et dagtilbud med ambitioner. Ikke ambitioner om flere projekter eller flere skemaer. Men ambitioner om at skabe de bedste betingelser for børns trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskaber.

Hos os arbejder vi med:

Langsom pædagogik, fordi gode relationer tager tid

NEST, fordi fællesskaber skal kunne rumme forskellighed

❤️ ICDP, fordi stærke relationer er fundamentet for al udvikling

Legeparate læringsmiljøer, der inviterer børn ind i leg, nysgerrighed og fordybelse

Stærke fællesskaber, fordi ingen børn skal stå alene

 

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi leder ikke efter den perfekte pædagog.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • ser bag barnets adfærd og er nysgerrig på, hvad barnet forsøger at fortælle
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt i mindre grupper
  • kan skabe ro, struktur og tryghed i en travl hverdag
  • tør være fagligt undersøgende og reflekterende
  • har mod til både at give og modtage sparring

Og så håber vi, at du har lyst til at være en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udfordrer hinanden og lykkes sammen.

 

Børnene ønsker sig en voksen der:

  • Er sød, fjollet og vil grine sammen
  • finder på lege og gider lege med
  • hjælper og trøster
  • vil danse, spise og cykle sammen

 

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får mulighed for at blive en del af en arbejdsplads:

  • hvor faglighed betyder noget og hvor der er mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • hvor vi arbejder målrettet med kvalitet i kerneopgaven
  • hvor du får indflydelse på læringsmiljøer og pædagogisk praksis
  • hvor vi tror på, at medarbejdere udvikler sig bedst i fællesskab

Kort sagt...

Hvis du bliver optaget af at skabe trygge relationer.

Hvis du tror på, at børn har brug for voksne, der kan låne dem ro.

Hvis du mener, at pædagogisk kvalitet starter med nærvær.

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er 37 timer pr. uge med tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027

Ansøgningsfrist: 06.12.26

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december efter kl. 13.00.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst mellem BUPL og KL.

Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest samt reference inden ansættelse.

Vil du vide mere?

Kontakt pædagogisk leder Mette Marie Pallesen på 25 20 02 91.

Du kan også læse mere om Løvehjerte på: https://daginstitutionenloevehjerte.aula.dk

Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på mulighederHos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

jobs.title: Cost Manager, Granlund
jobs.description: **Do you enjoy keeping large projects on track through clear cost control, structured thinking, and close collaboration with different stakeholders? Were looking for a Cost Manager to join Granlunds growing Cost Management team and work on demanding data center and industrial projects.****_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our 1,800 experts serve clients across Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands, and the UK._**Would you be our new Cost Manager?**As a Cost Manager, you help keep large and complex projects financially on track from early planning through execution and completion. You take ownership of cost planning, contingencies, budgeting and forecasting, monitor project performance and actively steer costs toward agreed targets. You may lead a team of cost professionals depending on large scale projects and are responsible for approving budget changes and change orders. Your work includes preparing and reviewing cost estimates, cash flow forecasts and cost reports, identifying deviations and understanding their financial impact. You also manage costs for MEP, OFCI and CFCI packages, depending on the project scope.Your responsibilities also cover procurement and contract-related cost management, such as reviewing contractor and supplier pricing, supporting tender evaluations, validating payment milestones and assessing variations and change requests. Working closely with project management, procurement, design teams, client and other commercial stakeholders, you ensure that cost, schedule and execution remain aligned. You communicate the project's cost position clearly, challenge assumptions when necessary and support decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.The position is full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. You can work from any Granlund office in Finland or remotely. The role includes occasional travel to project sites and client meetings across Finland.**What are we looking for?**We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in cost management, quantity surveying, project controls, or similar commercial responsibilities in project-based environments. Your background may come from construction, industrial, energy, data center, or other technically demanding projects, and experience with MEP-intensive projects is considered an advantage. You are comfortable taking ownership of cost management in complex projects and understand how costs, schedules, procurement, and project execution are connected. You have a relevant educational background, such as industrial engineering and management, quantity surveying or a similar field, and a structured way of working that you can apply in demanding project environments.Experience with cost management frameworks or standards such as RICS or AACE is considered an advantage, as is familiarity with contractual frameworks such as FIDIC or YSE and OFCI/CFCI procurement. Most importantly, you understand core cost control principles and how to apply them in complex project environments. Strong Excel skills are essential, while experience with ERP systems, cost estimating tools or Power BI is considered an advantage. You communicate fluently in English, and Finnish is considered a plus.As a person, you are analytical and able to see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers behind cost deviations. You collaborate effectively with different stakeholders and build trust, while also being confident enough to challenge when needed. You have good judgment in project situations and can balance cost and schedule considerations to support successful outcomes.**Why join us?**At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and industrial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.**Interested?**Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 3.12.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator (**elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi**)._Please note that we only process applications submitted through our recruitment system. We are unable to accept applications sent by email._

jobs.title: Demenskonsulent til Demensafdelingen i Syddjurs Kommune
jobs.description:
Syddjurs kommune søger demenskonsulent med uddannelse som sygeplejerske pr. 1. februar 2027.

Byrådet har bevilget en nyoprettet stilling på 37 timer som demenskonsulent, og vi søger derfor en kollega. Så hvis du har viden om demens og lyst til at sætte den i spil i Syddjurs Kommune, så vil vi glæde os til at læse din ansøgning til nedenstående stilling. 

Som demenskonsulent vil dine ansvarsområder være:
  • Rådgivning, støtte og vejledning af borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Koordinering af borgerforløb på tværs af sektorer og faggrupper.
  • Faglig sparring til kolleger internt og eksternt.
  • Samarbejde med kolleger i borgerteams, på plejehjem og bosteder samt med praktiserende læger, sygehuse m.fl.
  • Formidling af viden om demens.
Vi forestiller os, at du
  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske.
  • Har stor interesse for at arbejde med mennesker med demens og deres pårørende i alle sygdommens faser.
  • Evner at kombinere høj faglighed og professionalisme med humor, nysgerrighed og ydmyghed.
  • Har lyst til at indgå i et stærkt team, hvor faglig udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab vægtes højt.
  • Kan planlægge og arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Møder både borgere, pårørende og kolleger med nysgerrighed og anerkendelse.
  • Mestrer relationel koordinering i samarbejdet med både interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere på demensområdet.
  • Reflekterer over egen og andres praksis og bidrager aktivt til fælles læring og faglig udvikling.
  • Er en god kommunikator, der formulerer sig klart og præcist både mundtligt og skriftligt.
  • Trives med den svære samtale og har en konfliktnedtrappende tilgang.
  • Kan facilitere refleksion og læring blandt din kolleger og samarbejdspartnere. 
Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af et velfungerende demensteam på i forvejen 3 demenskonsulenter, hvor høj faglighed går hånd i hånd med nærvær, humor og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder en selvstændig stilling med stor indflydelse på egen opgaveløsning og gode muligheder for at bidrage til udviklingen af demensområdet. Samtidig får du tætte samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af kommunen og mulighed for at gøre en mærkbar forskel for mennesker med demens og deres pårørende hver eneste dag.

Vi tager udgangspunkt i Sundhedsstyrelsens anbefalinger, faglige retningslinjer og redskaber på demensområdet og udvikler løbende vores demensfaglighed på grundlag af nyeste viden på området.

Det formelle

Kørekort er en forudsætning

Der indhentes straffeattest ved tilbud om ansættelse. 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Vil du vide mere?

Yderligere oplysninger fås ved henvendelse til leder af demensafdelingen Birthe Moe på tlf. 24 86 53 74.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 8. december 2026
