Er dette noget for dig, så skriv en ansøgning med oplysning om personlige data.

 

Syddjurs Kommune opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, handicap m.v.

Syddjurs Kommune anvender digital rekruttering, se ledige stillinger på www.syddjurs.dk/job

Vi er den største arbejdsplads i Syddjurs med cirka 3.200 medarbejdere. Medarbejdere der hver dag går på arbejde for at hjælpe og understøtte kommunens borgere. Gennem dialog med virksomheder, brugere og borgere sikrer vi fælles ansvar for Kommunens udvikling. 

Vi har et Samarbejdsgrundlag der bygger på fem bærende principper; Samtaler, Fællesskab, Handlekraft, Ansvar og Udvikling. Se glimt af vores samarbejde på tværs af vores arbejdspladser her 

Du kan læse mere om vores samarbejdsgrundlag via følgende link Samarbejdsgrundlag.  

Syddjurs Kommune har omkring 44.000 indbyggere, fem hovedbyer og et stort opland med mange landsbyer. Vi er en Kommune i udvikling og hvert år vælger mange familier at flytte hertil. Vores styrker er de aktive borgere, de mange bysamfund, en enestående natur og nærheden til storbyen Aarhus. Vi er en aktiv del af udviklingen i den midtjyske region, herunder Business Region Aarhus, som er et fællesskab mellem de 12 østjyske Kommuner på tilsammen en million østjyder, en halv million arbejdspladser og landets største vækstområde uden for hovedstadsområdet.

jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: sandra.amundsen@randstad.noMobil: 980 31 23 

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Vi intervjuer fortløpende. 

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Lastenhoitaja tueksi lapsiperheelle Porvooseen
jobs.description: Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien lapsiperheiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten sote-alan opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai sote-alan koulutuksen omaava konkari, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme, isäämme, ystäväämme tai lastamme.Mikä on helpperi?Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle avustettavalle henkilölle, kuten lapselle. Helpperi tukee asiakasta kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, päivittäisissä toimissa, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain seurana ollessa ja huolehtien. Ajan myötä helpperistä, asiakkaasta ja hänen perheestään voi tulla läheisiä keskenään.Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.Etsimme tiimiimme sote-alan koulutettuja hoitajia auttamaan lapsiperheitäAsiakkaisiimme kuuluu niin lapsia kuin lapsiperheitä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan lapsiperheitä heidän hektisessä ja kiireisessä elämäntilanteessa tarjoamalla arvokasta aikaasi lapsiperheen arjen pyörittämiseen. Tehtävät voivat liittyä lapsien kanssa leikkimiseen ja ulkoiluun aina kodinhoidollisiin askareisiin, kuten roskien viemiseen. Välillä käynnit voivat sujua ihan vain yhdessä puuhaillen vaikkapa värityskirjan äärellä.Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Helppereitämme yhdistää halu viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa. Tässä työssä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki olisi parempaa ja helpompaa. Annamme lisäpisteitä, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä!Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat: "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen asiakkaan kanssa." "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."Helpperinä saat:- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan. - Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Investment Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Fundraising Manager to join our European organisation and lead our investment and financing activities across Europe.This is a senior, hands-on role for a professional with proven experience in equity fundraising, investment execution and European capital markets. The successful candidate will combine strong financial and commercial expertise with an established investor network, excellent negotiation skills and the ability to independently manage complex cross-border transactions.The RoleReporting directly to the CEO, you will take ownership of the company's European investment and financing activities, with a particular focus on local equity fundraising, investor engagement, industrial project investment and transaction execution.You will work closely with senior management, headquarters, European investors and external advisers to develop financing opportunities, execute investment transactions and establish a structured investment and financing framework in Europe.Equity Fundraising & Financing    Lead European equity fundraising activities, from investor identification and engagement to negotiation and transaction closing.    Develop and maintain relationships with Nordic and European private equity funds, venture capital firms, industrial investors and other strategic capital partners.    Identify suitable financing opportunities and develop fundraising strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.    Lead the preparation of investor presentations, financing proposals, transaction structures and related documentation.    Negotiate financing terms and coordinate transaction execution within approved financing plans and valuation frameworks.    Work closely with the CEO, headquarters and external advisers to ensure successful financing outcomes.Investment Execution & Project Management    Oversee investment activities relating to European industrial and strategic development projects.    Lead investment evaluations, due diligence, transaction structuring, negotiations and closing processes.    Coordinate financial, legal, commercial and technical assessments with relevant internal and external stakeholders.    Assess investment opportunities, financial implications, commercial feasibility and potential risks.    Support investment decision-making through structured analysis, recommendations and management presentations.    Monitor post-investment performance, identify potential risks and coordinate appropriate risk management measures.Investor Relations & Capital Market Development    Establish and expand the company's network of European financial institutions, investment funds and industrial investors.    Maintain professional relationships with existing and potential investors, financing partners and external advisers.    Monitor European capital-market developments, investment trends and financing opportunities.    Represent the company in discussions and negotiations with European investors, financial institutions and strategic partners.Investment & Financing Management    Establish and continuously improve the company's local investment and financing processes in Europe.    Support the development and implementation of European investment and financing strategies.    Build and coordinate local investment and financing resources, including internal teams and external professional advisers.    Ensure investment and financing activities comply with applicable EU and Swedish regulations and internal governance requirements.    Identify, monitor and escalate material investment, financing and compliance risks to senior management.Your BackgroundWe are looking for someone with:    A bachelor's degree or higher in finance, economics, business administration or a related field.    At least 4 years of experience in primary-market investment and financing, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience in European or Nordic markets.    Proven experience in cross-border equity fundraising, investment transactions and European local investment execution.    A strong understanding of European capital markets, investment practices and financing regulations, including relevant EU and Swedish requirements.    An established professional network among European private equity funds, venture capital firms, industrial investors or other relevant capital providers.    Demonstrated ability to independently manage investment and financing projects, including investor negotiations and transaction execution.    Strong commercial judgement, financial analysis, negotiation and project management skills.    Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.    Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to work effectively in an international business environment.It Would Be an Advantage If You Have    Experience in industrial investments, advanced manufacturing, new energy, lithium-ion batteries or related sectors.    Experience leading equity fundraising or strategic investment transactions involving European or Nordic investors.    Experience establishing local investment and financing functions or coordinating cross-border teams.    Familiarity with European industrial investment projects and international corporate structures.    Experience working with international headquarters, senior executives and multidisciplinary advisory teams.What You Can ExpectYou will join an international industrial organisation where investment and financing activities are directly connected to manufacturing development, strategic expansion and long-term business growth in Europe.The role offers significant responsibility and direct exposure to senior management, European capital markets and cross-border investment projects. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of key financing initiatives, develop investor relationships and contribute directly to the company's European development strategy.We value professionalism, ownership, collaboration and straightforward communication. We believe good decisions come from different perspectives and encourage an open, respectful and inclusive working environment.

jobs.title: Trives du med å jobbe med barn og er på utkikk etter en deltidsjobb? Da kan dette være BPA-stillingen for deg!
jobs.description:
Blid jente på 9 år søker lekne og trygge assistenter til sin BPA-ordning. Jenta sitter i rullestol og har en utviklingshemming som gjør at hun trenger hjelp til alle daglige gjøremål og sosiale aktiviteter. Hun er trygg og trives godt i selskap med andre. Samtidig har hun ingen talespråk, men kommuniserer godt på andre måter. 

Vi søker nå etter nye BPA-assistenter som kan jobbe dagvakter i ferieperioder og helger, samtidig kveldsvakter ellers i året. Det kan også bli aktuelt med enkelte nattevakter.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bistå i lek, aktiviteter og sosialt samvær
  • Delta i hverdagslige gjøremål
  • Stell og personlig omsorg

På nattevakter kan arbeidsoppgaver blant annet bestå av:

  • Tilsyn gjennom natten
  • Gi støtte og trygghet dersom jenta våkner
  • Morgenstell og forberedelser til skoledagen

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker deg som:

  • Trives og kommuniserer godt med barn
  • Er trygg, omsorgsfull og leken
  • Klarer å balansere en profesjonell rolle samtidig som du blir en naturlig del av familiens hverdag
  • Er selvstendig, ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig

Det vil bli gitt grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging, slik at du skal føle deg trygg og godt ivaretatt i rollen som BPA-assistent.

Arbeidstid:

  • Ferietider: 08:00-16:00
  • Helg: 12:00-20:00
  • Hverdager: 15:45-20:30
  • Nattevakt: 22:15-07:25

Du får stor medvirkning i vaktplanleggingen.

Vi kan tilby:

  • Gode arbeids- og lønnsbetingelser
  • God opplæring, veiledning og oppfølgning
  • En spennende og meningsfull jobbhverdag

 

Søkere blir vurdert fortløpende.

Alle aktuelle kandidater må vise til norskkunnskaper tilsvarende B2 og fremlegge gyldig politiattest før tilsettelse.

jobs.title: Juniorlønbogholder med bogholderierfaring
jobs.description:
Jobtype: Fastansættelse

Geografi: København, Danmark

Sprog: Dansk

Er du skarp på lønbehandling fra A til Z, og trives du i en alsidig rolle, hvor du også har fingeren på pulsen i det daglige bogholderi?

På vegne af vores kunde i København søger Work Supply en struktureret, energisk og selvkørende juniorlønbogholder med cirka 2 års praktisk erfaring (ikke praktik). Her får du en nøglerolle i en moderne og uformel økonomifunktion, hvor løn er dit primære ansvarsområde, men hvor dine dage også byder på bredere bogholderiopgaver.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Fuldkørende lønadministration: Du får det selvstændige ansvar for den månedlige lønbehandling fra start til slut – herunder indberetning, refusioner, ferieregnskab og løbende optimering af processerne (kendskab til Intect og SmartTid er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav).

  • Dagligt bogholderi & afstemninger: Du hjælper til i driften med håndtering af kreditorer, debitorer, finansbilag samt løbende bank- og kontoafstemninger.

  • Systemer & digitalisering: Du arbejder aktivt i moderne ERP-systemer og digitale økonomiværktøjer og er med til at sikre smarte, effektive arbejdsgange.

  • Ad hoc & sparring: Du bidrager til diverse administrative opgaver og løbende opfølgning i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger i økonomiteamet.

Hvem er du?

  • Erfaring: Du har omkring 2 års konkret erfaring fra en lignende stilling og er fuldkørende – eller meget tæt på at være fuldkørende – i hele lønprocessen, samtidig med at du har solidt kendskab til almindeligt bogholderi.

  • Drive & initiativ: Du møder ind med god energi, er nysgerrig af natur og tager naturligt ejerskab over dine opgaver.

  • Digital & struktureret: Du har let ved nye IT-systemer, arbejder systematisk og har sans for detaljen, også når der er fart på.

  • Teamplayer: Du sætter pris på et uformelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden i mål og har en god tone i hverdagen.

Hvad tilbyder virksomheden? Du træder ind i en udviklingsorienteret virksomhed med højt til loftet, kort vej fra idé til handling og rig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt. Du får en hverdag med spændende udfordringer, engagerede kolleger og frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på strukturen i dine opgaver.

Søg jobbet allerede i dag

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send dit CV afsted hurtigst muligt til: ak@worksupply.dk

Husk at skrive JOB ID: 2610 i emnefeltet på din ansøgning.

https://worksupply.dk/

jobs.title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

jobs.description: Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalleHaemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Forssassa.Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemistaLisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa.""Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Early-Career ASIC Project Manager, Lund
jobs.description: Do you want to work with advanced ASIC development at the forefront of technology? Join the team responsible for the ARTPEC SoC - at the heart of Axis products - and help coordinate a complex development project with people across many disciplines.This is an opportunity to contribute to a high-impact technology project while developing your project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues. We are looking for an Early-Career ASIC Project Manager to strengthen Axis ASIC development in Lund.What is Axis?Axis is a fast-growing and highly innovative company offering intelligent security solutions. Our network video and surveillance solutions help create a safer and smarter world.Our success comes from our skilled people and our culture of openness, collaboration, and innovation. At Axis, we do more than create products - we shape solutions that deliver value to our customers.Who is your future team?The Axis ASIC Department develops custom ASICs that accelerate essential functions in our surveillance cameras. We design, develop, implement, integrate, and verify hardware modules that help strengthen Axis' technology leadership.Our hardware blocks support functions such as image processing, video compression, radar, audio, and computer vision. We also work closely with external vendors who provide third-party IP cores.The ASIC development team brings together colleagues with a range of experience and expertise. We value an open working environment and collaborative, low-ego teamwork.Learn more about ARTPEC: https://newsroom.axis.com/article/artpec-foundation-qualityWhat you doYou will join the ASIC project leadership team, which coordinates the internal development of an ASIC at Axis. Working with colleagues across the organization and with external partners, you will help keep the project organized and moving forward.Your tasks will include:    Coordinating work across internal and external interfaces, including software, algorithms, electronics, product teams, and partners    Tracking project progress, coordinating priorities, and communicating plans and status.    Planning and following up on deliveries to and from other projects and external partners, such as third-party IP core providers    Helping track and visualize the project budget    Supporting technology intake activities within the ASIC DepartmentYou will build your project leadership skills while developing your understanding of the technical and commercial aspects of ASIC development. An interest in technology and working with external partners is important. Experience in technical or commercial negotiations is a plus.Who are we looking for?You have a technical background and are curious about ASIC development and the technology behind complex products. You enjoy creating structures, connecting people, and helping a team make progress towards a shared goal.You don't need to have held a formal leadership role. You may have developed relevant skills through your studies, a thesis project, an internship, or your first professional role. What matters is your interest in taking responsibility, supporting collaboration, and growing into project leadership.We believe you have:    A master's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related field. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field may also be suitable, depending on your experience and overall profile.    Some knowledge of ASIC development, or a strong interest in learning about technology.    An interest in project planning, coordination, and follow-up.    Clear communication skills and the ability to create shared understanding.    Familiarity with agile ways of working, or an interest in learning them.    Good communication skills in English and Swedish.You bring your own perspective, ask questions, and enjoy working with people across different disciplines. You value collaboration and are motivated to help a team succeed. At Axis, you'll have the opportunity to develop your technical understanding and project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues.What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ LundYour well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:Life at Axis blogEngineering at Axis blogInnovation at AxisReady to Act?Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.Do you want to join us? Apply today! For more information, contact our recruiting ASIC Systems Manager, Tomas Larsson, on +46 46 272 1500.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Lead

Together with colleagues in Axis organizations around the world, L&D plays a central role in driving our learning culture, keeping our global programs, processes and systems running smoothly, and supporting a growth mindset. You'll lead and succeed in your role through your expertise, your influence, and the strong relationships you build with stakeholders around the world.  You will:     Drive, maintain and develop our global L&D framework and initiatives, working closely with L&D teams across Axis     Own the day-to-day improvement of our learning management system (LMS), Workday Learning, drive the development of digital learning tools     Lead L&D projects from start to finish, including the change management that helps new ways of working take hold     Promote and facilitate our global learning initiatives, such as the Axis Mentorship program and learning on demand     Drive initiatives that strengthen our learning culture and work with regional and local L&D teams to put Axis's learning strategy into practice. As a manager, I believe in trust-based relationships where we are partners, and my role is to support you in reaching the goals we set together." - Irina Belenkaya, Group People Attraction and Development Manager  Who are you? You're curious, driven and enjoy working with both people and systems. jobs.title: Product Cost Controller
jobs.description: At TRATON Group, we believe that the whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Together with our brands we can make the future of transportation more sustainable - Let's make a difference together. The TRATON AB office, located in Södertälje, consists of experienced colleagues with various backgrounds and nationalities from all TRATON Group brands. We enjoy solving strategic problems cross functional and cross brand in the TRATON Group. We strive for a climate where opinions and knowledge are openly shared within and between teams and we welcome new ideas in order to create dynamic synergies. With its brands Scania, MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus and International, TRATON Group is one of the world's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. Its offering comprises light-duty commercial vehicles, trucks, and buses. At TRATON, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation. Find out more: www.traton.comRole SummaryAs a Product Cost Controller, you will drive product cost planning, analysis, and optimization to support the profitability of TRATON's products. Working closely with R&D, Controlling, and brand teams across the Group, you will set cost targets, evaluate cost performance, and identify improvement opportunities. The role combines financial analysis, technical understanding, and cross-functional collaboration in an international environment.Job Responsibilities As part of the Group Product Cost Controlling team, you will work cross-functionally with TRATON AB, local R&D entities, and brand Controlling teams. Together, you are responsible for calculating, challenging, and tracking product costs for current and future products. Your responsibilities include:     Deriving top-down product cost targets from a market perspective in early product development phases    Setting clear cost ambitions to secure long-term profitability    Driving and facilitating cross-functional discussions, workshops, and benchmark activities to identify and implement cost-optimizing measures    Performing product cost calculations throughout the entire product lifecycle    Consolidating cost data into comprehensive product cost views across all brands    Presenting analyses and results in cross-functional committees and to senior stakeholders    Tracking and monitoring product cost development over time    Conducting deviation analysis and supporting change management activities As this is a Group function, you will maintain a holistic TRATON perspective and collaborate frequently with all brands within the Group.Who You AreYou combine analytical strength with technical curiosity and a strong business mindset. You are comfortable working close to product development and thrive in environments where finance meets engineering. We believe you bring:     A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong interest in technical matters    5-10 years of experience within product cost controlling of hardware products, or related areas such as Purchasing, R&D, Project Management, or Strategy    Strong analytical capability and a high level of quality awareness and accountability    A structured, communicative, and collaborative working style    The ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling way    A genuine interest in working in a diverse, international environment with stakeholders across the globe    Fluency in English (written and verbal). Swedish or German is considered a strong advantage You are a team player who challenges constructively, drives progress, and contributes to securing long-term profitability through structured cost governance.This Is UsTRATON Group Product Cost Controlling is part of Project and Product Cost Controlling and plays a key role in ensuring the profitability of TRATON's product portfolio. We operate in a dynamic and complex environment, working closely with cross-functional management teams and product development organizations across the Group. Our team culture is characterized by collaboration, high ambition, and continuous learning. We believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and better decision-making. We value different perspectives and backgrounds and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. At TRATON, we also recognize the importance of work-life balance and strive to provide the flexibility and support our employees need to succeed both professionally and personally.TRATON AB OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. Benefits include access to our health center & wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. The group also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm. ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-04. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Emma Karlsson, Head of Product Cost Cab & EE/SW/AU, emma.x.karlsson@scania.com We look forward to your application! This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON AB

jobs.title: Certification Engineer
jobs.description: Who We AreAllgon is a leading manufacturer of wireless machinery control systems, delivering customized solutions to companies across the industrial sector. Our customers engage with us through our subsidiaries Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica. We are passionate about developing industrial remote control solutions that enhance safety and efficiency worldwide.You will join our Product Compliance & QESG team, which works with product compliance, quality, environment, sustainability and management systems. We are a small, close-knit team spread across Gothenburg, Björbo and Málaga. You report to the department manager at the head office in Gothenburg.The role can be based in Gothenburg, Björbo/Borlänge or Málaga, Spain. You will work closely with colleagues across Allgon’s global organization.About the RoleAs a Certification Engineer at Allgon, you make sure our products obtain and keep all required approvals before and after market release. This covers radio, RF exposure, EMC, electrical safety and functional safety. You will also support the work to meet new requirements under the EU Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity legislation.You will independently manage certification projects, from updates to existing approvals to new approvals in development projects. You will work closely with R&D, product management, quality, manufacturing, external test laboratories, certification bodies and our subsidiaries.Key Responsibilities:    Interpret and apply EU and international regulations and standards (RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, FCC, ISED and others)    Support R&D with functional safety: safety requirements, risk assessment, PL/SIL verification and safety documentation (ISO 13849, IEC 62061, IEC 61508)    Drive product cybersecurity compliance (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, the Cyber Resilience Act and the Machinery Regulation)    Plan and run certification projects    Coordinate testing with external laboratories, and work with TCB/FCB, Notified Bodies and authorities    Review test reports, technical files, declarations of conformity and product labeling    Manage updates, renewals and maintenance of existing approvals    Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on our products    Provide certification input during new product development and market expansion    Support customer service and subsidiaries with certification expertiseWhat We’re Looking ForYou are a detail-oriented and analytical engineer with a strong interest in product certification and regulatory requirements. You enjoy working independently, take ownership of your tasks and are comfortable coordinating many stakeholders. With a structured approach and clear communication, you turn complex requirements into practical actions that support product development and market access.Key qualifications include:    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field    Experience in product certification, regulatory affairs or a similar role    Strong knowledge of RF and EMC standards and global wireless certification requirements    Knowledge of and practical experience with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 62061/IEC 61508), e.g. risk assessment and PL/SIL determination and verification    Experience working with EU and international regulations (e.g. RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation, FCC, ISED, MIC)    Ability to review and interpret test reports and certification documentation    Understanding of PLM systems and certification documentation processes    Fluent English, spoken and written. Swedish, Spanish or other languages are also a plus.It is a plus if you have:    A functional safety certification    Experience with product cybersecurity (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, CRA)    Experience with RF exposure assessment and TCB/FCB processes    Experience with marine/offshore type approvals from classification societies (e.g. DNV, Lloyd’s Register)    Project management experienceWhat We Offer    Work with cutting-edge, high-quality products in a dynamic environment    A key role at a time when functional safety, the Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity are reshaping our industry    Opportunities for continuous professional growth and career development.    A challenging and rewarding role within a growing organization    Collective agreement (working in Sweden), including 9 extra days off per calendar year through reduced working hours    3,000 SEK annually for wellness benefits (working in Sweden)About AllgonAllgon is a Swedish company specializing in industrial radio control, with a strong track record in wireless technology innovation. Through our brands Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica, we have built a global presence, employing over 470 professionals and presence in 26 countries.We offer an exciting work environment in a profitable and growing organization with a strong technical focus. Despite our global reach, we maintain the close-knit atmosphere of a smaller company, where every employee has a voice and can influence the projects they work on.At Allgon, sustainability is a key priority—ecologically, socially, and financially. We are committed to attracting passionate individuals who share our vision of a safer, more efficient world through advanced wireless technology.Last application date is 5 January 2027. Selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before last application date. Welcome with your application already today!

jobs.description: Job DescriptionThe Unit Leader leads an assigned Tyvek® manufacturing unit in Luxembourg, with full accountability at the unit level for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Inventory, and Productivity (SQDIP). The role manages and develops a team, translates business priorities into operating plans, and delivers safe, reliable, customer-focused, and cost-effective performance.As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, the Unit Leader deploys DuPont Operational Excellence and coordinates shared functions to deliver unit commitments. Accountability covers the unit and controllable resources; site governance, plant-wide investment decisions, and independent functional authorities remain with designated leaders.What You'll DoOwn Unit QDIP Performance• Safety: Ensure safe work, environmental stewardship, employee qualification, and operating discipline. Partner with EHS to manage risks, verify corrective actions, and meet applicable process safety and management of change requirements.• Quality: Ensure execution of specifications and quality system requirements. Partner with Quality on defect prevention, deviations, customer concerns, and corrective actions, respecting independent approval and release of authorities.• Delivery: Meet production plans and customer commitments through staffing, capacity management, and shift coordination. Escalate constraints and lead recovery plans with Supply Chain.• Inventory: Partner with Supply Chain to improve work-in-process, material flow, inventory accuracy, and lead time while reducing excess and obsolescence without compromising supply reliability.• Productivity: Improve labor and asset effectiveness, yield, throughput, and conversion cost; reduce downtime, scrap, rework, and resource losses without compromising safety, quality, or compliance.• Set unit targets and ownership; use leading and lagging indicators to close gaps and sustain results across shifts.Lead Daily Management and Operational Excellence• Sustain Daily Visual Management, tiered accountability, Bowler reviews, standard work, effective handovers, and timely escalation.• Lead visibly at the Gemba: listen to employees, verify standards, remove barriers, and coach problem solving at the source.• Own the improvement roadmap with the Plant Leader and CI/OpEx partners. Lead Kaizen, root-cause analysis, waste reduction, and flow improvement.• Build practical Lean capability; use data and digital tools to identify losses, validate benefits, and embed improvements into daily work.Manage, Develop, and Engage the Team• Set clear goals and accountability; coach, recognize, and develop direct reports to lead effectively across shifts.• Own workforce planning and the unit employee life cycle with HR: hiring, onboarding, qualification, development, retention, succession, and transitions.• Maintain skills coverage, cross-training, and leadership depth for current and future operating needs.• Build a respectful, inclusive environment where employees raise concerns, contribute ideas, and own improvements; act on engagement feedback.• Partner with HR on employee relations, policies, and applicable labor agreements and consultation requirements.Deliver Financial Discipline and Asset Reliability• Develop operating plans, budget inputs, and forecasts; manage controllable spending within approved budgets and authority.• Partner with Finance on cost drivers, variances, working capital, and validated productivity benefits.• Coordinate Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, and Technology to improve asset vailability, process stability, and preventive maintenance; align shutdowns and projects with safe operation and long-term asset health.• Support improvement investments through business cases, operational requirements, implementation readiness, and benefit realization following approval.Lead Across Operations and Drive Change• Contribute to plant strategy, resource priorities, standards, and talent development; partner across functions and units to optimize the full value stream.• Translate customer requirements into operating priorities; support audits, customer engagement, new products, and manufacturing transfers withinassigned responsibilities.• Lead change through clear communication, employee involvement, practical plans, and sustained follow-through.• Demonstrate and role model behaviors aligned with DuPont's Core Values and Leadership Factors, reinforcing integrity, respect, accountability, customer focus, and continuous learning.What You'll Bring• Proven experience in manufacturing and direct people management, including accountability for operating results, team development, and cross-functional delivery.• Demonstrated SQDIP improvement track record, using Lean, Daily Management, and structured problem solving; experience managing costs, staffing, capacity, and production plans.• Knowledge of manufacturing risk, quality systems, and applicable regulations; relevant process safety or regulated-manufacturing experience required where unit risks or products demand it.• Relevant bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent manufacturing and leadership experience may be considered, subject to site requirements.• Professional proficiency in German and English, both spoken and written.• Lean Practitioner, Six Sigma Green Belt, or equivalent applied training preferred.Critical Skills and Leadership Behaviors• Connects strategy to execution, balancing daily delivery with long-term capability and sound business judgment.• Builds trust through visible leadership, listening, coaching, and consistent accountability.• Uses facts and employee insights to solve problems, manage risk, and sustain improvements.• Influences across boundaries, aligns shared resources, and builds ownership of change and learning.

jobs.description: Accounting Analyst Position Summary The Accounting Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records and statutory reporting. jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Asikkalassa
jobs.description: Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalleHaemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Asikkalassa.Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/applyMitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemistaLisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa.""Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-6h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.description: **Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund i Esbo. Besöken sker två gånger i veckan.Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Vad gör en vård helppare?**En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:- hjälp vid dusch - uppföljning av hur senioren mår - stöd för att klara sig hemma - stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.Som vård helppare får du:- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap. - **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka. - **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,51-17,51€/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning. - **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön! Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.Om du har frågor om att bli vårdar-helppare, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.title: Sykepleier/Vernepleier i Oppfølgingstjenester rus og ROP, team Ilaveien, 100 % fast
jobs.employer: FREDRIKSTAD KOMMUNE RUS OG PSYKISK HELSEARBEID
jobs.description:
Oppfølgingsavdeling Rus/ROP er en avdeling underlagt tjenesteområde Livsmestring i Fredrikstad kommune, hvorav en underavdeling har fast arbeidssted på Ilaveien bosenter. Dette drives som et samarbeidsprosjekt mellom Blå Kors og Fredrikstad kommune, hvor ansatte fra begge organisasjoner samarbeider for økte kvaliteter og utvikling av tjenestene. Målgruppen er personer i aktiv rus og med ROP‑lidelser, ofte med somatisk sykdom. Arbeidet krever god klinisk observasjonskompetanse og etablerte, trygge rutiner for legemiddelhåndtering.

Vi tilbyr oppfølging som støtter brukerne i å mestre hverdagen, ivareta helsen og bo stabilt. Tjenestene er recoveryorienterte, fleksible og tilpasset behovene til mennesker som lever med omfattende og sammensatte utfordringer.Arbeidstiden er dagtid, med én kveldsvakt i uken, samt hver sjette helg med 12,5‑timers langvakter.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til rusmestring og styrket daglig fungering gjennom systematisk kartlegging og målrettet oppfølging.
  • Legge til rette for å motivere til deltakelse i meningsfulle aktiviteter og struktur i hverdagen.
  • Benytte en recoveryorientert tilnærming for å utforske ressurser og støtte brukere i økt livsmestring og samfunnsdeltakelse.
  • Følge opp personer i aktiv rus og med ROP‑lidelser før, under og etter behandling i spesialisthelsetjenesten, samt ved behov etter soning.
  • Bidra med kliniske observasjoner og oppfølging av somatisk sykdom, samt sikre gode rutiner for legemiddelhåndtering.
  • Samhandle med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere, inkludert frivillige organisasjoner.
  • Henvisning til TSB ved behov for ruspoliklinisk behandling.
  • Utføre dokumentasjon, faglige vurderinger og planarbeid i tråd med lovverk og interne rutiner.
  • Bidra aktivt i avdelingens kvalitetsarbeid og faglige utvikling.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som Sykepleier eller Vernepleier
  • God kunnskap om og forståelse for rusavhengighet, ROP‑lidelser og somatisk helse.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner.
  • Førerkort klasse B.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Videreutdanning innen rus og avhengighet, psykisk helse eller annen relevant faglig fordypning.
  • Andre relevante videreutdanninger innen tjenestens fokusområder.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med rusavhengighet og psykiske lidelser
  • Erfaring med journalsystemet Gerica.
  • Kjennskap til FIT – tilbakemeldingsverktøy.
  • Erfaring med og kunnskap om klinisk observasjonskompetanse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er fleksibel, men samtidig strukturert i arbeidsprosesser.
  • Du håndterer endringer godt og kan omstille deg raskt etter brukerens behov.
  • Du har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og trives med oppsøkende arbeid på brukers arena.
  • Du er faglig engasjert, motivert og opptatt av kvalitet i tjenestene.
  • Du samarbeider godt i team og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet.
  • Du er arbeidsom, mobil og trygg i en variert og til tider uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag.
  • Du jobber godt både selvstendig og i team.

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyrEt stimulerende arbeidsmiljø i en avdeling med fokus på tverrfaglig samarbeid og kompetanse.Gode pensjonsordninger i KLP

Andre vilkårArbeidstakere ansettes i Fredrikstad kommune i henhold til lover, reglement og tariffavtale. Prøvetiden er 6 måneder.

OffentlighetOpplysning om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Fredrikstad kommune vil varsle søkere som har bedt om unntak for offentlighet, dersom dette ønsket ikke kan imøtekommes (offentlighetsloven § 25). Det vil gå frem av den offentlige søkerlista hvor mange søkere det har vært til stillingen og hvilket kjønn de har.KontaktinformasjonMaria Sætherbakken, Avdelingsleder, 98907108 Kine Norbom, Virksomhetsleder, 40449126 ArbeidsstedIlaveien 110 1605 Fredrikstad Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Fredrikstad kommune Referansenr.: 5208989607 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 26.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Velkommen til Fredrikstad, en av Norges mest attraktive byer. En liten time fra Oslo, der Glomma renner ut i havet, finner du Fredrikstad. Med våre 86.500 innbyggere er vi landets åttende største by. Fredrikstad er i sterk vekst. I tillegg til en urban bykjerne, har vi et spennende og variert omland og en vakker skjærgård. Byen er kjent for sitt rike kulturliv og sine historiske tradisjoner. Gamlebyen er Nord-Europas best bevarte festningsby. I Fredrikstad finner man trygge oppvekst- og levekår, et godt botilbud og et variert miljø- og teknologibasert næringsliv. Du når Oslo på en time og Gøteborg på vel to timer.

Fredrikstad kommune ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver hvor ulikheter og mangfold er en styrke. Kvalifiserte personer med innvandrerbakgrunn og/eller redusert funksjonsevne oppfordres til å søke. Kommunens verdier er Inkluderende, Ansvarlig og Modig.

jobs.title: Kunnossapidon työnjohtaja - Mäkelä Alu
jobs.description: Oletko se, joka avaa konepellin ja kurkkaa, miten asiat oikeasti toimivat? Haluatko työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen ja jonka jälki näkyy koko tehtaassa?Haemme Mäkelä Alulle kunnossapidon työnjohtajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Alajärvelle. Tehtävässä pääset johtamaan kokeneiden kunnossapidon ammattilaisten tiimiä ja työskentelemään monipuolisen, osin ainutlaatuisen laitekantamme parissa. Etsimme henkilöä, jota tekniikka, koneet ja laitteet aidosti kiinnostavat ja jolla on myös kykyä johtaa ihmisiä. Kunnossapitotaustaa et välttämättä tarvitse. Tärkeintä on hyvä tekninen osaaminen, aito kiinnostus laitteisiin ja ote, jolla porukka lähtee mukaan.90-vuotias perheyritys Mäkelä Alu on erikoistunut alumiiniprofiilien valmistukseen sekä niiden pintakäsittelyyn. Pääkonttorimme ja tuotantolaitoksemme sijaitsevat Alajärven Luoma-aholla. Kouvolan Kuusankoskella toimii toinen toimipaikkamme, jossa on pintakäsittely- ja varastointitoimintaa. Työllistämme noin 220 henkilöä.TehtäväsiOlet yhdeksän asentajan ja talonmiehen esihenkilö, ja ohjaat lisäksi kumppaniyrityksemme sähköasentajien työtä. Vastaat kunnossapidon päivittäisjohtamisesta yhdessä kunnossapitopäällikön kanssa. Työsi painottuu työnjohtoon, suunnitteluun ja koordinointiin, etkä itse osallistu varsinaisiin asennustöihin.Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:- kunnossapidon päivittäisten töiden suunnittelu ja resursointi- kunnossapitojärjestelmän pääkäyttäjän tehtävät- ennakkohuoltojen, huoltoseisokkien ja investointien suunnitteluun osallistuminen- varaosien riittävyydestä huolehtiminen yhdessä hankinnan kanssa- työturvallisuuden johtaminen ja turvallisten toimintatapojen varmistaminen- yhteistyö tuotannon, alihankkijoiden sekä kotimaisten ja ulkomaisten laitetoimittajien kanssa.Laitekantamme on monipuolinen ja osin ainutlaatuinen, joten opittavaa riittää. Työ on päivätyötä paikan päällä Alajärvellä.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Tunnistatko itsessäsi ripauksen Pelle Pelotonta: kaikki tekniikka kiinnostaa, eikä visainen konerikko saa sinua perääntymään. Ehkä työskentelet nyt suunnittelussa, tuotannossa tai projekteissa ja kaipaat lähemmäs koneita ja ihmisiä.Voit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos sinulla on:- Hyvä ymmärrys koneiden toiminnasta – kunnossapitokokemus on etu, ei edellytys- Kykyä johtaa ja koordinoida ihmisiä ja asioita- Hyvät tietotekniset valmiudet, sujuva suomi ja hyvä englanti- Päättäväinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja rehti ote: kestät suoraa palautetta ja uskallat sanoa en tiedä- Huumorintajua ja halua sitoutua pitkäksi aikaa- Teknikon tai insinöörin koulutus, esimerkiksi kone-, automaatio- tai sähkötekniikasta- Arvostamme lisäksi aiempaa kokemusta kunnossapidosta, huumorintajua ja halua sitoutua pitkäjänteisesti tehtävään.Mitä tarjoamme?Tarjoamme sinulle:- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnjohtotehtävän teollisuusyrityksessä- mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisen ja osin ainutlaatuisen laitekannan parissa- kokeneen ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin sekä kunnossapitopäällikön tuen- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kunnossapidon toimintaa- vakavaraisen suomalaisen perheyrityksen tarjoaman vakituisen työpaikan- kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon ja kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun.Kiinnostuitko?Kysy lisätietoja tai lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si alla olevan linkin kautta. jobs.title: Analytics and pricing expert - Insurance
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Insurance Team ⭐️

Being part of Alan's insurance community is a great opportunity to have a significant impact on people's health and wellbeing in our multiple countries of operation.

  • We are at the heart of Alan’s mission, bringing to the team our technical leadership and expertise on healthcare and death & disability insurance.

  • We work hand in hand with our data scientists, designers, engineers and product managers to build the most differentiating products and provide a delightful experience at a fair price.

  • We build and manage offers for large companies and public institutions with our sales and account management teams.

  • We make sure our portfolio is closely monitored and risks are effectively managed.

  • We also manage our capital, steer our reinsurance strategy and maintain a trusting relationship with our insurance regulators.

️ ⭐️ Your role ⭐️ ️

  • Partner with sales teams to price and develop compelling proposals for very large corporate clients and public institutions

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor in client meeting, delivering expert insights that build confidence in our solutions

  • Design delightful insurance products meeting both member needs and regulatory requirements

  • Support key account managers in nurturing and renewing our most strategic client relationships

  • Develop scalable tools, frameworks and knowledge resources that empower further our sales teams 

⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️ 

You would thrive in this role if you: 

  • Are able to navigate and synthesize technical, data, legal and business considerations related to health and income protection insurance

  • 2 years of experience in Health and/or "Prevoyance" Insurance are a big plus but are not required

  • Are analytical and structured, with a fact-based decision-making style

  • Are excited about bringing technical expertise in a business-centric context

  • Are willing to deeply change the insurance industry and challenge the status quo

  • Approach challenges with a scalability perspective, continuously identifying opportunities to optimize processes and systems

  • Have strong written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts

  • Are fluent in both French (French clients) and English (Alan’s working language)

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-F level range.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Kontaktperson i barnevernstjenesten
jobs.description:
Barneverntjenesten i Arendal holder til i gode lokaler på Maxis kjøpesenter like utenfor Arendal. Vi er i underkant av 50 årsverk. Tjenesten har etablert egen avdeling for mottak, undersøkelse og tiltaksarbeid, egen avdeling for oppfølging av barn som bor utenfor hjemmet, samt et team med miljøterapeuter som yter veiledning til både foreldre og fosterforeldre. 

Vi er opptatt av å gi tjenester med høy grad av kvalitet, i åpenhet og hvor barn og foreldre medvirker i samarbeid. Trivsel og ivaretakelse av ansatte er viktig for oss. Vi legger til rette for tett lederstøtte og opplæring. I tillegg arbeider vi systematisk med HMS tiltak for helhetlig kultur og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Vi ledig to 100% vikariater som kontaktperson i mottak, undersøkelse og tiltaksavdelingen. Det ene har varighet til 30.06.27 og det andre til 31.12.27. Alle søkere må legge ved skannede vitnemål og attester. Det kreves politiattest ved ansettelse i henhold til barnevernsloven. Vi har egne tjenestebiler, men du må påregne å måtte bruke noe egen bil i arbeidet. 

Skriv tydelig i søknaden om du søker begge eller en av stillingene.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Saksbehandling etter Lov om barnevern.
  • Undersøke og følge opp innkomne meldinger.
  • Kartlegge og undersøke barn og familiers behov for hjelp etter lov om barnevern.
  • Følge opp barn og familier som mottar hjelpetiltak fra barnevernstjenesten hjemme.
  • Gjennomføre samtaler med barn og forvalte deres synspunkt.
  • Ivareta foreldre og familier i krevende livssituasjoner.
  • Gjøre analyser og vurderinger omkring barnets beste.
  • Planmessig og strukturert oppfølging og evaluering av tiltak.
  • Møteledelse og utstrakt samarbeid med andre.
  • Jobbe tverrfaglig med andre instanser til beste for familien og barnet.
  • Være partsrepresentant for barneverntjenesten ved saker i barneverns- og helsenemnda, og i rett.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du er sosionom eller barnevernspedagog.
  • Annen relevant bachelor kan komme i betraktning dersom du har relevant erfaring.
  • Du har gjerne relevant praksis.
  • Du har sertifikat. 
  • Arbeidsspråket i Arendal kommune er norsk, og søkere må beherske norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig, minimum B2-nivå.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er faglig engasjert og opptatt av å holde deg oppdatert på barnevernsfeltet.
  • Du har god relasjonskompetanse og evner å skape tillit.
  • Du tar ansvar, og du er strukturert og analytisk.
  • Du har god arbeidskapasitet og er emosjonelt robust.
  • Du evner å prioritere og jobbe selvstendig.
  • Du ser verdien av og forsøker aktivt å samarbeide med  barn, familier, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Du kan kommunisere godt både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Du har gode kontaktskapende evner og er trygg i fremtoningen
  • Du er ydmyk i møte med barn og familier.
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende jobb hvor du får anledning til å utvikle deg både faglig og personlig.
  • Gode kollegaer og et godt arbeidsmiljø med mye glede, trygghet og støtte fra leder- og kollegaer. 
  • Systematisk veiledning og god opplæring.
  • Lønn etter tariff, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Fleksitid. Parkering.
KontaktinformasjonChristin B Haugesten, Avdelingsleder, +4748995525 ArbeidsstedVesterveien 44 4839 Arendal Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Arendal kommune Referansenr.: 5211590268 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 04.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2027 Søknadsfrist: 06.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du bli vår nye kollega? 

Arendal ble etablert som kjøbstad i mai 1723. Siden har det skjedd mye. I dag har Arendal kommune over 46 000 innbyggere. Kommunen er en handlekraftig organisasjon og en attraktiv arbeidsgiver for over 3500 medarbeidere. 

Vi løser viktige samfunnsoppgaver, og er en sentral aktør i utviklingen av byen og kommunen. Vi jobber aktivt med FNs bærekraftsmål, og vi er vertskommune for Arendalsuka - Norges største demokratifestival. 

Arbeidet skal preges av mangfold og våre medarbeidere skal gjenspeile Arendals befolkning. Vi ser mangfold som en styrke. Vi vil ha medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, bakgrunn, erfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. 

Arendal kommune er sertifisert som likestilt arbeidsgiver. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert; uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn, til å søke jobb hos oss. Vi jobber for heltidskultur, og ansetter fortrinnsvis i hele stillinger. Se mer om vår arbeidsgiverstrategi.

I henhold til offentlighetslovens § 25. gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli gjort offentlig, selv om søkeren har bedt om unntak fra offentlighet.

For stillinger som arbeider med barn og unge, tjenester innen helse- og omsorg, eller brann- og eksplosjonsvern, må det foreligge tilfredsstillende politiattest før ansettelse.
