jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.employer: Dječji vrtić Ivana Brlić Mažuranić, Biograd na Moru
jobs.description:
DJEČJI VRTIĆ IVANA BRLIĆ MAŽURANIĆ

BIOGRAD NA MORU

Marina Držića 1

23210 Biograd na Moru

Temeljem čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (''Narodne novine'' broj 10/97, 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., i 101/23.) i odluke Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića Ivana Brlić Mažuranić, Biograd na Moru, od dana 6. listopada 2026. objavljuje se

NATJEČAJ

za prijem za radno mjesto

ODGOJITELJ/ICA na određeno puno radno vrijeme, 1 izvršitelj/ica

Za prijam u radni odnos odgojitelja/ice kandidati moraju ispunjavati, osim općih uvjeta, uvjete propisane člankom 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (''Narodne novine'', broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22. i 101/23.) te člankom 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (''Narodne novine'' broj 145/24. i 62/25).

Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih godinu dana života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti:

  • Sveučilišni diplomski studij – Sveučilišni/a magistar/magistra ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja
  • Sveučilišni prijediplomski studij – Sveučilišni/a prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja
  • Stručni prijediplomski studij – Prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijem u radni odnos:

1. punoljetnost

2. zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

- Dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta dostavit će izabrani kandidat po dostavljenoj obavijesti o izboru.

3. radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (''Narodne novine'' broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22. i 101/23.).

Kao dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta za prijam u radni odnos kandidati moraju priložiti sljedeće dokumente:

  • prijavu (vlastoručno potpisanu),
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • presliku diplome o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • elektronički zapis odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje
  • kao dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju dostavljaju se sljedeći dokumenti (ne stariji od 6 mjeseci):

a) uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak prema članku 25. stavak 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju

b) uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema članku 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju

c) potvrda nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta iz članka 25. stavak 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim zakonima, sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (''Narodne novine'' broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.)., članku 48. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u tekstu ovog natječaja.

Prijave se podnose preporučeno poštom ili osobno, u zatvorenoj omotnici, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na adresu Dječji vrtić Ivana Brlić Mažuranić, Biograd na Moru, Paška 1, 23210 Biograd na Moru, s naznakom ''NE OTVARAJ – za natječaj.

jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

Bei uns arbeiten Sie... an der Betreuung von Bestandskund:innen und Akquisition von Neukund:innen im Unternehmensbereich an der Speisen- und Sortimentspräsentation sowie der Durchführung von Verkostungen mit Umsatzverantwortung für das Verkaufsgebiet an der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Mitbewerbersituation an Jahresplanung, Kontroll- und Berichtswesen Wir freuen uns auf Sie und... Ihre abgeschlossene kaufmännische, gastronomische oder ernährungswissenschaftliche Ausbildung Ihre nachweisbare Berufserfahrung (3-5 Jahre) im Außendienst, idealerweise branchenspezifisch im Gastronomie-, Tourismus- oder Lebensmittelbereich Ihre hohe Kundenorientierung und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Ihr gutes Verhandlungsgeschick Ihr gepflegtes Auftreten, Ihre hohe Belastbarkeit und Ihr Durchsetzungsvermögen Ihre sehr guten MS-Office Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) sowie Erfahrung mit Kundendatenbanken Ihren Führerschein B, entsprechende Fahrpraxis sowie Ihre Reisebereitschaft Wir machen Gutes besser... mit einem Dienst-PKW zur unbegrenzeten Privatnutzung mit modernem Firmenlaptop und Handy mit einer fundierten und umfangreichen Einschulung für einen erfolgreichen Start mit flachen Hierarchien, einem familiären Team und einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag mit fairer Entlohnung gemäß dem Kollektivvertrag der Nahrungs- und Genussmittelindustrie für Angestellte von monatlich mindestens EUR 3.300,- brutto auf Basis einer All-In Vereinbarung. Bei entsprechender Qualifikation und Erfahrung ist eine Bereitschaft zur weiteren Überzahlung gegeben. Darüberhinaus rundet die Einbindung in ein attraktives Provisionsmodell das Paket ab. Ob Berufseinstieg, Spezialisierung oder neue Perspektiven: Bei GOURMET eröffnen sich vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu bieten wir attraktive Vorteile für Mitarbeiter:innen, verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, das unterschiedliche Lebenssituationen berücksichtigt. Durch Ihren Bewerbungsprozess führt Sie Christina Heigl. Bei Fragen oder Anliegen nehmen Sie sehr gerne direkt Kontakt auf. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Der familiäre Umgang und sehr gute betriebliche Aus- und Weiterbildung sehen wir als Grundvoraussetzung für unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg.  Weitere Benefits: Flexible Arbeitszeiten Abwechslungsreiche und interessante Aufgaben Fachliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Gute Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten Familiäres und sehr gutes Betriebsklima Mitarbeiterrabatte Grandits bietet Ihnen eine leistungsgerechte und marktgerechte Überzahlung, die über dem kollektiven Mindestgehalt liegt. Diese richtet sich nach Ausbildung, Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung. Diese Stelle unterliegt dem Kollektivvertrag für Fleischer Arbeiter. Für diese Position ist ein Bruttomonatsgehalt ab EUR 2.895,98 in Vollzeit vorgesehen.

jobs.title: Innovation Internship
jobs.description:
About the role

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance.

As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

  • GHG reduction calculation: Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

  • Policy Fit: asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

  • Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

  • Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

  • Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Backend Platform team:

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python.

  • Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system.

  • Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

  • Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each.

  • Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact.

  • Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

  • Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both.

  • Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: System Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description:
System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Caseware combines over 35 years of industry expertise with AI-powered technology to transform how audit and accounting professionals work. Serving organizations across 130 countries, we bring intelligent automation directly into audit and financial reporting workflows—helping professionals reduce manual work, navigate complexity, and focus on informed decisions. Join our global team and help build technology that strengthens trust in financial information.


As an Account Executive at Caseware, you play a central role in driving revenue growth. You expand our presence in the market, win new customers and strengthen relationships with existing ones. With strong closing skills and a sharp eye for new opportunities within your portfolio, you help build sustainable revenue and long-term partnerships. You also increase Caseware’s visibility by building a relevant network and positioning our solutions confidently in the market. Your work has a direct impact on customer loyalty, market position and the long-term success of the company.

What you will be doing:
  • Drive active sales of Caseware’s solutions through consultative conversations, product presentations and confident management of the full sales cycle, working closely with Marketing, Consulting and Product Management. 
  • Build and expand long-term customer relationships based on a clear understanding of individual needs, strengthening satisfaction, loyalty and future growth opportunities. 
  • Increase market share and ARR within your territory by winning new customers, securing reliable deal outcomes and expanding existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell. 
  • Develop and execute strategic sales and account plans, using cross-functional resources to unlock revenue potential and move opportunities to a successful close. 
  • Manage your pipeline with discipline and deliver accurate forecasts that support clear decision-making and consistent progress toward sales targets. 
  • Strengthen Caseware’s market presence and expand your professional network through active engagement with key decision-makers and relevant industry stakeholders. 
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of all sales activities, data and contract details in the CRM to ensure transparency and efficient operations. 

    • What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise technology or complex solution sales across large customer accounts 
  • Solid understanding of the Software as a Service (SaaS) business model 
  • Proven success in winning new customers and expanding existing enterprise accounts 
  • Demonstrated ability to sell and navigate complex enterprise organizations 
  • Experience demonstrating complex software applications to customers

jobs.description:
Work tasks: DreamApply is an international EdTech company providing world-class SaaS admission solutions for universities. We are a small, dynamic team with a big mission: to make the application process a hassle-free experience for millions of students globally. Our roots are in Estonia, and our team is global. We are looking for a proactive and dependable HR Specialist & Office Manager to serve as management’s right hand in daily HR and administrative matters. Above all, we value strong organizational skills, initiative, and a genuine enthusiasm for keeping operations running smoothly. It is an ideal fit for someone who appreciates a balanced workload, while bringing precision, reliability, and an in-person presence when it counts. Key Responsibilities: Recruitment: Drafting and posting job openings, screening incoming applications, and conducting initial interviews through to final candidate selection. Onboarding & Offboarding: Facilitating smooth, welcoming onboarding for new hires and managing exit steps. Team Support: Addressing day-to-day HR inquiries from team members and assisting management with HR-related topics and projects. Team Events and Trainings: Planning and organizing virtual and in-person team events, trainings, and informal get-togethers when colleagues visit. Office Management: Managing daily office needs and ensuring a comfortable, well-run workspace. Operational & Administrative Support: Handling ad-hoc operational and administrative tasks.

We offer: What We Offer:Flexibility: A remote-friendly hybrid setup and a balanced workload that supports an exceptional work-life balance. International Environment: Hands-on exposure to the dynamic EdTech industry alongside a diverse global team. Open Culture: A flat hierarchy with direct, transparent communication. Benefits: sports compensation or health insurance, according to your choice

Other requirements: Requirements:Fluency in English and Estonian (both spoken and written), as everyday internal collaboration with our distributed team takes place in English. Previous experience or strong familiarity with the HR field and regulations, recruitment, office management, and administrative support. Strong organizational abilities, analytical skills, diligence, and attention to detail. High autonomy and proactivity - you readily spot what needs doing. Strong interpersonal and empathetic skills, acting as an approachable point of contact for colleagues. Excellent self-management and time-management skills, a proactive mindset with strong initiative, and great communication skills.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do whatâs right for Clover.

Weâre hiring an Engineering Lead to own the technology behind Cloverâs acquisition journey, from the public website and lead generation through telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment. You will understand how the operation works, shape the product and technical approach, lead a small team, and help build the systems yourself.

This role focuses on autonomy and engineering-led delivery: take an important business goal, understand the people and data involved, choose a practical approach, ship useful increments, and own the result. You will also manage approximately two to three engineers, give them clear scope, and develop their judgment. Expect roughly 60% hands-on technical work and 40% management, planning, and work with business partners.

Your charter includes our content management systems, telesales technology, member app, and public surface area including our enrollment forms and customer data and public analytics platforms. You will work through the whole chain, from a data source or API to what an agent or prospective member actually experiences.

As an Engineering Lead, Growth, you will:

  • Own technical direction and delivery for acquisition systems, including the public website and assets, telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment experiences.
  • Work directly with sales, growth, marketing, and operating partners to understand the business problem, choose useful increments, and agree how their value will be measured.
  • Connect analytics, leads, customer data, CRM, and operating workflows. Make data flows, ownership, and failure behavior understandable and dependable.
  • Build and improve software personally. Use AI in development, investigation, analysis, prototypes, and useful product capabilities, and evaluate the result against actual behavior.
  • Lead and coach a small engineering team. Make scope and staffing decisions, give direct feedback, and stand behind credible delivery commitments.
  • Make pragmatic choices about architecture, vendors, and existing capabilities. Keep a focused solution moving while preserving engineering quality and control of important integration points.
  • Partner with IT on the operation and support of sales tools, and with Product and our special projects teams on discovery, dependencies, and business change.
  • Observe how prospective members, brokers, and sales staff use the systems. Use that evidence to improve the experience and the operation.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand the acquisition journey and existing systems, have a clear first delivery plan, and have shipped an increment that improves our usersâ experience. Your engineers have clear ownership, and business partners understand the next commitments.
  • First six months: The team has landed a new telesales stack, and other agreed acquisition priorities, including the ongoing growth demands of a five star Medicare Advantage plan. Data and tools are improving the actual sales workflow, and the result is visible in agreed operational and acquisition measures.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has led work end-to-end and can reason across application, integration, data, and user-experience boundaries, especially in public-facing contexts.
  • You have managed and developed engineers while remaining directly involved in building. You enjoy the scope of an enduring small team.
  • You have strong product instincts and can translate a commercial or operating goal into a useful technical plan with measurable results.
  • You have built systems involving customer data, CRM, sales or acquisition workflows, public web and content management experiences, or similarly interconnected operations.
  • You use AI deeply in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities. You can explain how you check the result.
  • You work well with business partners, make tradeoffs clear, and can move work forward when the initial request is ambiguous.

Benefits Overview:Â 

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â 
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do whatâs right for Clover.

Weâre hiring a Engineering Lead to build the systems that help our clinical teams deliver services in the field and in membersâ homes. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation.

A likely first assignment is an âAir Traffic Controlâ system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene.

This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable.

We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day.

As an Â Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations, you will:

  • Work directly with supervisors, clinical field staff, and operations leaders to understand schedules, travel, capacity, handoffs, and the exceptions that disrupt a dayâs work.
  • Build field visibility and intervention tools that give supervisors useful context, distinguish current facts from missing information, and help them respond to changing conditions.
  • Develop scheduling and dispatch capabilities that match people and visits to practical constraints, with clear ways for operating staff to review and adjust the plan.
  • Build and debug APIs, mobile workflows, integrations, and data flows supporting field teams, connected equipment, and home technology.
  • Prototype quickly and ship focused increments. Make deliberate choices about what to build, integrate, or buy, and avoid committing to a large system before the operation has tested the approach.
  • Use AI actively for development, investigation, prototypes, analysis, and useful workflow capabilities. Check the behavior and make failures understandable and recoverable.
  • Coach engineers and take on a small number of direct reports as the team develops. Maintain clear ownership, sound engineering practices, and credible delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Product, Special Project Leads, IT, Counterpart, and the Engagement lead at the interfaces their work shares with field operations.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand how the field operation works, have shipped an improvement used by supervisors or field staff, and can show what it changed. You have a focused technical plan grounded in real constraints and exceptions.
  • First six months: Several useful increments are in place. Supervisors can understand and respond to disruptions more effectively, scheduling and field workflows are improving, and technical ownership is clear.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has owned meaningful work end-to-end and still builds regularly.
  • You can move across backend services, APIs, data flows, user interfaces, and operational workflows to solve a real problem.
  • You have strong product instincts, learn unfamiliar domains directly, and enjoy working with the people using what you build.
  • You have an iterative, curious approach to technology. You can describe an unfamiliar system you explored, a practical prototype you tried, or a failure you traced across boundaries.
  • You use AI in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities, with clear verification and evaluation.
  • You can coach engineers and are interested in responsibility for a small team as it develops. Formal management experience can help, but a strong record of Engineering Leadership and coaching also matters.

Benefits Overview:Â 

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â 
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

jobs.description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
jobs.description:
About the Team

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.Â  With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do

  • Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow.Â 
  • Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit
  • Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines
  • Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isnât always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind
  • Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't
  • Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics
  • Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team
  • Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly
  • Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments
  • A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)
  • Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI
  • Strong product and design instincts. This isnât about visual polish - itâs about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.
  • Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance
  • Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team
  • Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production
  • A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team
  • Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others
  • Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners
  • Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed
  • A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals
  • Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices
  • Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows
  • You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality
  • You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work
  • You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example
  • You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others
  • You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it
  • You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first
  • You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Regional Director, Enterprise Sales

This is your moment

Sweden. Norway. Denmark. Finland. Four markets, one region, and a team of elite sellers who are already winning. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, and we are looking for a Regional Director to take the Nordics to its next level.

Every CISO in the region is facing the same problem: attackers are using AI to get past defences built for a different era. Abnormal exists to change that. You will be the leader who gets into the deals, runs to the fire, and builds on a team that is already formidable.

This is not a role for someone who manages a forecast from behind a screen. It is for a leader who would rather be in the room with a CISO than in a meeting about the meeting.

Your mission

Overachieve the Nordics new annual recurring revenue (NARR) quota by winning enterprise accounts (2,000+ mailboxes) from first conversation to signature, and by growing them long after.

Along the way, you will:

  • Take an elite team and make it even better, through coaching, inspiration and an unrelenting standard.
  • Be hands on in the deals that matter, side by side with your Account Executives.
  • Spend your time where the revenue is: with customers, prospects and partners.
  • Build a channel in the region from the ground up, with your own hands.
  • Make the whole region move together, leading marketing, SDR and channel through a matrix model.

How you will lead

Hands on, always. You love getting into the deals with your AEs. You shape the strategy, join the critical calls, open doors at CISO, CIO and CTO level, and help close complex, multi-stakeholder deals from $200K+ through to $1M+.

Inspire the team. You lead with energy and example. You know what great looks like because you have done it, and you make the people around you want to do it too.

Run to the fire. When a deal is wobbling, a customer needs you or a competitor shows up, you are the first one there.

Thrive in velocity. We are low friction on process and high on pace. You enjoy agility, you make decisions quickly, and you are comfortable in a dynamic, Slack-based working culture where the best ideas move at the speed of a message.

Be external first. You will spend more time out in the market than in internal meetings, because that is where the pipeline and the relationships are.

What you will own

  • A programmatic sales playbook. Run a disciplined, repeatable approach to selling, embedded in the 3-Whys and MEDDPICC. Inspect deals with rigour, forecast monthly and quarterly with credibility, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews that drive action.
  • The team. Develop each Account Executive in the areas that matter most to their skills and NARR results. Recruit when the region needs it, and keep a bench of future talent warm so you are never caught short.
  • The matrix. Hold responsibility across channel, marketing and SDR in the region, bringing them together behind one plan to generate pipeline and accelerate new business.
  • The channel. Build strategic relationships with existing channel partners and open up new ones. This is a hands-on builder role, not a hand-off.
  • The customer. Maintain strong relationships with key customers in the region, focused on value realisation, timely renewals, rapid expansion and referrals.
  • The proof. Partner closely with Sales Engineering to deliver outstanding demonstrations and a repeatable proof-of-concept and technology validation programme.
  • The voice of the market. Be the voice of the customer and prospect inside Abnormal, with Sales Engineering, the POV team, Product and Marketing, so the right things get prioritised and more revenue gets closed.

What you bring

You are a proven winner who holds yourself accountable to consistent over-achievement, and who is hungry to build on something already strong.

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota selling security, networking and/or software.
  • 3+ years leading a sales team focused on new business and new logos.
  • A hunter's mentality: you have led teams that create new demand, win new customers and source their own pipeline.
  • A record of closing complex enterprise deals with multiple buying influences, in new or emerging solution categories, including deals of $200K+ and $1M+.
  • Credibility with executives. You build strong relationships with customers and partners at the most senior levels, and translate technical features into business value.
  • Fluency in consultative, value-based methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or Challenger Sale.
  • Experience building or growing a channel, and the instinct to get hands on with partners.
  • Outstanding verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and real enjoyment of a fast-paced, low-process environment.

Why you will love it here

We are building a generational company, and you would be building it with us. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, selling something customers genuinely need in a category that is still being defined. The momentum is real, the product is differentiated and the opportunity ahead is enormous.

Here, builders are not spectators. You will inherit a team of elite sellers and be trusted to make them even better. You will work shoulder to shoulder with Sales Engineering, Product and Marketing, and your voice will shape what we build and how we win. You will have the freedom to move fast, the support to do it well, and a front-row seat to something special.

If you want to lead from the front, build a region and put your name on some of the most important deals in Nordic enterprise security, as part of a company people will talk about for decades, we would love to meet you.

#LI-RJ1

These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

jobs.title: Technical Lead Norm Compliance
jobs.description:
About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week.

The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction.

How You'll Work

The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call.

You Will

  • Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week.

  • Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager.

  • Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers.

  • Run on-call escalation.

  • Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team.

  • Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it.

Skills & Experience - Core

  • Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code

  • Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS

  • Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it

  • Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients

  • Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising

  • Clear, brief writing

Skills & Experience - Pluses

  • Clients in financial services or another regulated industry

  • Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal

  • Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero

What Success Looks Like - 90 Days

  • You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team

  • You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation

  • The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working

Comp and Benefits

$220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity.

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Employees enjoy top-tier insurance coverage, encompassing health, dental, hospital, accident, and vision plans. You'll thrive in our fast-paced learning environment where professional growth is constant.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with core hours on US Eastern time. You will start in our New York office at One World Trade Center. Norm employment, US residency and work performed from the US are conditions of the role; because our clients are financial institutions, offers are conditional on a background check, including E-Verify. Visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

If you're interested in the role but aren't sure whether you're a good fit, we'd still like to hear from you.

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.
