jobs.title: Talent Brand Manager
Senior Talent Brand Manager
Software Engineer, Collections Infra
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer, UX/UI
jobs.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Web Development Team, part of Brand, owns beyondtrust.com end to end: a React and Next.js front end backed by an enterprise headless CMS, serving a global cybersecurity audience and the pipeline that runs through it. beyondtrust.com is BeyondTrust's largest go-to-market surface, and this role builds it â the campaign and launch experiences, the shared component system underneath them, and the front-end quality of the whole site.

This is a hands-on, mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer who is strong in React, TypeScript and Next.js, has the visual judgment to make what they build look right without every state being specified, and uses AI tooling as an everyday part of how they work. Direction comes from the team; execution and craft are yours. The role reports to the Sr. Manager, UX/UI & Digital Experience.

What Youâll Do

  • Build the web experiences behind BeyondTrust's launches, campaigns and new product narratives, working from direction set with Brand, Demand Generation and Product Marketing, and turning it into something live quickly.
  • Work hands-on in the shared component library every week: build new components, extend existing ones, and improve what is there through cleaner APIs, better typing and clearer documentation, and help shape where it goes next.
  • Build for front-end performance across the site, including Core Web Vitals.
  • Build and improve the conversion and demo-request journey and the form experience.
  • Build WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility into components and pages from the start, including automated accessibility checks.
  • Write component and end-to-end tests for your own work.
  • When you see a better way to do something â a pattern, an interaction, a page that should work differently â prototype it far enough that the team can react to a working example.
  • Use AI tooling, including Claude and Claude Code, as a core part of how you design, build, test and review, and help shape how the team uses it.
  • Build AI-powered features into the site as the team takes them on, such as assistive and conversational search, and content recommendation and personalization.
  • Follow secure development practices: handle secrets properly, keep dependencies current, validate input at boundaries, and take part in standing security review.

What Youâll Bring

  • 3+ years shipping production React and TypeScript, working in TypeScript strict mode.
  • Solid working knowledge of Next.js App Router, including server versus client components, rendering and caching, and the interest to go deeper.
  • Experience building against a headless CMS or API-driven content, including querying over GraphQL, and building components that hold up when content does something unexpected.
  • Strong CSS, including a utility-first framework, and an eye for layouts that hold together at every breakpoint.
  • Experience working in a shared component library, and opinions about what makes one good to build with.
  • Experience measuring and improving front-end performance.
  • Experience testing your own work with component and end-to-end tests, including accessibility checks.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility implementation: semantics, focus management and keyboard interaction.
  • Good visual judgment and comfort in Figma: able to take design direction and fill in the gaps â spacing, states, responsive behavior â without needing every case specified.
  • Everyday, specific use of AI tooling in your own workflow, with examples you can walk through.
  • Comfort taking a piece of work from brief to shipped in a small team.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with a modern hosting and edge platform, including caching and revalidation, incremental regeneration, and debugging production builds.
  • Experience building marketing and go-to-market web experiences, such as campaigns, launches and landing pages.
  • Experience contributing to the design or evolution of a component library, not just building in one.
  • Experience with Claude, Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tooling in a team setting.
  • Experience building LLM-backed features, such as retrieval, prompt design and evaluation.
  • Serverless or edge function work behind a front end, such as form handling, API routes and third-party integrations.
  • Motion and animation implemented in code.
  • Comfort working alongside marketers and other non-engineers: explaining tradeoffs without jargon and working from a brief that is not yet fully specified.
  • B2B SaaS, enterprise or security-industry background.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. Theyâre more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers whoÂ come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

jobs.title: Temporary Executive Assistant -  Luxembourg
jobs.description:
As a (Temporary) Executive Assistant to the CFO, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to a senior executive. Acting as a key business partner, you will ensure the smooth management of the CFO's agenda, travel arrangements, communications, and day-to-day priorities, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and efficiency.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organization based in Luxembourg. The company offers a collaborative and professional environment where flexibility, trust, and high performance are valued. You will work closely with executive leadership and gain exposure to strategic business activities while supporting key operational processes.

Description

Executive & Administrative Support
  • Manage the CFO's complex agenda, meetings, appointments, and business commitments.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, meeting packs, and professional correspondence.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring urgent matters are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, and filing systems.
  • Anticipate administrative needs and provide proactive support on a daily basis.
Travel & Diary Management
  • Coordinate extensive domestic and international travel arrangements, including visas and logistics.
  • Organize flights, accommodation, transportation, and detailed itineraries.
  • Prepare travel documentation and monitor travel-related expenses and reimbursements.
  • Ensure scheduling conflicts are anticipated and resolved efficiently.
Stakeholder & Project Coordination
  • Serve as a key point of contact between the CFO and internal or external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, partners, and external contacts.
  • Monitor action points, track deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Support and coordinate business initiatives, projects, and executive-level meetings.
Office & Operational Support
  • Assist with budget monitoring and expense management across multiple cost centers.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Coordinate office-related activities and procurement when required.
  • Contribute to the smooth operation of daily business activities.
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
  • Proactive, autonomous, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Service-minded with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).

jobs.title: Global Head of GSI Solutions Architecture
jobs.description:
Global Partner Engineering is the technical engine behind Rubrik's partner business. We work with global systems integrators, channel partners, managed service providers and technology alliances to help them build, sell and support Rubrik at scale.

Our GSI team works with the largest integrators in the world. We co-create joint solutions with their practices, enable their practitioners through certification, and partner with our field teams to win large, complex deals. Partners are a core part of how Rubrik grows, and this team makes that real.

What this role will do:

You will lead Rubrik's global GSI technical organization, with two integrated charters that work as one system.

  • Global Solutions - Architects build the play for named global GSIs: joint offers, reference architectures, blueprints and certification strategy with partner COEs. They work with Product on what is coming next and feed roadmap gaps back.
  • Global Go-to-market - Architects run the play in the region. They pair with partner sellers and Rubrik account teams to build joint pipelines, shape deals, lead demos and POCs through close, and activate Black Belts.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the global GSI technical strategy. Define the KPIs, targets and investment priorities that connect team effort to partner-sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue.
  • Shape the joint solution portfolio. Decide which GSIs get which offers, and run a repeatable pipeline that takes each offer from idea to adoption across our four product lines: enterprise and cloud data, identity, SaaS and AI agents.
  • Build the operating system for the business. Run on cadence, clear ownership and one source of truth, so leaders spend their time on strategy and outcomes, not status.
  • Drive deal excellence across every GSI motion, whether GSI-led, co-led or field-led. Bring the visibility and discipline to prioritize the right opportunities and win the technical decision.
  • Be the senior technical voice with GSI executives and COE leaders. Partner with Rubrik Product, Marketing, Sales and Alliances to turn what GSIs need to sell into what we build next.
  • Scale the partner field. Enable and certify GSI practitioners so partners can position and deliver Rubrik on their own.
  • Attract, develop and retain high-agency leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APJ, and build a deep bench.
  • Lead the team's AI transformation, with a clear productivity baseline, targets and new ways of working.

Why you will love this job:

  • Growth at scale. Rubrik has passed $1.6B in subscription ARR and is growing over 30% year over year.
  • A category we created. Cyber resilience started here, and the market now follows our lead.
  • Partners are a strategic priority, with executive sponsorship from the top and a seat at the table.
  • A real build. A strong foundation and a clear mandate to scale and shape a global organization.
  • The most exciting product shift in the industry. Identity resilience, SaaS data protection and Rubrik Agent Cloud give GSIs new services to build around.
  • Direct impact. Your offers and relationships will show up in pipeline and closed deals you can point to.
  • A team that moves fast, tries AI first, and rewards people who own outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 12+ years in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, partner engineering or a related technical go-to-market role.
  • 5+ years leading teams, including managing managers, with a global footprint across regions.
  • Proven track record of building repeatable solutions, blueprints or offers that the field and partners adopt at scale.
  • Experience designing KPIs, scorecards and operating cadences that drive behavior and outcomes.
  • Executive presence. You can earn credibility with senior leaders at GSIs and inside Rubrik.
  • Strong grasp of enterprise data, cloud or security. You will ramp quickly on Rubrik's platform.
  • Comfort with Salesforce and data-driven management of pipeline and deals.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working directly with GSIs or in alliance and partner organizations.
  • Background in cyber resilience, backup and recovery, identity, SaaS or AI and agentic systems.
  • Experience in both direct field and partner-led selling.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

jobs.description:

Key Responsibilities:

Pipeline and Revenue
  • Own a quarterly pipeline and bookings target for GSI-sourced and influenced Identity Resilience opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities in GSI installed bases: AD and Entra ID modernization, M&A and divestiture identity work, ransomware recovery readiness, and cyber insurance and regulatory programs.
  • Drive deals from first conversation to close alongside Rubrik AEs, SEs, and Regional Directors, using partner-sourced expansion (PSX) and new-logo (PSNL) plays.
  • Attach Identity Resilience to Cloud Resilience and data protection deals to expand deal size and strategic relevance.
  • Run a disciplined cadence: weekly forecast, deal reviews, and clean Salesforce hygiene (account categorization, partner attribution, deal registration).
GSI Engagement and Enablement
  • Build relationships across GSI identity and security practice leaders, cyber recovery and incident response teams, managed security services, and sellers.
  • Create a joint account plan per priority GSI: target accounts, executive sponsors, solution focus, and quarterly milestones.
  • Train and certify GSI sellers, architects, and delivery teams on Rubrik's identity value proposition, competitive positioning, and services attach.
  • Lead recurring pipeline reviews, win/loss reviews, and joint account mapping sessions.
Joint Solutions and Offerings
  • Co-create packaged offerings that bundle Rubrik Identity Resilience with GSI identity assessment, recovery planning, managed detection and response, and incident response services.
  • Work with Product, Product Marketing, and GSI practices on repeatable assets: solution briefs, reference architectures, recovery runbooks, pricing guidance, and SOWs.
  • Align identity resilience with Rubrik's cyber recovery and Cloud Resilience motions, including clean-room and orchestrated recovery of AD ,Entra ID and Okta
  • Help GSIs build managed-service and recurring-revenue models around Rubrik.
Ecosystem and Go-to-Market
  • Coordinate with Rubrik's Microsoft, security, and identity ecosystem partners on co-sell and field engagement, including Azure Marketplace and MACC-eligible purchasing where applicable.
  • Stay current on identity attack techniques, AD and Entra ID architecture, and compliance drivers; position Rubrik against native Microsoft capabilities and specialist identity recovery vendors.
  • Partner with Marketing and Partner Programs on joint campaigns, workshops (e.g., ransomware tabletop exercises), and executive briefings; support customer meetings and RFP/RFI responses.
  • Publish win stories and references, and relay field and partner feedback to Product and Sales Leadership.
Required Qualifications:
  • 10+ years in enterprise software, cybersecurity, or identity and data protection sales, including 5+ years in a partner, alliance, or GSI-facing role.

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Legion builds AI-powered workforce management software for enterprises that run hourly workforces in retail, hospitality, facilities management, and manufacturing.

We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Manager to own how our go-to-market team learns, sells, and improves. You'll build onboarding that shortens ramp, run the enablement cadence, launch new products to the field, and reinforce a consistent sales methodology. You'll measure all of it against productivity, win rate, and pipeline outcomes.

This is a builder role. You'll work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and RevOps, and you'll be the field's single point of contact for what to know and how to sell it.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Onboarding and ramp

  • Own new-hire onboarding for AEs, AMs, SDRs, and SCs, with clear milestones and visibility into ramp progress
  • Build role-based certifications that confirm readiness before reps run deals on their own

Curriculum and training

  • Design and deliver curriculum across five domains: company, function, industry, product, and selling skills
  • Map content to how reps work: manage, prospect, present, collaborate, sell, and deliver
  • Run the bi-weekly enablement session and feed the enablement segment of weekly team meetings

Sales methodology and process

  • Reinforce a consistent methodology and drive adherence to the sales process
  • Equip Account Executives for deal and forecast reviews
  • Build skills in prospecting

Content, playbooks, and knowledge

  • Build and maintain playbooks, competitive intelligence, and messaging by industry and persona
  • Own knowledge management so the field finds the right content fast

Partners and the wider GTM team

  • Enable partners on co-sell and âBetter Togetherâ storytelling
  • Extend enablement to CSMs, delivery, and support where it drives customer outcomes

Tools and measurement

  • Drive adoption and ROI of the sales tool stack, partnering with RevOps
  • Report enablement impact against ramp time, quota attainment, win rate, sales cycle, and pipeline progression

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS, with 3+ in sales or revenue enablement
  • Experience enabling enterprise sales teams on complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Working knowledge of a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC
  • Strong curriculum design and facilitation skills, live and virtual
  • Comfort with Salesforce and enablement or conversation-intelligence platforms
  • Ability to tie programs to revenue metrics and report on them
  • Clear writing and the credibility to coach AEs and work with executives

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • Background in workforce management, HCM, or software sold into retail, hospitality, facilities management, or manufacturing
  • Prior quota-carrying or solution consulting experience
  • Experience enabling channel or alliance partners
  • Experience running product launches with Product Marketing
  • Familiarity with AI products and helping sellers position them

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • 401k plan

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industryâs most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. Itâs proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.Â 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITYÂ 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

  • Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
  • Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
  • Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
  • Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
  • Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
  • Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
  • Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.

The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

  • Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
  • Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
  • A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact & Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

jobs.title: RF Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact and Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

jobs.title: Community Moderator - Wisdo (1099)
jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for a Community ModeratorÂ to join our team at Wisdo as an Independent Contractor (1099). The Community Moderator will help maintain safe, supportive, and inclusive spaces within the Wisdo Health communities. This role focuses on reviewing community content and user profiles, identifying safety concerns, and taking action according to established protocols. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and committed to helping members feel safe and supported.

This is a remote position based in the United States. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What Youâll Do

  • Review community content and user profiles using Wisdoâs moderation tools to identify potential safety concerns and Code of Conduct violations.
  • Take appropriate action on safety violations according to Wisdoâs established policies and procedures.
  • Ensure community posts, responses, and user profiles align with Wisdoâs Code of Conduct.
  • Model and promote supportive, respectful, and inclusive behavior within the community.
  • Identify and escalate safety concerns according to established safety escalation policies.
  • Provide appropriate crisis resources to members experiencing a crisis, following Wisdoâs safety protocols.
  • Maintain consistent safety standards across community spaces and document or report incidents as required.

About YouÂ 

  • Experience in online community moderation, content moderation, customer support, or a related role.
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to recognize potentially unsafe content and follow established safety protocols.
  • Comfortable working in online mental health and peer support environments in a non-clinical capacity.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle sensitive situations with care and professionalism.
  • Self-directed and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Must reside in the United States.
  • Must have reliable internet access and personal laptop or desktop computer.
  • Availability to work Saturday through Tuesday, 8:00 PMâ2:00 AM EST.

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The hourly rate for this role is $15 an hour. Estimated 24 hours per week, Saturday through Tuesday, 8:00 PMâ2:00 AM EST.

About Wisdo
Wisdo is an evidence-based peer support and social health platform designed to reduce the devastating consequences of loneliness and social isolation on mental health outcomes, engagement rates, and overall costs. Learn more at www.wisdo.com.

Why Talkspace?Â 

Talkspace is the worldâs leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the worldâs population â 2 billion people â live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind âgetting help,â we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverseÂ  âfor purposeâ space. If youâre equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you donât meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional â such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record â if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?Â 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.Â  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

About the role

At Airtable, we are passionate about how our product democratizes software creation and empowers teams to build applications that connect their organization and drive outcomes, no code needed. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the post-sales owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding them from onboarding through renewal as they adopt Airtable and our AI capabilities. You will help customers turn AI adoption and workflow innovation into measurable business outcomes, and you will partner closely with Account Executives so they can focus on growth.

Customer Success at Airtable sits at the nexus of our Sales, Product and Marketing teams. We hire Customer Success Managers into one of two teams (Scaled and High Touch), depending on your experience and where our team needs you most. We will talk with you about which team is the best fit during the interview process.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the post-sales point of contact for your accounts, guiding customers to the right answer or the right Airtable team when you cannot resolve something yourself
  • Drive onboarding excellence, working with customers on a mutual plan so their primary workflows launch within 90 days, with governance and best practices in place from the start

  • Qualify expansion opportunities and hand them to your Account Executive with context
  • Maintain a current account record: use cases, success stories, ROI and a stakeholder map, refreshed quarterly
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating usage and feedback into insights that shape our product and AI roadmap, and partner with Marketing and Product on customer stories
  • Develop reusable frameworks, AI-enabled health insights and playbooks that scale customer impact across the enterprise segment

jobs.title: Head of Channel Sales & Alliances
jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of Channel Sales & Alliances

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

Weâre building the industryâs first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, weâd love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Own the partner channel that sources a meaningful share of Salesloftâs new closed-won revenue.

As our Head of Channel Sales & Alliances, you'll build and run a quota-carrying Channel Sales & Alliances organization focused on four motions: private equity partnerships, cloud marketplace and strategic platform alliances, ISV and MCP partnerships, and VAR, BPO, and services partnerships. The primary measure is closed-won revenue sourced through partners, supported by partner-influenced revenue and the retention and expansion of partner-sourced customers. Relationships, programs, and pipelines are critical in producing signed deals. You will be the executive face of Salesloft to our most strategic partners and the owner of the plan, the team, and the results.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

Private Equity Partnerships

  • Build relationships with private equity firms and their operating partners to position Salesloft as the revenue platform for their portfolio companies.
  • Structure portfolio-wide agreements and programs that turn a firm-level relationship into sourced, closed-won deals across multiple portfolio companies.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to run portfolio-specific plays, from the initial introduction through close.

Cloud Marketplace and Strategic Platform Alliances

  • Own Salesloft's go-to-market with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including marketplace listings, private offers, and co-sell programs that let customers buy against their existing cloud commitments.
  • Build strategic alliances with the CRM and productivity platforms our customers run on, such as Salesforce, Microsoft, and HubSpot, including their app and agent marketplaces.
  • Turn platform relationships into sourced and co-sold pipeline by aligning with these partners' field sellers, not only their partner teams.

ISV and MCP Partnerships

  • Identify, recruit, and sign independent software vendors and AI platforms that integrate with, embed, or distribute Salesloft, including through MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and agent ecosystems.
  • Define co-sell and co-marketing motions with ISV partners so that integrations produce sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, not only technical listings.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to shape the partner integration roadmap and make sure partners can build, launch, and sell with confidence.
  • Design partner economics for AI and agent partners, including revenue share on usage- and consumption-based pricing alongside seat-based models.

VAR, BPO, and Services Partnerships

  • Recruit and onboard value-added resellers and business process outsourcing providers that resell, bundle, or deliver Salesloft as part of their sales services.
  • Recruit systems integrators and RevOps consultancies that influence enterprise buying decisions and deliver implementations, and build a services partner motion that speeds time to value and improves retention.
  • Negotiate reseller and partner agreements, pricing, margin structures, and business terms that support profitable, repeatable revenue.
  • Equip partner sellers with value-selling playbooks, competitive positioning, and qualification criteria so deals are sourced and closed consistently.

HOW YOUâLL WORK HERE

  • Move as One: Youâll partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps on joint plays and partner attribution, and share credit for partner-sourced wins.
  • Evidence over Ego: Youâll plan, forecast, and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue using real signals, and say so when the data changes your mind.
  • Lead from the Front: Youâll be the executive face of Salesloft to strategic partners and set the quotas, coverage models, and standards your team is held to.
  • Make Your Mark: Youâll shape how Salesloft shows up in private equity, cloud marketplaces, ISV and MCP ecosystems, and services channels, not just run the playbook.

WHAT WEâRE LOOKING FOR
Youâre a senior partner and alliances leader who has sourced and closed partner-driven revenue in B2B SaaS and led teams to quota. You build the relationships and programs that turn into signed deals, and you are credible with C-level partners and technical teams alike. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOUâLL BRING

  • 12+ years of experience in partner sales, channel sales, alliances, or business development in B2B SaaS, with senior leadership experience managing teams
  • A track record of sourcing and closing partner-driven revenue and meeting or exceeding quota, with results you can describe in terms of closed-won revenue
  • Experience building or working with private equity relationships, ISV or technology integration partnerships, cloud marketplace and co-sell programs with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, or VAR, BPO, and services channel programs. Experience in more than one of these is strongly preferred
  • Experience building a partner program from the ground up, or rebuilding one after a merger or acquisition
  • An established network of private equity operating partners and portfolio company leaders
  • Familiarity with AI, API, and MCP-based integration ecosystems, and the ability to talk credibly with technical partners about how Salesloft fits
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex partner, reseller, and revenue-sharing agreements
  • Ability to coach and lead a team, including setting quotas and holding people accountable to them
  • Strong sales acumen and fluency with CRM and partner tools such as Salesforce, partner relationship management platforms, and account-mapping tools, including building partner attribution models. SaaS experience is required
  • Executive presence, including comfort presenting at conferences, events, and webinars and influencing C-suite stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams

THE TEAM
Youâll lead the Channel Sales & Alliances team of partner sales and alliance professionals and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps. Itâs a place to grow as the executive owner of a channel plan, a team, and the results.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview atÂ  https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If youâre excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Stillingen indebærer både dag-, aften- og weekendvagter.

  • Tilberedning og produktion af kolde og varme retter

  • Kvalitetskontrol af råvarer og færdige retter

  • Varebestilling, lagerstyring og fokus på råvareforbrug

  • Støtte, motivere og vejlede køkkenteamet under både daglig drift og travle serviceperioder

  • Bidrage aktivt til menuudvikling og optimering af køkkenets arbejdsgange

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har solid erfaring som kok, gerne med erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Har en passion for mad, kvalitet og gode råvarer

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og har naturlige lederegenskaber

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og træffe beslutninger

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher, Computational Space Physics
jobs.description: The Department of Physics at the Faculty of Science invites applications foraPOSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHERIN COMPUTATIONAL SPACE PHYSICSThe start time of the position is in early 2027.BackgroundThe WAVESTORMS team at the Department of Physics, University of Helsinki, is led by Associate Professor Lucile Turc. The groups research focuses on dayside magnetosphere interactions, and in particular on foreshock processes, their contribution to wave activity and particle acceleration, and their global impact on near-Earth space. Our analyses are based on a combination of multi-point measurements and numerical simulations. Simulations are conducted using the global hybrid-Vlasov model Vlasiator, developed in the Space Physics group at the University of Helsinki. We are now extending our simulations to Mercurys environment, and we are thus seeking a new team member to join us for this new project.Postdoctoral researcher positionWe are seeking a postdoctoral researcher with prior expertise in developing numerical plasma simulations and a strong academic track record. The applicant should hold a PhD in space plasma physics or a related field by the time they join the team. Other skills that will be considered an asset for the position include coding in C++, analysis of planetary plasma data, and knowledge of shock physics and/or particle acceleration.The main tasks of the successful candidate will be to implement dynamic boundary conditions to the Vlasiator code and to conduct scientific analysis of the simulations on topics related to foreshock physics at Mercury. The project will also include active collaborations with scientists involved in the BepiColombo mission, and funding is available for research visits and travel to international conferences.The position is initially for 2 years and can be extended further. The employment contract will include a probationary period of six months.Research environmentThe Space Physics Group of the University of Helsinki is a leading European space physics group specialised both in observations and numerical modelling of space plasmas. The group provides ample opportunities to develop technical and transferable skills relevant to academic research and beyond.Finland is a member of EU, has high quality free schooling (also in English), generous family benefits and healthcare and was recently ranked as the best country in the world for expat families. Finland and the Helsinki region possess top expertise in sciences in terms of a vibrant talent pool, leading research, strong support services and functioning collaboration networks. For more information about working at the University of Helsinki and living in Finland, please seehttps://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university.The starting salary of the postdoctoral researcher will be ca. 3900-4100/month, depending on the appointees qualifications and experience. Furthermore, the University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care and health insurance, sports facilities, and opportunities for professional development.The University of Helsinki welcomes applicants from a variety of gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds.How to applyPlease apply with; * a one-pagemotivation letter highlighting the candidates research interests, achievements and prior experience with numerical simulations * a CV * a publication list with a brief (ca. two lines) discussion of the role played by the candidate in each publication.Please submit all files using the University of Helsinki Recruitment System by clicking the Apply for the position button below (button Apply now).The deadline for applications is 15th December 2026.The selected candidates will be contacted personally and will be invited for an interview/discussion.For further information, please contact Associate Professor Lucile Turc, lucile.turc(at)helsinki.fi.If you have questions related to the recruitment system, please contact recruitment@helsinki.fi.Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen opiskelu- ja työkulttuuri ovat meille tärkeitä. Sen vuoksi teemme parhaamme edistääksemme inklusiivista yliopistoyhteisöä. Kannustamme kaikkia osaavia ja eritaustaisia hakijoita hakemaan tehtäviämme.Tästä linkistä pääset lukemaan yliopistomme esteettömyydestä ja saavutettavuudesta.TULE KANSSAMME TEKEMÄÄN TYÖTÄ MAAILMAN PARHAAKSI – YHDESSÄ!#helsinkiunicareers

jobs.title: Restaurantdriftsleder / Restaurant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

  • Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

  • Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

  • Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

  • Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

  • Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

  • Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

  • Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

  • Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

  • Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

  • Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

  • Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

  • Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

  • Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

  • Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

  • Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

  • A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

Restaurantdriftsleder

Om os

Hos Bagel Bites mener vi, at god mad, fremragende kundeservice og effektiv restaurantledelse går hånd i hånd.

Efter en mindre omstrukturering af vores ledelsesteam søger vi nu en ansvarsbevidst, motiveret og fleksibel medarbejder, der kan varetage ansvaret for restaurantens daglige drift.

Stillingen omfatter en kombination af restaurantledelse, køkkenarbejde, kundeservice, indkøb og administrative opgaver. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på at deltage aktivt i alle dele af restaurantens drift, herunder også praktisk arbejde i køkkenet.

  • At administrere lagerbeholdningen, overvåge lagerstatus og sikre, at de nødvendige råvarer altid er tilgængelige.

  • At varetage kundeservice, modtage bestillinger og håndtere kundehenvendelser og eventuelle klager.

  • At udvikle og gennemføre markedsføringsinitiativer med henblik på at promovere restauranten.

  • At administrere virksomhedens sociale medier og online tilstedeværelse.

  • At bidrage til økonomiske og administrative opgaver, herunder budgettering, overvågning af omsætning, rapportering og grundlæggende regnskabsopgaver.

  • At sikre, at gældende fødevaresikkerhedsregler, hygiejnekrav og virksomhedens interne procedurer overholdes.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi søger en kandidat, der har følgende kvalifikationer og kompetencer:

  • Relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring inden for restaurantledelse, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen eller fødevarebranchen.

  • Gode organisatoriske og ledelsesmæssige evner samt erfaring med personaleledelse og uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver.

  • En fleksibel og praktisk tilgang til arbejdet samt villighed til både at varetage ledelsesmæssige opgaver og deltage aktivt i køkkenets daglige arbejde.

jobs.title: PYP Coordinator & Concept-Based Inquiry Instructional Leader
jobs.description: Are you an experienced PYP educator who is passionate about concept-based inquiry, collaborative professional learning and helping teachers strengthen their practice?The International School of Helsinki is seeking a dedicated and collaborative **PYP Coordinator & Concept-Based Inquiry Instructional Leader** to join our vibrant IB World School.This is a full-time, permanent position combining PYP programme coordination with hands-on instructional coaching. Serve as the school's PYP liaison with the International Baccalaureate, coordinating programme communications, documentation, evaluation processes and follow-up. - Facilitate the ongoing development of the Programme of Inquiry, curriculum documentation and collaborative planning processes, strengthening conceptual progression, curriculum coherence and authentic transdisciplinary learning. - Coordinate and support the planning and implementation of the PYP Exhibition, promoting student inquiry, agency, reflection and meaningful action. - Plan and facilitate professional learning and parent workshops in collaboration with the PYP Directors, responding to programme priorities and the needs of teachers and families. - Work alongside teachers through instructional coaching, collaborative planning, classroom observation, co-teaching, modelling and reflective professional dialogue. - Support teachers at different stages of their PYP journey through differentiated coaching approaches that foster trust, professional curiosity, reflection and continuous growth. - Strengthen concept-based and inquiry-driven teaching and learning, supporting teachers in developing conceptual understanding, purposeful inquiry, student agency, intentional teaching and responsive differentiation. - Collaborate with homeroom and specialist teachers to develop authentic transdisciplinary connections while respecting the integrity of individual disciplines. - Support the development of effective assessment practices, including success criteria, formative assessment, student reflection, feedback and the use of evidence to inform teaching and learning. - Promote inclusive and multilingual approaches to teaching and learning that recognise and value students' diverse identities, languages, experiences and needs. - Partner and collaborate with the PYP Directors, MYP and DP Instructional Leaders and teaching teams to identify shared pedagogical priorities, coordinate professional learning and support coherent approaches to curriculum, instruction and assessment across the PYP and beyond. - Uphold the school's commitment to student wellbeing, child protection and safeguarding, following all relevant policies and reporting procedures. **What We Offer**This role provides meaningful opportunities to impact quality of learning, collaboration and contribution within a vibrant international learning community. At ISH, our values of Care, Curiosity, Courage and Connection shape how we learn, work and grow together. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities and a supportive environment where colleagues are encouraged to collaborate, inquire, take initiative and contribute to our shared commitment to high-quality teaching and learning.**Salary:**Compensation is determined by qualification and years of relevant experience, aligned with the ISH Teachers Salary scale + leadership stipend. For candidates meeting the minimum qualification with 5 years experience, the monthly salary is 4600 €.**Qualifications & Experience**- A recognised teaching qualification and a university degree in elementary or primary education, or a closely related field. - A minimum of five years of successful teaching experience within the IB Primary Years Programme. - Demonstrated expertise in concept-based and inquiry-driven teaching and learning, with a strong understanding of PYP curriculum, assessment and programme requirements. - Experience in PYP programme coordination, curriculum development, collaborative planning and facilitating professional learning. - Demonstrated ability to coach, guide and support colleagues through modelling effective practice, co-teaching, feedback and reflective professional dialogue. - Strong interpersonal, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to build trusting, collaborative professional relationships. - Understanding of multilingual development and experience supporting students learning in second or additional languages. - Experience working within international school communities, with strong intercultural awareness and a commitment to inclusion and diversity. - Excellent spoken and written English. - Preferred experience using Toddle to support collaborative planning, curriculum documentation, assessment and reporting is desirable. - A reflective, flexible and collaborative approach, with the initiative and commitment to contribute positively to ongoing school improvement. **Child Protection & Safeguarding** ISH is committed to the highest standards of safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.
