jobs.description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.Â We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal â not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most.

Your Area of Focus

  • Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.
  • Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.
  • Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins.
  • Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support.
  • Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check.
  • Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections.
  • Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards.
  • Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production.
  • SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets.
  • Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams.
  • Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt.
  • Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.
  • Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation.
  • Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.
  • Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred.
  • Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred.
  • Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.
  • Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus.
  • Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred.

jobs.title: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Documented education as engineer or technician

  • Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

  • Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

  • Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

  • Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**TyötehtäväsiHuskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen - moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta - asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin - huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät - varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito - asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä Mitä odotamme sinulta?Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.Mitä tarjoamme?Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

jobs.title: Myyntineuvottelija
jobs.description: **Haussa on** määräaikainen ja kokoaikainen (112,5 h/3 vko)**MYYNTINEUVOTTELIJA, KSO Myyntipalvelu.****Myyntineuvottelijan työssä** vastaat omalta osaltasi Kymen Seudun Osuuskaupan majoitus-, kokous- ja ravitsemispalveluiden myymisestä ja varaamisesta sekä puhelimitse että sähköpostitse. Myyntipalvelu toimii myös monipuolisesti liiketoiminnan tukena esimerkiksi räätälöityjen ratkaisujen rakentamiseen asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaisesti sekä laskutuksiin liittyen.Meillä ollaan ihan tavallisissa töissä. Kenenkään ei tarvitse pystyä ihmetekoihin eikä olla aina paras versio itsestään. Riittää, että arvostat tavallista työtä ja ymmärrät työn merkityksellisyyden asiakkaidemme näkökulmasta – toimien sen mukaisesti!**Toivomme hakijalta:**- Alalle soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. restonomi tai tradenomi). Eduksi katsomme lisäksi matkailualan kokemuksen ja/tai kokemuksen myyntityöstä. - Hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia, sillä työssä käytetään useita erilaisia järjestelmiä. Perehdytämme uuden työntekijän käyttämiimme järjestelmiin, mutta odotamme, että esim. Wordin, Outlookin ja Excelin käyttö sujuu jo ennestään. - Halua oppia uutta. Myyntineuvottelijamme hallitsevat suuria kokonaisuuksia pyrkien aktiivisesti ratkaisemaan käytännön ongelmia tietoa luovasti etsien ja sitä soveltaen. - Hyvää paineensietokykyä ja organisointitaitoja. Et siis hätkähdä kiirettä, kauhistu sähköpostiviestien määrää tai tiuhaan tahtiin soivaa puhelinta. Hallitset nopeasti muuttuvia tilanteita ja pystyt priorisoimaan tekemisiäsi. - Aitoa asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä hyviä viestintätaitoja. Asiakkaan on saatava laadukasta palvelua sekä puhelimitse että sähköpostitse. Myös tiimin kanssa toimiminen on sinulle helppoa. Työtä tehdään arkisin ma-pe klo 8–17 Kouvolan Prismalla myyntipalvelun tiloissa. Etätyömahdollisuutta ei tässä tehtävässä ole. Myyntineuvottelijalta edellytämme sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme valituille henkilöille:**- Monipuolisen ja kiinnostavan työtehtävän Kymen Seudun Osuuskaupan palveluiden parissa. - Sopimuksen mukaan alkavan määräaikaisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen, joka jatkuu syyskuun 2027 loppuun saakka. - Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan työehtosopimukseen mukaisen kuukausipalkan (2480-2692 €), jonka suuruuteen aiempi työkokemuksesi vaikuttaa. - S-ryhmän epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut, jotka saat käyttöösi heti työsuhteen alkaessa. **Lisätiedot ja rekrytoinnin aikataulu**- Haku päättyy 6.12.2026. Kaikki hakemukset tulee jättää suoraan rekrytointijärjestelmäämme oheista linkkiä käyttäen. Sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia emme käsittele erikseen. - Loppuvaiheen hakijoilta saatamme odottaa osallistumista soveltuvuusarviointiin osana rekrytointiprosessia. - Lisätietoja antaa myyntiryhmän päällikkö Marko Kokko p. 010 7635 613 pe 27.11. klo 9-10 ja pe 4.12. klo 13-14.

jobs.title: Dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejder til nordisk virksomhed i Malaga, Spanien
jobs.description:
Kundeservicespecialist (Dansktalende) – Malaga, Spanien

Drømmer du om en international karriere inden for kundeservice i et dynamisk og multikulturelt arbejdsmiljø? Har du stærke kommunikationsevner på både dansk og engelsk, og motiveres du af at levere en professionel kundeoplevelse?

Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicespecialister til en nordisk virksomhed med kontor i hjertet af Malaga. Du bliver en del af et dansk team, hvor samarbejde, trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø er i fokus. Virksomheden arbejder med spændende projekter og tilbyder gode udviklingsmuligheder i internationale rammer.

Som kundeservicespecialist bliver du kundernes primære kontaktperson og vil blandt andet:

  • Yde professionel kundeservice via telefon, e-mail og chat på dansk og engelsk.

  • Besvare kundehenvendelser og sikre en effektiv og korrekt håndtering af forespørgsler.

  • Opbygge gode kunderelationer gennem en venlig, løsningsorienteret og professionel dialog.

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og bidrage aktivt til et positivt og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø.

  • Følge interne procedurer og bidrage med konstruktiv feedback til løbende forbedringer.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk (minimum C1).

  • Har gode engelskkundskaber (minimum B2).

  • Erfaring med kundeservice er et plus – eller har en stærk motivation for at arbejde med kunder.

  • Har en løsningsorienteret tilgang og trives med at hjælpe andre.

  • Er nysgerrig på at bo og arbejde i Malaga.

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til teamet.

  • Har teknisk forståelse – dette er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende international karrieremulighed i Malaga.

  • Et stærkt dansk team og et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø.

  • Grundig oplæring og gode udviklingsmuligheder.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med en innovativ branche

  • Fuldtidskontrakt og fastansættelse

Startdato: ASAP

Bemærk: Kun kandidater med EU-statsborgerskab eller gyldig arbejdstilladelse i Spanien vil blive taget i betragtning.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Send dit CV til olivera@globalcareerrecruitment.com allerede i dag. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så søg allerede nu! Vi ser frem til at fortælle dig mere om mulighederne i Malaga.___Global Career values diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, religion, ethnic background, or other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Hotel Javri - Vastaanottovirkailija/tarjoilija
jobs.description: _Tule talveksi Saariselälle!__Haluaisitko viettää talven keskellä upeita Lapin maisemia, kansallispuiston naapurissa ja revontulten alla? Meillä olisi tarjolla paikka pienessä ja mukavassa porukassa Saariselällä.__Olemme 12 huoneen perheomisteinen hotelli aivan Urho Kekkosen kansallispuiston vieressä. Vieraamme saapuvat meille kaikkialta maailmasta, erityisesti Euroopasta, Australiasta ja USA:sta, etsimään aitoa Lapin tunnelmaa. Nyt etsimme joukkoomme vastaanottovirkailijaa talvikaudeksi.__Työ meillä on monipuolista. Vastaanotossa huolehdit asiakkaiden saapumisista, lähdöistä ja päivittäisestä asiakaspalvelusta, mutta pääset tekemään myös tarjoilijan tehtäviä ja osallistumaan hotellin arkeen laajemminkin. Pienessä hotellissa jokainen päivä on vähän erilainen, ja kaikki auttavat toisiaan.__Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta tai vastaanottotyöstä auttaa tehtävässä, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme hyvää asennetta. Jos olet iloinen, oma-aloitteinen ja viihdyt ihmisten parissa, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö. Pienessä tiimissä pärjää henkilö, joka tarttuu reippaasti toimeen ja nauttii yhteistyöstä._**_Tarjoamme sinulle:_**- mahdollisuuden viettää talvikausi Lapissa - mukavan ja kansainvälisen työyhteisön - monipuolisen työn matkailualalla - työsuhdeasunnon _Jos ajatus talvesta Saariselällä kuulostaa omalta, kuulisimme sinusta mielellämme!_

jobs.title: Projektleder
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger en projektleder, der tager ansvar for det samlede projektresultat. Du skaber overblik, får aftaler omsat til handling og sikrer, at kunden får den aftalte leverance til tiden og inden for projektets økonomiske ramme.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for kommerciel projektledelse og motiveres af at skabe fremdrift og få opgaver, mennesker og aftaler til at hænge sammen.

  • Trives i et tværfagligt team, hvor du samler forskellige fagligheder om et fælles mål.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projekter med kundetilpassede robotløsninger og ansvar for både forløbet og resultatet.

Stillingen

Som Projektleder har du det samlede ansvar fra overdragelsen fra salg til projektets afslutning og evaluering. Du styrer tidsplan, økonomi og samlet fremdrift og har ansvaret for kunderelationen, ændringsstyringen og projektets samlede risikobillede.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger i salg og de øvrige fagområder. Vores tekniske projektarkitekt er din sparringspartner og afklarer løsningskonceptet og de tekniske risici. Du samler indsatserne og sikrer, at de understøtter projektets mål.

Du definerer projektets ressourcebehov, følger op på milepælene og reagerer, når noget påvirker leverancen.

Eksempler på dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Sikre en struktureret overdragelse fra salg og afklare projektets omfang, kundekrav, budget, forudsætninger og åbne punkter.

  • Afklare projektets ressourcer, tidsplaner og budget i tæt samarbejde med den tekniske projektarkitekt.

  • Udarbejde og opdatere projektplanen med tydelige milepæle, ansvar og deadlines samt koordinere ressource- og kompetencebehov.

  • Varetage kundedialogen, afstemme forventninger og følge op på kundens beslutninger og leverancer.

  • Håndtere ændringer og deres konsekvenser for tid, økonomi, ressourcer og kunde.

  • Planlægge dokumentationsleverancer fra projekts opstart og følge op på, at de bliver klar som aftalt.

  • Rapportere projektstatus, håndtere projektrisici og sikre rettidig handling.

Du arbejder efter Danrobotics’ projektmodel og bidrager med erfaringer og forbedringsforslag til vores projektgennemførelse.

Din profil

Du har erfaring med projektledelse af tekniske leverancer og med at koordinere flere fagområder gennem et samlet projektforløb.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Styrer tidsplaner, milepæle og projektøkonomi og følger op på de aftalte mål.

  • Skaber tydelig retning og engagement, så teamet tager ansvar og leverer de aftalte resultater.

  • Har erfaring med kundedialog og sikrer klar forventningsafstemning undervejs.

  • Arbejder systematisk med risici, ændringer og dokumentation.

  • Omsætter projektstatus til konkrete prioriteringer og handlinger.

  • Kommunikerer på dansk og engelsk. Tysk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du kombinerer et kommercielt mindset med teknisk forståelse og inddrager specialisternes viden, når du træffer beslutninger i projektet.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Danrobotics får du ansvar for det samlede projektresultat og mandat til at drive projekterne og træffe beslutninger inden for de aftalte rammer. Du får tæt samarbejde med tekniske specialister og kolleger, der udvikler og bygger løsningerne. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke vores projektarbejde og bruge dine erfaringer til at forbedre både samarbejdet og kommende leverancer.

Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse.

Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer.

Praktisk information

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Bodil Koertsen: bk@danrobotics.dk

Du er velkommen til at ringe og høre nærmere om stillingen ved Bodil Koertsen, telefon +45 61 24 33 89.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Kort om Danrobotics

Danrobotics har hovedkontor i Middelfart, tæt på motorvejen, og et datterselskab i Neumünster, Tyskland. Vi leverer robotløsninger til industrien – fra simple automatiseringsopgaver til store, komplekse løsninger, der omfatter hele produktionslinjer. Derudover tilbyder vi service og vedligeholdelse af alle typer robotanlæg.

Vi er 38 engagerede medarbejdere, der brænder for at udvikler, installerer og servicerer værdiskabende løsninger inden for robotteknologi og automatisering til industrivirksomheder i både Danmark og udlandet. Vi samarbejder med nogle af branchens førende leverandører for at sikre vores kunder de bedste løsninger. Læs mere om Danrobotics her.

jobs.title: Psykolog
jobs.description: Vill du arbeta med psykologutredningar inom psykiatrisk specialsjukvård? Ålands hälso- och sjukvård (ÅHS) lediganslår ett vikariat som psykolog vid psykiatriska kliniken.Om tjänsten Psykiatriska kliniken ansvarar för den psykiatriska specialsjukvården för vuxna på Åland. Som psykolog arbetar du huvudsakligen med psykologutredningar i samarbete med klinikens övriga psykologer. I arbetet ingår bland annat semistrukturerade intervjuer, psykometriska tester och sammanställning av utlåtanden. Du deltar även i nätverksmöten och samarbetar med andra yrkesgrupper, såsom läkare, ergoterapeuter och sjukskötare. Vikariatet avser frånvaro under föräldraledighet och pågår under perioden 4.1. – 4.11.2027 med tillträde 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Din kompetens och erfarenhet Vi söker dig som är legitimerad psykolog med behörighet att arbeta i Finland (FFS 559/94). Du har ett intresse för psykiatri och ett professionellt förhållningssätt. Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är flexibel och vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vid urvalet kommer vi att fästa vikt vid de sökandes personliga egenskaper, lämplighet för arbetsuppgiften samt intervjutillfällena. Anställningsvillkor Tjänsten är ett tidsbundet vikariat där arbetstiden är veckoarbete, 38,25 timmar i veckan med flextid. Arbetsspråket är svenska. Grundlön för tjänsten är 4 925,36 euro och med fulla erfarenhetstillägg 5 954,48 euro. Övriga anställningsvillkor följer tjänstekollektivavtalet TKA. Uppgiften kräver vaccinationsskydd enligt 48 § Lag om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016). Nyfiken på att bo och arbeta på Åland? På Åland kan du välja mellan att bo i småstad eller skärgårdsmiljö, med närhet till både Stockholm och Helsingfors. På Åland Living hittar du mer information om livet på Åland och praktiskt stöd inför en eventuell flytt: www.alandliving.ax. Välkommen med din ansökan! Hos oss får du arbeta tillsammans med kollegor från olika yrkesgrupper med patienten i fokus. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Ansök via Kuntarekry senast 4.12.2026 kl. 15:00. Vill du veta mer? Kontakta klinikchef Sirpa Mankinen, tfn +358 (0) 18 53 8613 eller e-post sirpa.mankinen@ahs.ax.

jobs.title: Principal Pre-Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Lysaker, Norway (with a planned move to Kongsberg)Business Unit: EMS / Engineering (I&C)Contract Duration: 6 monthsExpected Start Date: 1 December 2026Application Deadline: 20 November 2026

About the Role

Are you an experienced Pre-Commissioning Engineer with strong expertise in subsea pipelines and umbilical systems?

We are seeking a senior engineer to provide technical expertise across subsea pre-commissioning projects, tenders, studies and offshore operations. You will focus on pipeline and umbilical testing, engineering assurance and execution planning, contributing throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review pre-commissioning philosophies, procedures and execution strategies.

  • Lead engineering activities covering FCG, hydrotesting, leak testing, flushing, dewatering, drying and preservation.

  • Define pigging strategies, including pig selection, configuration, pressure requirements and contingency plans.

  • Specify temporary equipment requirements, including pumps, filtration units, tanks, compressors and testing equipment.

  • Review pipeline and subsea designs, subcontractor procedures, methodologies and proposed equipment spreads.

  • Develop umbilical testing procedures covering electrical, fibre-optic and hydraulic systems, including continuity, insulation resistance, OTDR and pressure testing.

  • Evaluate test results and support system acceptance and handover.

  • Coordinate technical interfaces with Umbilical, SPS, Controls, Installation and offshore teams.

  • Provide engineering support during project preparation, mobilisation and offshore execution.

  • Support vessel-based operations, troubleshoot technical issues and assess operational and test data.

  • Conduct technical reviews, risk assessments and readiness assessments.

  • Provide technical assurance for assigned scopes, review critical deliverables and support the qualification of equipment and methods.

  • Contribute to tenders and studies through execution concepts, scope definition, equipment specifications, man-hour estimates and technical evaluations.

  • Provide input on vessel selection, deck requirements, schedules and offshore duration.

  • Guide and mentor engineers while contributing to procedures, technical tools, documentation and lessons learned.

Qualifications and ExperienceMust-Have Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical, Marine, Subsea, Offshore, Petroleum Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Relevant experience in subsea and pipeline pre-commissioning engineering.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in:

    • Flooding, Cleaning and Gauging (FCG) and pigging.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
About the position

A permanent position as Senior engineer (position code 1181) is available at The Department of Physics, University of Oslo.

Starting date as soon as possible. 

Place of work is Department of Physics at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description and work tasks

The Electronics section has seven academic positions (two full-time and five part-time) and two technical positions. The research activity is currently largely related to projects in medical technology, particularly those using methods based on impedance spectroscopy. The successful candidate may also provide technical support for new research activities in electronic components and neuromorphic electronics, especially related to electrical characterization, measurement setups, and laboratory infrastructure. 

Together with the Department of Informatics, the section is responsible for a study program in electronics, informatics, and technology. The academic staff are therefore responsible for several courses in electronics and sensor technology and also contribute to teaching basic physics courses. The section’s staff are also involved in the supervision of students at both master’s and doctoral level. 

The engineering position is intended to support both the research and teaching activities in which the section is involved. 

The tasks connected to teaching will primarily involve training and assisting master’s and PhD students in the use of specialized measuring instruments and software. 

Part of the position also involves organizing the section’s student laboratories. This includes testing of hardware and software, as well as other typical engineering tasks related to the day to-day operation of the laboratories.

What skills are important in this role?

Qualification requirements:

The minimum educational requirement is a master’s degree (or equivalent) in electronics/electrical engineering. In addition, the candidate must have experience with: 

  • Instrumentation, measurement systems, and laboratory work 
  • Impedance spectroscopy and interpretation of bioimpedance data 
  • Programming in Python and MATLAB, or equivalent 
  • Finite element modelling, e.g. COMSOL Multiphysics 
  • Good oral and written English skills

The following qualifications are strongly desirable and will be emphasized in the evaluation process: 

  • Research experience, preferably demonstrated through a PhD degree 
  • Use of various sensors for monitoring food quality, such as colorimetry, pH measurements, and NIR spectrometry 
  • Electrical characterization of semiconductor devices or other electronic components, preferably including low-current and/or pulsed measurements 
  • Automation and integration of laboratory instruments and measurement systems 
  • Technical supervision of students
What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A service minded attitude 
  • Ability to work independently 
  • Ability to work precisely in a structured and solution-oriented manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills 
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods 
  • Have a safety-oriented attitude

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.

We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Senior Engineer, position code 1181 in salary range NOK 700 000 – 775 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We especially encourage women to apply.We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter with a statement of motivation
  • CV (complete overview of education and work experience)
  • Copies of educational certificates and transcript of records
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (names, relation to candidate and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department of Physics covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

Helges Ost & Bageri ApS

We are looking for a skilled and responsible Head Baker to lead and coordinate our night-time bakery production and supervise the bakery team.

As Head Baker, you will be responsible for the daily night production, ensuring that our products meet our quality standards and that production runs efficiently and smoothly.

You will take an active part in the production while supervising and coordinating the work of other bakery employees. You will be responsible for daily task allocation, staff scheduling and ensuring that the team performs its duties correctly and efficiently.

Leading and coordinating daily night-time bakery production.

Actively participating in baking bread, rolls and other bakery products.

Supervising bakery employees and ensuring that tasks are performed correctly and according to established standards.

Planning staff schedules and coordinating shift coverage.

Distributing daily tasks and monitoring employee performance.

Training and guiding bakery employees in production methods, quality standards and daily routines.

Maintaining consistent product quality and ensuring compliance with recipes and production procedures.

Ensuring efficient workflows and timely completion of production.

Monitoring compliance with hygiene, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

Maintaining cleanliness and order in the bakery.

Reporting operational issues and staffing needs to management.

Be a qualified baker or have solid professional experience in bakery production.

Responsibility for coordinating the night production and supervising the bakery team.

Salary based on qualifications and experience.

The opportunity to become an important part of a dedicated bakery team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now

  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Vil du kombinere salg, kundekontakt og interesse for lastebilbransjen
jobs.description:
Den beste feilen er den som aldri oppstår. For kundene våre handler en lastebil om langt mer enn transport. Den skal starte hver dag, levere som planlagt og være på veien når kunden trenger den. Når service, kontroller eller nødvendige reparasjoner blir utsatt, kan det raskt føre til driftsstans og unødvendige kostnader.I Norsk Scania ønsker vi å være i forkant. Derfor ser vi nå etter en Account Manager, Rolling Fleet som vil bidra til å utvikle kundeoppfølgingen vår, identifisere nye salgsmuligheter og sørge for at kundene får mest mulig ut av kjøretøyene sine.Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som trives med kundekontakt, motiveres av salg og liker å finne løsninger som skaper verdi for både kunden og Scania.Om rollenSom Account Manager Rolling Fleet får du en sentral rolle i oppfølgingen av våre eksisterende kunder og deres kjøretøy.Ved hjelp av kunde- og kjøretøydata skal du identifisere behov, se salgsmuligheter og tilby løsninger som bidrar til økt oppetid og en mer effektiv drift for kundene våre.Du vil ha tett dialog med kundene og samarbeide med våre verksteder, kundemottakere og salgsorganisasjonen for å sikre at behov blir fulgt opp og omgjort til konkrete salg og verkstedoppdrag.Dette er en spennende rolle for deg som vil kombinere salg, relasjonsbygging og interesse for transportbransjen.ArbeidsstedStillingen vil ha kontorsted ved et av våre Scania-anlegg på Østlandet. Vi er fleksible når det gjelder lokasjon, og endelig arbeidssted avtales i løpet av rekrutteringsprosessen.Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ser etter deg som trives med kundekontakt, er nysgjerrig på kundens behov og motiveres av å skape resultater.Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:
  • Liker å bruke telefonen som arbeidsverktøy og ta initiativ til kundedialog.
  • Har interesse for lastebiler, transportbransjen og kundens drift.
  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit.
  • Har et kommersielt blikk og ser muligheter for mersalg.
  • Jobber strukturert og samarbeider godt med andre.
  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av å nå mål.
Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg, kundeservice, verksted eller transportbransjen. Relevant utdanning er positivt, men ikke avgjørende.For oss er motivasjonen din, evnen til å skape gode kunderelasjoner og viljen til å lære minst like viktig som hva som står på CV-en.Hva kan vi tilby deg?Hos Norsk Scania blir du en del av et solid, internasjonalt selskap med dyktige kolleger og et stort engasjement for både kunder og medarbeidere.Vi tilbyr deg:
  • En spennende og variert rolle med mulighet til å påvirke kundeopplevelsen og salgsresultatene.
  • Muligheten til å bidra til å utvikle vår kundeoppfølging.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kolleger.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Årlige sosiale sammenkomster og aktiviteter som skaper samhold og trivsel.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
Klar for å bli en del av Scania?Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare ser en lastebil, men også mulighetene som ligger i å holde den på veien.Hos oss får du bruke din kommersielle teft, bygge sterke kunderelasjoner og bidra til løsninger som gjør en forskjell for kundene våre.Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad!Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Christoffer Hermann, regionsdirektør for Region Øst Nord, på telefon 993 32 778.Søknadsfrist: Onsdag 9. desember 2026.Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

- Poskytuje pomoc, podporu alebo dohľad pri sebaobslužných činnostiach, najmä pri osobnej hygiene, starostlivosti o ústnu dutinu, vlasy a nechty, obliekaní, obúvaní, stravovaní, pitnom režime, vyprázdňovaní a používaní inkontinenčných a kompenzačných pomôcok.

- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.
- V rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, zaškolenia, poverenia a interných postupov vykonáva alebo asistuje pri meraní základných fyziologických funkcií, podporuje dodržiavanie liečebného režimu a poskytuje pomoc pri užívaní liekov iba v rozsahu dovolenom právnymi predpismi a internými postupmi.
- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.

- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky

Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Project Engineer, Electrical Systems
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a Project Engineer to join a highly skilled engineering team working with advanced power generation and energy solutions. This role focuses on generator protection and excitation systems, offering an excellent opportunity to build expertise in a specialized and growing area of the energy sector.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

You will participate in customer projects throughout their lifecycle, from engineering and system configuration to testing and commissioning. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will gradually take on broader technical responsibility and contribute to developing customer-specific solutions.

The position offers a combination of office-based engineering work and practical field activities at customer sites. As your expertise grows, you will also support technical discussions with customers and contribute to solution development activities.

Key Responsibilities:
· Engineering, configuration, and documentation of generator protection and excitation systems.
· Supporting testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), installation, and commissioning activities.
· Participating in commissioning assignments and technical troubleshooting at customer sites.
· Collaborating closely with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and customers to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
· Providing technical input for solution design and supporting sales and customer-facing activities when needed.

Requirements:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in electrical engineering, power generation, industrial automation, commissioning, or similar technical environments
- Good understanding of electrical power systems and interest in energy production technologies
- Experience with engineering, configuration, testing, or commissioning activities
- Knowledge of generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or power plant environments is considered an advantage
- Familiarity with electrical design tools is beneficial
- Strong communication and teamwork skills with a proactive, customer-oriented mindset
- Willingness to travel approximately 30 days per year, mainly within Finland and Northern Europe

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical, Automation or Power Engineering?*
- Do you have 2+ years of hands-on experience with electrical engineering, power systems, industrial automation, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you worked with generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or similar technologies?

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Vaasa (hybrid, minimum 1 day/week onsite)
Start: January 2027
Duration: Long-term assignment (12-month contracts, expected to continue for several years)

jobs.description:
For our client were looking for a Senior Process Integration Engineer / Heat Recovery Specialist.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

The clients product portfolio is expanding, and they are looking for an experienced senior specialist to strengthen the development of heat pump and heat recovery solutions and the design of integrations in an industrial environment. The role is part of an international team of experts. They are not looking for a traditional process engineer, but an experienced integration designer who understands the complete process and piping system built around an industrial heat pump and has a hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation.

Responsibilities:
 Design and implement integration solutions related to industrial heat pumps.
 Develop industrial heat recovery solutions and assess how recovered heat can be used efficiently.
 Design solutions where recovered energy is converted back into useful use.
 Define the technical integrations of heat pump systems, including pump and process solutions.
 Take responsibility for piping design and plant and factory design tasks.
 Produce and maintain process and P&ID diagrams and ensure compliance with standards.
 Take part in defining technical solutions together with the client and the project team.

Requirements:
 Strong experience in industrial processes, energy or heat pump solutions.
 Experience in heat recovery, steam systems or the paper and process industry.
 Skills in piping design and plant or factory design.
 Hands-on experience with the E3D design tool.

 Experience in the technical integration of different systems and equipment.

 Hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation

- Are you able to work on-site in Raisio or Tikkurila? *

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Our client is planning a modernization of its production data and industrial IT architecture. The current environment consists of multiple systems, some of which are approaching end-of-life and require replacement or consolidation. The client has already reviewed several vendor solutions and is now looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to act as an independent, neutral advisor and sparring partner during the assessment and design phase. The consultant will help evaluate the current landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, and support decision-making regarding future architecture, technology choices, and vendor ecosystem. The objective is a more standardized and controlled architecture that supports operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and future AI capabilities.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for a senior brand campaign leader who can set the vision for our biggest moments, turn ambiguous business goals into breakthrough campaign strategy, and rally a lean, cross-functional team to deliver work that's both culturally relevant and commercially effective.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Lead, Brand owns the strategy, orchestration, and performance of Notion's largest integrated brand campaigns—the tentpole moments that tell the most important stories about who we are, what we make, and why it matters. You'll be the connective tissue across launches and campaigns, making sure every global brand moment brings a cohesive, inspiring narrative to market across channels, audiences, and regions.

Reporting to the Head of Brand & Integrated Marketing, you'll set the brand campaign roadmap, lead campaigns end-to-end from first brief to performance readout, and raise the bar for how the team plans, builds, and learns. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Comms, Growth Marketing, and Regional Marketing leads, and help develop other campaign managers on the team. Responsibilities include:

 - Define and own the annual brand campaign roadmap, aligning tentpole moments to company priorities, product launches, and business goals

 - Lead Notion's largest cross-functional tentpole campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement, making high-stakes calls on concept, channel mix, and trade-offs

 - Partner with in-house Creative to originate and champion bold, category-defining brand concepts, and know when to push an idea further versus when to ship it

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Comms to unify product and brand narratives into a single, compelling story for each moment

 - Own campaign budgets and agency/vendor relationships, and partner with Growth Marketing on integrated brand and performance media from planning through reporting

 - Build the measurement framework for brand campaigns with Analytics and Growth, connecting awareness and consideration to pipeline and business outcomes

 - Collaborate with regional teams and localization to adapt and scale campaigns across EMEA, APAC, and other key markets

 - Evolve the campaign operating system—briefs, tiering, workback plans, retros, and AI-powered workflows—so the whole team moves faster with more clarity

 - Represent brand campaigns with marketing leadership and executives, presenting strategy, progress, and results with a clear point of view




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with a track record of leading large-scale, multi-channel brand campaigns that moved the business

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable—and you can sell them up and across the org

 - Strategic owner: You turn ambiguous goals into a clear campaign strategy and roadmap, and you're comfortable owning outcomes, budget, and trade-offs end to end

 - Hybrid brand + performance thinker: You care about craft and tone, and you think rigorously about metrics, media, and sales enablement. You're not a purist in any one discipline

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with AI tools and agents, and you have a perspective on the balance of human vs. AI in creative generation

 - Speed: You bias toward action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - Leader without the title: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you. You influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting feedback, and level up the people around you

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to run multiple complex workstreams at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience managing creative agencies and large media budgets

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting (individuals, teams, and enterprise)

 - Experience mentoring or managing marketers

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Connectors Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Connectors let Replit’s agents and applications securely access the tools and data people already use. Behind every connection are hard systems problems: whose identity is being used, what they’re allowed to access, how credentials stay valid, and how those guarantees hold across services and execution environments.



We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer with deep experience in authentication, authorization, security, and distributed systems to own this foundation. You’ll build and operate the infrastructure that makes connections work reliably across Replit’s projects, agent conversations, and environment builds.



This is a hands-on engineering role, not a security advisory position or a job focused on adding individual integrations. You’ll trace behavior across service boundaries, make architectural decisions, ship production changes, and simplify an evolving platform. Success means connections are secure and reliable end to end, and the team can confidently build on the systems you own.



YOU WILL

 - Own authentication and authorization across the connection lifecycle. Design how users, agents, applications, and services establish identity, receive access, and act on behalf of others.

 - Build reliable credential infrastructure. Handle OAuth flows, token refresh, revocation, reauthorization, and secure credential storage, including concurrency and partial failures.

 - Make connections work across the platform. Follow requests through application services, credential proxies, agent execution, and environment builds, preserving security guarantees at every boundary.

 - Design and operate distributed systems. Improve service-to-service communication, tenant isolation, failure recovery, and observability across shared and isolated deployments.

 - Handle provider-specific constraints without compromising the platform. Account for differences such as user versus bot credentials, token limits, and source-control authentication.

 - Lead safe migrations and reduce technical debt. Replace fragile or duplicated paths with clearer ownership and simpler designs while keeping existing customer workflows working.

 - Raise the team’s technical judgment. Explain system behavior clearly, lead design discussions, mentor engineers, and partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Fix a token-refresh race that causes connections to fail when multiple services use them concurrently.

 - Trace an authorization failure from an agent request through the credential proxy to the provider, then address the underlying design problem.

 - Design a connection lifecycle that behaves consistently across projects, conversations, and environment builds.

 - Migrate customers to a stronger identity and authorization model without disrupting their applications.

 - Remove legacy connection paths and add end-to-end tests that make future changes safer.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Deep hands-on experience with authentication and authorization systems, including OAuth 2.0, access scopes, credential lifecycles, and trust boundaries.

 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, consistency, retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

 - Experience designing, shipping, and operating production backend infrastructure with meaningful security and reliability requirements.

 - Ability to understand an unfamiliar system end to end and debug failures across multiple services and third-party APIs.

 - A track record of owning complex changes through design, implementation, rollout, and production validation.

 - Pragmatic engineering judgment: you improve existing systems incrementally, reduce unnecessary complexity, and know when a provider-specific exception is justified.

 - Clear technical communication and a willingness to help other engineers develop deeper systems understanding.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with service identity, delegated access, token federation, or credential-management infrastructure.

 - Experience with multi-tenant isolation, enterprise governance, or customer-managed cloud deployments.

 - Experience migrating authentication or authorization systems while preserving existing customer access.

 - Experience leading cross-team architectural work and mentoring engineers.



BONUS POINTS

 - Familiarity with emerging cross-app access standards such as Cross-App Access (XAA), as well as OAuth 2.0 token exchange, OpenID Connect, and identity federation.

 - Experience designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or connector-authoring tools.

 - Familiarity with AI agent tool execution or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 - Experience supporting integrations with complex authentication behavior, including collaboration tools and source-control providers.




LOCATION

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

jobs.title: Legal Engineering Counsel
jobs.description:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

What weâre looking for

Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers.

This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster.

Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk.

What youâll do

  • Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review.

  • Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer.

  • Turn our legal counselâs nuanced advice, negotiation positions, and fallbacks into structured guidance that people and AI tools can apply consistently.

  • Test and measure what you build. Check outputs against real deals, track where the tools fall short, and iterate until they hold up.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts yourself using those systems â including customer agreements, BAAs, NDAs, payer trading partner agreements â from first redline through signature.

  • Structure our contract data so the team (and our tools) can answer questions about our agreements in minutes.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management. Build self-serve paths for routine agreements and field the questions that still need a person.

jobs.title: DEKO søger en CNC-operatør
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med CNC-bearbejdning og lyst til at arbejde med moderne produktion? Vil du være en del af en virksomhed, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og udvikling er i fokus?

DEKO søger en CNC-operatør, der skal arbejde med programmering, opsætning og drift af moderne 5-aksede CNC-maskiner i en højteknologisk produktion.

Om jobbet

Som CNC-operatør hos DEKO bliver du en del af et stærkt produktionsteam, hvor du arbejder med avanceret bearbejdning af aluminiumprofiler til blandt andet karme og døre. Du får en alsidig hverdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, varierende opgaver og mulighed for løbende faglig udvikling.

Dine opgaver:

  • Programmering og opsætning af 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Drift og overvågning af produktionen med fokus på kvalitet og præcision

  • Visuel kvalitetskontrol af emner

  • Optimering og vedligeholdelse af produktionsprocesser

  • Sikring af levering i den rette kvalitet og til aftalt tid

  • Samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af produktionen

  • Deltagelse i en rotationsordning mellem flere arbejdsstationer

Din profil:

  • Du har erfaring som CNC-operatør – evt. uddannet industritekniker

  • Du har gerne erfaring med 3- eller 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Du kan læse tekniske tegninger og arbejde præcist efter mål

  • Du har en god teknisk forståelse og sans for kvalitet

  • Du er fortrolig med IT som en naturlig del af produktionen

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring i produkter, maskiner og arbejdsprocesser

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår i en virksomhed med fokus på kvalitet og udvikling

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af DEKO og bidrage med din erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning, så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til ja@deko.dk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, hvor du vil få mange flere informationer og detaljer om stillingen. Ansættelsen sker ligeledes løbende.

Om DEKO

DEKO er en familieejet virksomhed, hvor det familiære og høj performance går hånd i hånd. Her er kort vej fra idé til handling, og nye initiativer bliver mødt med nysgerrighed frem for bureaukrati. Vi tror på, at udvikling kræver mod til at prøve nye ting, og at man lærer mere af at forsøge end af at lade være.

Vi har i mere end 50 år udviklet produkter til indvendigt byggeri og er i dag en af Skandinaviens førende leverandører af glasvægge samt en af Danmarks største tømrer- og snedkervirksomheder inden for indretning af kontor-, erhvervs- og institutionsbyggeri
