Esperienza nel ruolo di capoturno (valutabile anche provenienza da settori diversi). Leadership e gestione team: autorevolezza nel far rispettare le regole, equilibrio relazionale, visione d'insieme e attenzione alle criticità. Autonomia organizzativa: capacità di gestire imprevisti e definire priorità operative. Orientamento al miglioramento continuo: collaborazione nella ricerca di soluzioni e proposta azioni correttive. Ordine e pulizia come standard di lavoro. Informatica di base: utilizzo PC e principali applicativi d'ufficio. Requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza base inglese. Esperienza nel settore stampaggio. jobs.title: addetto alla pianificazione acquisti/addetta alla pianificazione acquisti
jobs.description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. jobs.description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico ICP OES/ICP MS Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. jobs.title: TEHNIČAR/KA U ODRŽAVANJU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 25. Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Ur.broj: 857/2023 od 18. 10. 2023.g., Odluke o izmjenama i dopunama Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Urbroj: 649/2024 od 15. 7. 2024.g. i Odluke o izmjenama i dopunama Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Urbroj: 240/2026 od 14. 4. 2026.g., te članka 8. Pravilnika o radu br.359/2023 od 16. 5. 2023.g., Ustanova Zagreb film, Zagreb, Vlaška 70, raspisuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ za radno mjesto tehničar u održavanju (m/ž) 1 izvršitelj/ica, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, uz probni rad od 2 mjeseca Uvjeti za radno mjesto: • SSS tehničke struke • najmanje 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima • koeficijent 3,60.

Opis poslova i radnih zadataka: • obavljanje redovnih obilazaka objekta i opreme i njihov pregled • upravljanje sustavima grijanja, klimatizacije i ventilacije • obavljanje manjih popravaka i domarskih poslova • obavljanje jednostavnijih održavanja, ukoliko ne remete jamstvene uvjete (npr. čišćenje filtera: split klima uređaji, ventilokonvektori, zamjena filtera na rekuperacijskim jedinicama i klima komorama i sl.) • koordinacija vanjskih izvođača prilikom obavljanja radova • redovito tjedno paljenje diesel električnog agregata (DEA) i rad u praznom hodu u trajanju od 10 minuta (ukoliko postoji) • koordinacija dovoza goriva za potrebe Diesel-električnog agregata (DEA) na objektu (ukoliko postoji) • skladištenje zamjenjivih dijelova tehničkog otpada (baterije, toneri i sl.) • obavljanje manjih preseljenja • montaža projekcijskih plata i spajanje prezentacijske opreme • obavljanje svečanog uređenja objekta za praznike • briga oko rasporeda i pripreme soba za sastanke • prilagođavanje pomičnih pregradnih stijena u multifunkcijskim dvoranama • poslovi montaže i demontaže • popravak namještaja • organizacija odvoza i zbrinjavanje dijela otpada (papir, plastika) s objekta • obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu ravnatelja.

Probni rad: 2 mjeseca.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi upotrijebljeni u ovom javnom natječaju, a koji imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod, bez obzira na to u kojem su rodu navedeni.

Dokumentacija koju su kandidati, u elektroničkom obliku, obvezni priložiti: - prijava (mora sadržavati osnovne informacije o kandidatu – ime, prezime, kontakt podaci: adresa, telefon, adresa elektroničke pošte) - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (presliku svjedodžbe) - dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje zajedno sa potvrdom o vrsti poslova i razdoblju njihovog obavljanja, ugovori o radu, ugovori o djelu i ostali odgovarajući dokazi) - uvjerenje pribavljeno od nadležnog suda ili sustavom e-Građani da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja) - životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada (potpisan od strane prijavitelja/prijaviteljice).

U slučaju da kandidat sve potrebne podatke iz prijave dostavi u tekstu elektroničke pošte prilikom slanja dokumentacije uz prijavu na natječaj, smatrat će se da je kandidat poslao potpunu prijavu. Obveznu dokumentaciju potrebno je priložiti u PDF formatu, svaki dokument kao zasebni prilog. Dokazi koji se dostavljaju moraju biti na hrvatskom jeziku i latiničnom pismu, odnosno kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku, dužni su uz istu dostaviti i ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Iz priložene dokumentacije mora biti nedvojbeno jasno ispunjenje uvjeta propisanih natječajem. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista).

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju. Osoba čija je prijava nepravodobna ili nepotpuna odnosno osoba koja ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj, niti će biti pozvana na dopunu istih.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete bit će pozvani na kvalifikacijski razgovor s Povjerenstvom za provedbu natječaja u cilju utvrđivanja organizacijskih vještina te snalažljivosti kandidata u zadanim okolnostima, o čemu će biti obaviješteni e-poštom.

Prijave na natječaj s traženom obveznom dokumentacijom poslati elektroničkom poštom na mail adresu: antonela.copo@zagrebfilm.hr

Naslov: NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO TEHNIČAR U ODRŽAVANJU Elektronička pošta s prijavom i svom dokumentacijom ne smije biti veća od 25 MB. Kandidati će dobiti povratnu elektroničku poruku s potvrdom zaprimanja prijave.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je petnaest (15) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Ustanove Zagreb film.

Primitak prijave u propisanom roku utvrđuje se uvidom u vrijeme primitka elektroničke pošte . Prijavom na natječaj prijavitelji su izričito suglasni da Ustanova Zagreb film kao voditelj obrade može prikupljati, koristiti se i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajne procedure, sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni elektroničkom poštom a Odluka o rezultatima bit će objavljena i na mrežnim stranicama Ustanove Zagreb film sukladno članku 10. stavku 1. točka 10. Zakona o pravu na pristup informacijama (Narodne novine broj: 25/13, 85/15, 69/22).

Provoditelj natječaja zadržava pravo ne izabrati nijednog kandidata i poništiti natječaj.

jobs.title: PRODAJNI MENADŽER/MENADŽERICA PRIVATNOG SMJEŠTAJA
jobs.description:
Lokacija: Dubrovnik (mogućnost povremenog remote rada) Industrija: Turizam / Kratkoročni najam smještaja Vrsta zaposlenja: Puno radno vrijeme

Tvoja uloga u Direct Bookeru

Tražimo ambicioznu i prodajno orijentiranu osobu koja zna prepoznati priliku, izgraditi povjerenje i zatvoriti suradnju koja donosi stvarnu vrijednost. Kao Prodajni Menadžer, tvoj zadatak bit će širenje naše mreže privatnog smještaja u Hrvatskoj – uz maksimalnu podršku iskusnog tima i fleksibilnost rada od kuće.

Ovo je prilika da aktivno oblikuješ budućnost turizma, a istovremeno izgradiš karijeru u rastućoj globalnoj kompaniji.

Što ćeš raditi:

? Proaktivno pronalaziti i kontaktirati vlasnike apartmana, vila i kuća za odmor putem poziva, preporuka, društvenih mreža, sajmova i drugih kanala. ? Jasno i uvjerljivo predstaviti prednosti partnerstva s Direct Bookerom – uz korištenje komercijalnih analiza i konkretnih benefita. ? Voditi pregovore i izrađivati ponude koje zadovoljavaju obje strane. ? Graditi dugoročne odnose s partnerima i biti njihova kontakt osoba od povjerenja.

✅ Tražimo te ako:

? Imaš iskustva u B2C/B2B prodaji (idealno u turizmu, ugostiteljstvu ili najmu smještaja). ? Uspješno si razvijao/la partnerske odnose i ostvarivao/la prodajne ciljeve. ? Odlično komuniciraš i znaš prepoznati što je važno klijentima. ? Vješt/a si u samostalnom radu i donošenju strateških odluka.

Što nudimo:

✨ Ravnotežu između privatnog i poslovnog života ✨ Ugovor na određeno s mogućnošću stalnog zaposlenja ✨ Podršku i mentorstvo unutar pozitivne, motivirajuće radne okoline ✨ Bonusi za rezultate – bez gornje granice!

Zašto Direct Booker?

Direct Booker je dio međunarodnog brenda Belvilla by OYO / PRISM, lidera u upravljanju kratkoročnim najmom. Radit ćeš lokalno, ali kao dio velike globalne mreže. Zajedno mijenjamo način na koji ljudi putuju i iznajmljuju – budi dio te promjene!

Zainteresiran/a?

Prijavi se danas i napravi korak prema karijeri u kojoj tvoja energija i ideje čine razliku. Direct Booker čeka tebe!

jobs.title: Program Manager, Office of the CEO (PMO)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Program Manager to operationalize the CEO's external presence and growth work: founder-led marketing, founder-led sales, investor relations, and strategic go-to-market (GTM) efforts around the world. Reporting to the Chief of Staff and working on strategic special projects, you will turn the CEO's priorities into repeatable systems, clear workplans, and completed actions.

This is an execution-heavy role. You should be equally comfortable building a founder-led sales playbook, preparing an investor update, and following up on an overdue deliverable. Success requires strong judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and a willingness to take on both high-impact initiatives and the routine work that keeps them moving.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



FOUNDER-LED MARKETING

 - Build and run the operating system for the CEO's marketing presence: content calendar, speaking and event schedule, media and podcast opportunities, and social channels.

 - Turn the CEO's ideas, conversations, and public moments into repeatable content, working with Brand, Comms, and Content teams.

 - Set up intake, approval, and review workflows so the CEO's time goes to the highest-leverage appearances and posts.

 - Track reach, engagement, and pipeline influence, and report what is working.



FOUNDER-LED SALES

 - Operationalize the CEO's role in the sales motion: target account lists, executive outreach, customer and partner meetings, and follow-up.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, and RevOps to prepare briefs, talking points, and next steps for every CEO-involved deal.

 - Maintain a tracker of CEO-sourced and CEO-assisted opportunities with owners, stages, and commitments.

 - Document the playbook so founder involvement scales without adding burden to the CEO.



INVESTOR RELATIONS SUPPORT

 - Support the preparation of investor updates, board materials, and fundraising and diligence materials.

 - Maintain the investor and stakeholder tracker: relationships, meetings, asks, and follow-ups.

 - Coordinate data requests across Finance, Legal, and functional leaders, and check inputs for accuracy and consistency before review.

 - Prepare briefing documents for investor meetings and other external engagements.



STRATEGIC GTM, GLOBALLY

 - Support GTM strategy and execution across regions, including market entry, partnerships, government and ecosystem engagement, and regional events.

 - Coordinate with regional teams and partners across time zones, local requirements, and travel logistics.

 - Translate initiatives into workplans with defined scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Surface cross-regional insights and delivery risks early, with clear recommendations.



STRATEGIC SPECIAL PROJECTS AND OPERATING CADENCE

 - Own time-sensitive special projects assigned by the Chief of Staff, from scoping through close-out.

 - Run project check-ins, maintain issue and decision logs, and escalate missed commitments or unresolved dependencies.

 - Build agendas, collect pre-reads, and document decisions and action items for recurring leadership and planning meetings.

 - Maintain trackers, dashboards, and scorecards for priorities, programs, and milestones, reporting to the Chief of Staff.

 - Document standard operating procedures, and replace repetitive manual work with templates, tools, and AI-enabled automation.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience in program management, business operations, chief of staff or executive operations, GTM operations, or a comparable execution-focused role.

 - Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects and recurring operational processes.

 - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to maintain detailed trackers and manage competing deadlines.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex inputs into concise executive materials.

 - Proficiency with AI. Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and make practical decisions with incomplete information.

 - Discretion with confidential investor, customer, and company information.

 - Willingness to perform hands-on administrative and logistical work alongside program management responsibilities.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or Chief of Staff.

 - Experience in marketing, sales, or investor relations at a fast-paced or high-growth company.

 - Experience working across regions or with international teams and partners.

 - Experience preparing board and investor materials.

 - Experience improving workflows through automation and AI-enabled tools.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The CEO's marketing and sales activity runs on clear systems, with consistent output and few last-minute scrambles.

 - Every founder-involved deal has a brief, an owner, and tracked follow-up.

 - Investor materials are accurate, on time, and consistent across audiences.

 - Global GTM initiatives have clear ownership and steady progress against agreed milestones.

 - The Chief of Staff has a clear, current view of priorities, risks, and decisions needed.

 - Routine requests and operational issues are resolved with minimal CEO involvement.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers.

 - By your 90th day:
   
   - Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide.
   
   - Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization.
   
   - Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions.

 - By the end of your first year:
   
   - Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment.
   
   - Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes.

 - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment—the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions.

 - Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments.

 - Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on.

 - Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings.

 - 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging.

jobs.title: Market Researcher
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI.

This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Build a trusted market research practice and become a standing strategic partner for GTM planning, brought into launch planning early enough to shape the work.

 - Own brand tracking as a clear input into how Notion understands awareness, consideration, and perception, and translate those signals into sharper messaging and GTM priorities.

 - Connect customer, competitive, product, and top-of-funnel research across global markets to inform growth strategy and audience strategy.

 - Raise the bar for Notion’s research capabilities across decision support and thought leadership, building original studies on topics like AI transformation and ROI that give Marketing and Sales a credible point of view in the AI landscape.

 - Use AI as a research collaborator and workflow layer to connect data, scale analysis, surface patterns, and make insights easier for stakeholders to use, while improving the quality of decisions, not just the speed of delivery.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong quantitative research craft, including the ability to design and run research sprints, surveys, and MaxDiff studies, and to choose the right method for the decision at hand.

 - Deep understanding of brand tracking and top-of-funnel research, with the judgment to place those signals in the broader customer, competitive, and product context.

 - Strategic judgment: you can challenge the brief, connect market and product data, and turn ambiguous evidence into a clear recommendation that changes GTM priorities.

 - Experience working across global markets and regional teams, flexing across Product, Creative, and GTM while distinguishing local context from patterns that should shape broader strategy.

 - AI fluency and systems thinking: you use AI and data workflows thoughtfully to connect research infrastructure, scale insight delivery, and make the broader team more effective
   
    

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $219,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (UK)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We're hiring our first FDE in the UK! Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.

 

You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.

 

Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

Enterprise Marketing is responsible for driving B2B pipeline and revenue at Replit. The team partners closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, and Growth to engage enterprise buyers and turn demand into qualified opportunities. With millions of individual users already in the product, Replit has a unique opportunity to connect product-led adoption with enterprise growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Senior Manager, Demand Generation to lead integrated campaigns that accelerate enterprise pipeline and revenue growth at Replit. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of full-funnel programs that win new customers and expand adoption within existing accounts.

Reporting to the Director / Sr. Director of Demand and Digital, you’ll partner with Product Marketing to translate Replit’s AI capabilities, positioning, and customer use cases into compelling campaigns for technical and business audiences. You’ll build account-based programs, launch targeted campaigns, and work closely with Sales to turn engagement into qualified opportunities.

You’ll bring deep channel expertise and partner with channel owners to optimize spend, improve conversion, and allocate budget toward programs that deliver the strongest pipeline and revenue impact. This is a hands-on role that combines strategic planning with detailed execution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own campaign strategy and pipeline results. Build and execute enterprise demand generation programs with clear audiences, offers, pipeline goals, and measures of success.

 - Build enterprise campaign playbooks. Create repeatable programs across account-based marketing, webinars, content syndication, email nurture, and integrated field marketing.

 - Develop account-based programs. Partner with Sales to select high-value accounts, identify buying groups, and coordinate multi-touch campaigns with relevant sales outreach.

 - Own land-and-expand campaigns. Develop and execute integrated programs across new customer acquisition and account expansion. Partner with Sales to prioritize target accounts and buying groups, tailor campaigns to customer use cases, and generate qualified pipeline for new business, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.

 - Shape campaign messaging and creative. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, and Design to develop compelling assets and offers across the buyer journey, from awareness through opportunity progression.

 - Test and improve performance. Experiment with audiences, messaging, creative formats, calls to action, and landing pages to improve conversion and pipeline quality. Partner with the paid media optimization team to apply findings across campaigns.

 - Connect product-led growth with enterprise sales. Identify expansion signals within Replit’s individual user base and build programs that nurture high-potential users and accounts toward enterprise adoption.

 - Strengthen lead management and sales handoff. Work with Sales, SDRs, and RevOps on targeting, lead scoring, qualification, routing, and follow-up. Partner with Product and Analytics on product-qualified lead signals.

 - Measure and communicate business impact. Track campaign contribution, funnel conversion, and program efficiency. Bring clear insights and recommendations to business reviews, including where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.

 - Deliver high-quality execution. Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and cross-functional dependencies. Coordinate internal teams and external partners to launch programs on time and turn successful experiments into repeatable playbooks.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - A strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.

 - 10+ years of demand generation experience, including 5+ years in B2B SaaS focused on enterprise customers.

 - A proven track record of building and scaling demand generation programs with measurable pipeline contribution and ROI.

 - Expertise with account-based marketing, including account selection, multi-channel campaigns, engagement measurement, and creative development.

 - Experience developing lead scoring, qualification, and funnel optimization approaches in partnership with Sales and RevOps.

 - Strong analytical skills and a disciplined approach to experimentation—connecting data across sources, interpreting results, and translating findings into action.

 - The ability to provide clear campaign briefs and creative direction while partnering effectively with Content, Product Marketing, and Design.

 - Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, with the ability to move from strategy to hands-on execution.

 - Must have a strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join as an early member of our Enterprise team. The consumer story has demonstrated Replit’s magic and now we are seeing use cases emerge in the B2B space that are ripe for innovation and growth. It is a critical area for our success this year and beyond.



You can be part of the journey to build and scale features that help teams and organizations of any size be more productive with Replit. This is an opportunity to make meaningful impact and shape the culture and processes from the ground up. Working closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and AI engineers, you'll craft solutions that enable our customers to build, deploy, and share their applications seamlessly. This role requires both technical expertise and a deep understanding of user needs to deliver features that make an impact.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Build and own features across the full stack that serve enterprise customers, from backend services to user-facing interfaces

 - Design and implement scalable solutions for teams and organizations. This includes enterprise-readiness features like authentication, permissions, security, and compliance, as well as tools that improve team collaboration and drive adoption within an organization.

 - Work directly with customers to understand their needs and iterate on solutions

 - Contribute to technical decisions and architecture for the Enterprise platform

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering excellence

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Strong full stack engineering skills with experience shipping production code

 - Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar)

 - Track record of shipping high-impact features and taking ownership of projects

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Support Engineering (Public Sector)
Facility Technical Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a department that will comprise 55 employees. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director. You will be assisted by an Associate Facility Technical Manager,  and lead the department consisting of shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Lead and develop a department of 55 employees across day and shift teams.
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description: Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectseÄr du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.Vilka är vi?Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.Om tjänsten:Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.Vi söker dig som:Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!Vad erbjuder vi?    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.Vid flytt till Barcelona:    Ersättning av flygbiljett.    Stöd vid letande utav boende.    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectseVi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Join Team TechnipFMC as our new SCU Project Engineer in Kongsberg!
jobs.description:
Job Purpose: For our global SCU team within Controls & Automation we are looking for a motivated engineering professional to join our diverse team of highly competent engineers.In Controls & Automation we execute subsea control system project deliveries, including design, engineering, fabrication, and system integration.The Subsea Control Unit (SCU) is a topside located unit that provides operator control and monitoring of subsea wells and manifolds.Job Description:
  • Be the responsible engineer for the Subsea Control Unit (SCU) in delivery projects
  • Take charge of the SCU detailed engineering during project execution, including preparation of SCU software functionality specifications, SCU cabinet hardware specifications, and other technical documentation
  • Be the technical point of contact towards the SCU 3rd party supplier, ensuring delivery in accordance with our design input
  • Witness the SCU Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) at the SCU 3rd party supplier's facility to verify SCU functionality and HMI graphics
  • Support the Extended Factory Acceptance Test (EFAT) for the SCU part executed at TechnipFMC's facility
  • Collaborate closely with the global multidisciplinary project team
  • Participate in technical reviews and workshops
  • Some travel will be required
You are meant for this job if:
  • Hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree, or other relevant education, within Control Systems, Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
  • Preferably have 2-5 years of work experience within Control System Engineering
  • Can handle a 3rd party SCU supplier
  • Can support the Controls Lead Engineer in interactions with the Client
  • Have high level of autonomy in task execution
  • Are analytical and have excellent attention to details
  • Are solution oriented and structured in your approach to complex challenges
  • Are proactive and continuously learn from every situation
  • Have relation building abilities and work well in a team-oriented environment
  • Have excellent command of English, both written and spoken
Your future at TechnipFMC:
  • Your journey starts with our onboarding program
  • As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth
  • You will have the opportunity to attend development activities
  • We have benefits like company cabins, in-house gym, and sports teams  
  • You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans 
  • Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork.
Practicalities:
  • Application date: 6th December 2026, candidates will be evaluated on a continuing basis
  • Place of work: Kongsberg
  • Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in Norway, without sponsorship
  • For more information, please contact Manager Kristine Welde Ødelund, kristinewelde.odelund@technipfmc.com

jobs.title: Library and Digital Media Officer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Library and Digital Media Officer

Job Type: Part-time (with possibility of full-time conversion) | Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark | Employer: China Cultural Center in Copenhagen

 

About the Organization

The China Cultural Center in Copenhagen is an official institution dedicated to promoting cultural and tourism exchanges between China and Denmark at both governmental and grassroots levels. We organize cultural events, facilitate people-to-people exchanges, and collaborate with Danish institutions and travel trade partners to enhance mutual understanding and cooperation.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced professional to join our team and to serve as an important communication window for promoting Chinese culture to Danish and international audiences.

 

Job Description

The Library and Digital Media Officer is responsible for the management and operation of the China Cultural Center's digital media platforms and library, as well as the promotion of the Center's cultural activities and public services.

 

Key Responsibilities

 ⑴ Social Media Management and Digital Communications

Manage and maintain the Center's social media accounts and digital platforms, including WeChat Official Account, Facebook, Instagram and the Center's official website. 

Plan, create, edit and publish communication materials, including news articles, event announcements, promotional posts, photographs, videos and other digital content.

Develop and implement social media content plans in accordance with the Center's events and communication objectives.

Monitor platform performance, analyse engagement and audience data, and continuously improve content quality and online visibility.

Coordinate photography, video recording, editing and the archiving of promotional materials for the Center's activities.

 ⑵ Library Management and Public Services

Oversee the daily operations of the Center's library, including book classification, cataloguing, registration, lending, returns and collection management.

Establish and maintain library management procedures and reader services, including opening arrangements, reservations and visitor reception.

Actively promote the opening of the library to the general public and expand its readership among local residents and communities.

Plan and organise reading promotion activities, book-sharing sessions, cultural talks and other public cultural activities.

Promote the library's resources and services to increase its visibility and accessibility within the local community.

⑶ Cultural Communications and General Support

Support the promotion and publicity of the Center's cultural events, exhibitions, performances, lectures and cultural exchange activities.

Photograph cultural events and create visual content for the Center's promotional and communication purposes.

Participate in developing communication strategies, preparing promotional materials, writing copy and producing multimedia content.

Assist in establishing and maintaining relationships with local communities, schools, cultural institutions and other relevant organisations to expand partnerships and promote public cultural services.

Undertake other related duties as assigned by the Center.

 

Essential:

1. Language: Fluent proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken).

2. Industry Knowledge: Professional knowledge of social media management and digital platform operations. Proficiency in using standard office software and applications.

3. Paper Work Ability: written communication and analytical reporting skills.

4. Education: Bachelor's degree or above.

5. Background Check: An acceptable criminal record check is required and Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark.

6. Health: Ability to provide a health certificate as required by the employer.

 

Preferred:

1. Proficiency in Danish is a strong advantage.

 

Work Authorization

During the interview stage, candidates will be asked to confirm their current residence status in Denmark. For positions involving international travel, verification of legal work authorization may be required prior to final offer.

 

Selection Process & Interview

To apply for this position, please submit the following to our email:

① Your CV/resume;

② A written proposal outlining how you would develop and manage the media and digital communication platforms of the China Cultural Center in Copenhagen.

 (format: Word or PDF)

 

Selection Timeline:

1. Applications will be screened on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

2. If you have not received an email response by 31 December, 2026, please assume that your application has not been shortlisted for an interview.

 

Special Terms of Employment

This position starts on a part-time basis. The Center may offer a one-year full-time contract, based on work performance and business needs. The final interpretation of these employment terms shall reside with the Center.

 

Contact for Applications

China Cultural Center in Copenhagen

Email:[info@ccccph.org]

Subject line for applications: "Library and Digital Media Officer – [Your Name]"

We look forward to receiving your application!
