jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Introduction

Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

We are seeking two highly skilled and motivated Chief Engineers to join our dynamic team on our krill fishing vessels.

What you will do

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. Chief Engineer is overall responsible and in charge of all technical installations onboard the vessel, and all R&M and ordering of spare parts for these components as well as responsible for, and being sure costs are held at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will be:

  • Lead and manage the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals and objectives.

  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

  • Manage the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.

  • Collaborate with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.

  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from, preferably, other shipping and fishing companies. You are structured and systematic yet flexible and responsive. You have a positive, can-do attitude and manage to roll up your sleeves with the motivation to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

We think you have:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1.

  • Medical Certificate

  • Safety Course for officer

  • At least 5 years of experience in role as Chief Engineer.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.

  • Proficient in project management software and tools.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

Location

Vessel/Antarctica. Embarkation date approx. May 2027.

Benefits:

  • We believe that diversity drives success. Everyone at TQC should feel involved, included, and respected.

  • Competitive compensation and pension scheme

  • Comprehensive insurance program

  • Unique location in Antarctica

Travel and rotation

Crew changes are normally arranged in Montevideo, Punta Arenas and Puerto Williams. 3 shift rotation with approximately 1 period on board (approx. 3 months) and 2 periods home (approx. 4-5 months) but may deviate slightly due to operation.

Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis. Application Deadline is January 10, 2027.

For more information about the position or process, please contact Maya Aursnes, Crew Manager at maya.aursnes@qrill.com , Valerija Dirzininkaite, HR & Crew Coordinator at Valerija.Dirzininkaite@qrill.com or Georg Skjong, Technical Director at georg.skjong@qrill.com

About the Company

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of five vessels, including two cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Aalesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents.

QRILL™ Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL™ Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are the world’s leading krill company, delivering premium ingredients for human and animal nutrition. Aker QRILL Company is an Antarctic krill-harvesting company dedicated to improving health across species. We develop krill-based ingredients for nutraceutical, aquaculture, and animal feed applications, backed by rigorous science and research into krill’s benefits. Sustainability is at the core of our operations, rooted in world-class standards.

jobs.title: Vi søger en tilbudsberegner til vores anlægsafdeling
jobs.description:
Vi søger en tilbudsberegner til vores anlægsafdelingVil du være med til at vinde de rigtige opgaver og skabe et solidt grundlag for vores projekter?

Hos Torben Clausen A/S har vi travlt og søger derfor en engageret og struktureret tilbudsberegner til vores anlægsafdeling. Vi leder efter dig, der har sans for tal, forståelse for anlægsarbejde og lyst til at være en vigtig del af processen fra den første forespørgsel til det færdige tilbud.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som tilbudsberegner bliver du en central del af vores anlægsafdeling, hvor du blandt andet skal arbejde med:

  • Gennemgang og vurdering af udbudsmateriale og projektbeskrivelser.
  • Mængdeberegning og kalkulation af anlægsopgaver.
  • Indhentning og vurdering af priser fra leverandører og underentreprenører.
  • Udarbejdelse af konkurrencedygtige og gennemarbejdede tilbud.
  • Dialog og koordinering med projektledere, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Opfølgning på tilbud og bidrag til den løbende udvikling af vores kalkulationsarbejde.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med tilbudsberegning, kalkulation eller projektarbejde inden for anlæg, jord, kloak, belægning eller entreprenørbranchen.
  • Har en god teknisk forståelse og kan gennemskue sammenhængen mellem mængder, priser, ressourcer og tidsforbrug.
  • Arbejder struktureret og har øje for både detaljer og helheden.
  • Er fortrolig med IT og gerne har erfaring med kalkulationsprogrammer.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også trives i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Har en kommerciel forståelse og motiveres af at finde de gode løsninger.

Den rette kandidat kan have flere forskellige faglige baggrunde. Det vigtigste er, at du har forståelse for anlægsbranchen og lyst til at skabe gode resultater.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Torben Clausen A/S bliver du en del af en virksomhed, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed er vigtige værdier.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En spændende stilling med ansvar og mulighed for at præge din egen hverdag.
  • En central rolle i vores anlægsafdeling.
  • Et tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger.
  • En varieret arbejdsdag med både faglige udfordringer og praktiske problemstillinger.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads med en god omgangstone og plads til alle
  • Gode sociale arrangementer
  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer, sundhedsordning og pensionsordning

Beskrivelse af virksomheden

Torben Clausen A/S er en entreprenørvirksomhed med specialer indenfor anlægsarbejde, nedrivning og entreprenørtransport. Dertil har vi egen genbrugsplads med tilhørende jordhotel. Virksomhedens rødder går helt tilbage til 1952. Torben Clausen A/S beskæftiger i dag ca. 145 mand, fordelt på vores forskellige fagområder.

jobs.title: Faglig kompetent pædagog søges
jobs.description:
Brænder du for udvikling i børnehøjde, værdsætter langsom pædagogik. Forstår du at sætte pris på og udnytte naturens mange muligheder, samt er en engageret og handlekraftig pædagog, Så har vi det helt rigtige job til dig hos Børnebo i Lyne.

 

Vi søger en pædagog i en tidsbegrænset stilling på et år, med mulighed for forlængelse pr. 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter – vi venter dog gerne på den helt rette medarbejder profil. Stilling er på 30 timer, og er hovedsageligt i børnehave afdelingens førskolegruppe.

Vi leder efter en pædagog med et positivt livs og menneskesyn. En medarbejder der kan arbejde selvstændigt, reflekterende og gerne med kreative eller musiske evner. Vi har brug for en pædagog som har kendskab og erfaring med det tværfaglige arbejde med diverse sparringspartnere såsom PPR, samt erfaring med dokumentationsarbejde.

Børnebo i Lyne er en privat vuggestue og børnehave i fremdrift og med fokus på at løfte en høj pædagogisk faglighed i hverdagens aktiviteter. Børnebo er normeret til 35 børn, hvoraf de 9 er i vuggestuen. Vi har derfor små grupper og er nærværende og tillidsskabende overfor vores børn, forældre og kollegaer, så vi kan skabe en tryg hverdag med fokus på trivsel for den enkelte. Vi vægter udeliv og naturen og anvender byens skovområde på ugentlige skovdage store dele af året.

Vi ønsker derfor at du kan bidrage med din viden og erfaringer, samt at du kan tænke innovativt og er åben for udvikling af den pædagogiske praksis. Vi arbejder med udgangspunkt i den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

 

Af en kommende kollega vægter vi en høj faglighed og at du er omstillingsparat, kan arbejde selvstændigt og skabe en tryg og udviklende pædagogisk ramme for vores dejlige børn. Du er loyal overfor kollegaer og arbejdspladsen. Vi ønsker plads til humor og lyst til hygge ud fra en positiv tilgang til den hverdag, som vi gerne vil tilbyde forældre og børn i Børnebo.

Børnebo kan som privat institution tilbyde en stor grad af mulighed for at være lige præcis den bedste version, af den faglige pædagog som netop DU ønsker at være. Uanset om du er den kreative, musiske, naturfaglige eller idrætsfaglige pædagog. Så har vi rammerne til at lade dig udvikle den pædagogiske retning, som du allermest brænder for at kunne skabe i hverdagen. Vi tilbyder dig muligheden for at sætte din professionalisme, faglighed og din erfaring i spil, i samarbejde med husets andre pædagoger, medhjælpere og lederen. Du vil få ansvar for arbejdet omkring tilsyn, tværfaglige møder i samarbejdet med kommunale instanser, samarbejde med Lyne Friskole ifht skolestart og overgangen imellem børnehave og skole.

Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er smilende, præsentabel og imødekommende over for både kunder og kolleger samt er villig til at gøre en forskel. Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

Du bliver en vigtig del af køkkenteamet og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores køkkenchef.

pinglin68@live.dk

jobs.title: Destinationsudvikling og Samarbejde
jobs.description:
Destinationsudvikling og samarbejde – vær med til at udvikle Sønderjylland som destination

Har du blik for udvikling, gode samarbejder og evnen til at få idéer omsat til konkrete resultater? Trives du med at drive projekter, skabe relationer og samle forskellige aktører om fælles mål? Så har vi en spændende stilling til dig i Destination Sønderjylland.

I Destination Sønderjylland arbejder vi med markedsføring, udvikling samt tiltrækning og styrkelse af turismen i Sønderjylland på tværs af de fire sønderjyske kommuner Haderslev, Sønderborg, Tønder og Aabenraa. Det gør vi i tæt samarbejde med kommuner, turismevirksomheder, lokale aktører og erhvervsorganisationer. Sekretariatet har kontor i Sønderborg, hvor vores team på 9 medarbejdere arbejder med markedsføring, salg, service og udvikling. Derudover driver Destination Sønderjylland turistbureauerne i Haderslev, Sønderborg og Aabenraa.

Vi søger en ny kollega, som kan være med til at drive og koordinere udviklingsprojekter, styrke samarbejdet på tværs af turismeerhvervet og omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete indsatser. Du får samtidig et særligt ansvar for at udvikle og styrke vores gæsteservice på tværs af destinationen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med både projektledelse, koordinering, udvikling og relationsarbejde. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Udvikling og gennemførelse af indsatser, der understøtter Destination Sønderjyllands strategi og styrker Sønderjylland som samlet destination.

  • Udvikling og styrkelse af gæsteservice, herunder udvikling af nye tiltag, koncepter og samarbejder, der sikrer gode gæsteoplevelser på tværs af destinationen.

  • Etablering og udvikling af samarbejder med kommuner, turismevirksomheder og øvrige lokale aktører samt facilitering af netværk, møder og workshops.

  • Sparring, koordinering og opfølgning med samarbejdspartnere samt identifikation af nye muligheder for fælles udvikling.

  • Planlægning, koordinering og gennemførelse af udviklingsprojekter – fra idé og ansøgning til implementering, dokumentation og afrapportering.

Dine kompetencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og erfaring med projektledelse, udviklingsarbejde og koordinering. Du er god til at skabe overblik, holde fast i fremdriften og få forskellige mennesker og organisationer til at arbejde sammen om fælles mål.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at drive projekter og kan bevare overblikket fra de første idéer til den endelige gennemførelse.

  • Har erfaring med samarbejde med kommuner og forståelse for de kommunale organisationer og deres arbejdsprocesser.

  • Har erfaring med udvikling af service og gæsteoplevelser og kan omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete forbedringer i praksis.

  • Er god til at skabe relationer og kan navigere i samarbejdet mellem forskellige interessenter og organisationer.

  • Er struktureret og har styr på planlægning, koordinering, opfølgning og dokumentation.

  • Har gode formidlingsevner og kan facilitere møder, workshops og processer, der skaber engagement og fremdrift.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, tager initiativ og er god til at prioritere, når flere opgaver er i gang på samme tid.

  • Har blik for helheden og forståelse for, hvordan samarbejde og udvikling kan skabe værdi for både destinationen og de lokale aktører.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til turismeerhvervet, destinationsudvikling eller gæsteservice.

Vi tilbyder

Et spændende og alsidigt job, hvor du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af Sønderjylland som turistdestination og arbejde tæt sammen med en bred kreds af engagerede samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af et lille og uformelt team, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling, stor grad af frihed under ansvar og plads til at tage initiativ. Vi arbejder på tværs af fagområder og hjælper hinanden.

For at fremme det gode arbejdsmiljø afholder vi løbende sociale arrangementer. Udover løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension tilbydes en sundhedsforsikring.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen. Du må påregne varierende arbejdstider, hvor også aften- og weekendarbejde kan forekomme.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har stillingen fanget din interesse, så vent ikke med at sende din ansøgning! Opstart vil være den 1.2.2027.

Ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag sendes pr. mail til Kirsten@dssj.dk andre former for ansøgninger accepteres ikke.

Yderligere spørgsmål rettes til direktør Kirsten Oldenborg Lundvang kirsten@dssj.dk, eller på 66446701

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til Visit Haderslev
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at holde VisitHaderslevs hjemmeside skarp og opdateret?Destination Sønderjylland søger en studentermedhjælper til vedligeholdelse og optimering af hjemmesiden.

Er du i gang med en uddannelse med fokus på hjemmesider, digitale medier eller web, og har du lyst til at få praktisk erfaring med at arbejde med en større turismehjemmeside? Så søger vi en studentermedhjælper til at hjælpe med den løbende vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af VisitHaderslevs digitale indhold.

Om Destination Sønderjylland

Destination Sønderjylland arbejder med markedsføring og udvikling af turismen i de fire sønderjyske kommuner Haderslev, Sønderborg, Tønder og Aabenraa. Derudover driver Destination Sønderjylland turismeservice i Aabenraa, Sønderborg og Haderslev Kommune.

Sekretariatet har kontor i Sønderborg, og arbejdet med VisitHaderslevs digitale indhold sker i tæt samarbejde med den faste medarbejder hos VisitHaderslev.

Om stillingen

Som studentermedhjælper kommer du primært til at arbejde med VisitHaderslevs indhold på VisitSønderjyllands hjemmesider.

Destination Sønderjylland og den faste medarbejder hos VisitHaderslev vurderer og prioriterer, hvilket indhold der skal være på siderne. Din opgave bliver især at hjælpe med at få indholdet oprettet, opdateret og kvalitetssikret.

En stor del af jobbet består derfor af det løbende arbejde med at holde hjemmesiden korrekt, relevant og opdateret. Samtidig forventer vi, at du byder ind med forslag til, hvordan hjemmesiden kan optimeres og forbedres.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·       opdatere og vedligeholde VisitHaderslevs indhold på VisitSønderjyllands hjemmesider

·       oprette og redigere sider, guides, artikler og andet indhold ud fra de aftalte prioriteringer

·       kvalitetssikre tekster, billeder, links, åbningstider og øvrige oplysninger

·       finde og rette døde eller forældede links

·       arbejde med løbende SEO- og GEO-optimering af eksisterende indhold med fokus på synlighed i både søgemaskiner og AI-baserede søgetjenester

·       oprette, redigere og kvalitetssikre produkter og events i GuideDanmark-databasen i samarbejde med kolleger og turismeaktører

·       indhente og kontrollere oplysninger om blandt andet oplevelser, attraktioner og arrangementer

·       have øje for forbedringsmuligheder på hjemmesiden og komme med forslag til, hvordan indhold og brugeroplevelse kan optimeres.

Arbejdet foregår efter eksisterende retningslinjer for blandt andet opbygning og tone of voice. Indholdet findes på dansk, tysk og engelsk og på dele af hjemmesiden også på nederlandsk. Til oversættelserne arbejder vi med faste prompts og værktøjer, som du bliver introduceret til.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en videregående uddannelse, hvor hjemmesider, digitale medier, web eller lignende indgår som en naturlig del af uddannelsen.

Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for at arbejde med hjemmesider og trives med den løbende opdatering og vedligeholdelse af indhold.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

·       har interesse for web og digitalt indhold

·       arbejder struktureret og grundigt

·       skriver sikkert på dansk

·       kan arbejde selvstændigt og tænke selv i opgaveløsningen

·       har blik for, når noget kan gøres bedre, og tør komme med forslag til forbedringer

·       er nysgerrig på SEO og GEO og har lyst til at lære mere

·       kan følge eksisterende retningslinjer og samtidig være opmærksom på muligheder for at optimere indholdet

·       har lyst til at samarbejde med kolleger og turismeaktører.

Erfaring med CMS eller webarbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

Et studiejob hvor du får praktisk erfaring med vedligeholdelse og optimering af webindhold inden for turisme. Du bliver en del af Destination Sønderjylland og får mulighed for at arbejde med en hjemmeside, som bruges af gæster til at finde inspiration og praktisk information om oplevelser i Haderslev og hele Sønderjylland.

Du får faste rammer og retningslinjer at arbejde ud fra, men samtidig mulighed for at bruge din faglighed og komme med input, når du ser noget, der kan forbedres.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted

Arbejdstiden er 8-15 timer om ugen og aftales nærmere under hensyntagen til dit studie.

Arbejdssted vil være i Haderslev og/eller på Destination Sønderjyllands sekretariat i Sønderborg, afhængigt af opgaver og aftale.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale og senest d. 1. februar 2027

Ansøgning og ansættelse

Send din ansøgning og CV til kirsten@dssj.dk senest den 10.12.2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Direktør, Kirsten Oldenborg Lundvang på mail: Kirsten@dssj.dk eller tlf. 66446701

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellowship in Political Science (3-4 years)
jobs.description:
About the position

We are offering a PhD Research Fellow (SKO 1017) in political science with a specialization in public policy and public administration. The successful applicant will be part of the research project "How Policy Growth Affects Policy Implementation and Performance" (POLIGROW) funded by the Norwegian Research Council. The PhD fellowship period is three years and devoted to carrying out research and pursuing a PhD in the context of the POLIGROW project. The position may also include other career-enhancing activities: depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period may be extended to a maximum of four years to accommodate qualifying activities, such as teaching responsibilities.

The POLIGROW project studies how policy growth affects the administrative structures, working routines and performance of the authorities in charge of implementation. The project is organized in three work packages. The first work package maps and explains how policy growth changes administrative structures, drawing on new hand-coded data on implementation tasks and the public and private organizations responsible for them in environmental/climate and social policy across 15 OECD countries from 1975 to 2025. The second work package examines how policy growth affects the working routines and coping practices of bureaucrats, such as policy triage, negative coordination, and selective oversight of private contractors, through comparative case studies, document analysis and semi-structured interviews with public officials. The third work package analyses how different patterns of burden allocation affect policy effectiveness, linking administrative structures to environmental and social performance using time-series-cross-section and difference-in-differences designs.

POLIGROW will produce the first cross-national dataset covering all implementing authorities and their tasks across multiple sectors, to be published on a publicly accessible data platform. The project also places strong emphasis on societal impact, with policy briefs, workshops and webinars organized with practitioners. 

The PhD Fellow is expected to develop an independent research project within the overarching thematic scope of POLIGROW. The individual project should align with the project's overall framework, for example by focusing on one of the three work packages, a specific policy sector, or a subset of countries. The candidate will have considerable freedom in developing their research questions, theoretical approach, and methodological design, whether quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods.

At the same time, the PhD Fellow will play an active role in the project's collective research activities, particularly in Work Package I. This includes contributing to the development of the coding manual and the coding of implementation structures. Candidates are therefore expected to design a PhD project that makes substantial use of data generated through POLIGROW: data they help collect themselves and/or other data produced within the project. The intention is that the collaborative data collection forms an integral part of the PhD project and provides a foundation for the candidate's own research. The research project proposal should include a tentative overall thematic and theoretical framework, along with at least three ideas for academic articles (see details below).

The successful candidate will be part of the Faculty’s PhD programme. The work is expected to lead to a PhD in political science.

To promote a strategic career path, all PhD fellows are expected to submit a career development plan, specifying career goals and the competencies that the PhD fellow should acquire, no later than one month after commencement of the fellowship period. The department is responsible for ensuring that the plan is followed up and that the PhD fellow has access to career guidance throughout the duration of the fellowship. 

Qualification requirements

Formal qualifications

  • The applicant’s prior education must correspond to five years of university-level education in Norway in political science or a related field, of which two years (120 ECTS credits) are at the master's level.
  • The master's degree should have a conventional academic and theoretical orientation and not be an experience-based or professionally oriented master's degree.
  • The master's thesis must be equivalent to at least half a year's full-time study (30 ECTS credits).
  • The master's degree must include relevant training in research design and methods.
  • Applicants must have an excellent academic record, normally corresponding to grades in the upper range of the Norwegian A – F grading scale (i.e., A (excellent) – B (very good)), or comparable academic achievement under other grading systems.
  • Please see the admissions requirements for the PhD programme for further details on qualification requirements.

Applications from candidates who do not fulfil all formal qualification requirements will be excluded from further assessment. 

Other qualifications

  • Applicants must have a very good to excellent command of English language (written and oral).
  • Language skills relevant to the countries covered by the project (e.g. German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese or a Scandinavian language) are an advantage. 
  • Applicants are required to possess robust empirical research knowledge within political science, with proficiency in quantitative or qualitative analysis.
  • Experience with manual data coding or interview-based research is an advantage but not a requirement.
  • Possessing knowledge of public administration, policy implementation, or environmental/climate or social policy is an advantage but not a requirement.

The evaluation of applicants is primarily based on documented academic qualifications and the research project proposal. 

During the initial screening phase among eligible applicants, particular emphasis is placed on academic performance and the quality of the master's thesis. Given the highly competitive nature of the position, shortlisted candidates will normally have an excellent academic record and a highly commendable or outstanding master's thesis.

In the subsequent phase of the selection process, greater emphasis is placed on the quality and fit of the research proposal. Factors such as personal suitability, motivation, and compatibility with the project team will also be taken into consideration. 

 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues - could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We offer
  • Salary according to “SKO 1017 PhD fellow”, NOK 565 700 - 625 000 per year.
  • Personal research funds that can be used for e.g. travel and research assistance (currently NOK 35 000 per year).
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • Involvement in a large research project that provides opportunities to build a network with scholars researching political elites around the world, including an annual workshop on the topic.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Attractive UiO welfare benefits
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the University’s kindergarten).
  • Norway’s capital with its easy access to beautiful nature and rich cultural life.
  • Introduction course for PhD Fellows: Teaching as a PhD candidate
  • Annual career development conversation based on the submitted career plan. 
  • Various courses and workshops supporting career development (e.g., on dissemination and presentation skills, op-ed writing, and stress-management).
  • Practical support for international staff moving to Norway (https://www.uio.no/english/about/jobs/ismo/) (international staff may also benefit from tax cuts in their first years)
How to apply

The application with attachments must be submitted in our electronic recruiting system. Please follow the link “apply for this job”.

The online application must include the following items, which are to be submitted before the deadline (all documents should be in English or a Scandinavian language):

  • A cover letter (maximum 2 pages), including a statement of motivation
  • A research proposal (maximum 3,000 words including all references and footnotes - a word count must be provided on the front page). The proposal should clarify the research theme, main research questions, how the research contributes to existing literature and the project, theoretical approach, methodology, article ideas, and a timeline. A final research proposal must be developed in cooperation with the project leader within three months of the start date. 
  • A CV summarizing education, positions, research and pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities. Career breaks, including parental leave, that are noted in the CV will be taken into consideration when evaluating applicants' academic record.
  • Copy of Master’s thesis (in English or in a Scandinavian language).
  • Copies of transcripts: All applicants must submit their Master’s degree diploma and transcript(s), preferably together with a class distribution of grades. The transcript must specify the grade achieved for the Master’s thesis.
  • Official explanation of the grading and credit system at your university (foreign applicants).
  • Applicants who have completed their education outside of the EU/EEA-area and who do not have English as a native language or who have not completed an English-language MA program must document English language skills: TOEFL - with a minimum result of 550 on the Paper-based Test (PBT), or 80 on the Internet-Based Test (iBT) or IELTS - International English Language Testing Service, with the result 6.0. 
  • Names and contact details for 2-3 reference persons (name, relationship to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). Reference letters are not needed.

The application deadline is December 14, 2026. The screening and evaluation of candidates will begin immediately. The most promising candidates will be invited for interviews. We expect the whole evaluation process, from the application date to an offer being made, to take 6 to 12 weeks, depending on the number of applications. The expected start date is April 1st, 2027, but is subject to negotiation. 

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Political Science is part of the Faculty of Social Sciences. It is the largest political science department in Norway and covers all subfields of the discipline: international politics, public policy and administration, comparative politics, political theory and research methods. The department offers a vibrant academic environment with a good mix of permanent staff, postdoctoral and PhD fellows. Around 1,400 students are currently enrolled at BA, MA and PhD level. The department runs two large political science programmes at BA and MA level. In addition, the department hosts interdisciplinary study programmes in International Studies, Public Administration and Leadership, and Peace and Conflict Studies. The department has several research groups, including Comparative Institutions and Regimes, Policy, Bureaucracy and Organization, and Political Data Science. The Department also hosts the interdisciplinary Center for Research on Extremism (C-REX).

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Experimental Cancer Biophysics and Quantitative Bioimaging
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

The Department of Physics and Technology is thrilled to announce a vacant position of Postdoctoral Research Fellow in the area of Experimental Cancer Biophysics and Quantitative Bioimaging at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Faculty of Science and Technology. The position is connected to the project Cymoplive funded by UiT. The position is a fixed term position for a duration of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The position's field of research

The project focuses on the development and validation of Cymoplive, a tumor-on-chip functional assay platform that uses longitudinal, label-free microscopy to investigate cancer cell responses and adaptation to therapeutic interventions.The central research objective is to identify and establish novel imaging-based functional markers of therapeutic response by investigating changes in cancer cell behaviour at both single-cell and population levels. The research will integrate advanced live-cell label-free microscopy, quantitative image analysis, and experimentally controlled therapeutic perturbations to characterize cellular motility, morphological dynamics, phenotypic heterogeneity, and adaptive responses. Using established and patient-derived cancer models, the project will investigate how these behaviours evolve under different therapeutic agents, dosing strategies, and treatment schedules.The identified markers will be quantitatively characterized and validated for their sensitivity, reproducibility, and biological relevance. Their performance will be benchmarked against conventional drug-response and complementary imaging-based assays, while their relationships with molecular markers of cancer cell plasticity will be investigated. The overarching goal is to establish robust imaging-based measures that provide additional insight into therapeutic responses beyond conventional assay endpoints, supporting their application in preclinical drug development. The position offers opportunities to develop independent research questions and methodological approaches within the project’s broader scientific objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Development and optimization of quantitative microscopy and longitudinal live-cell imaging methods. 
  • Design and execution of drug-response experiments using cancer cell models and tumor-on-chip platforms, including clinically relevant treatment regimens. 
  • Development and application of conventional and AI-based image-processing and quantitative analysis methods.• Development and validation of quantitative metrics to characterize cancer cell adaptation, functional heterogeneity, and drug responses.• Correlation of functional responses with molecular markers of cancer cell plasticity using ICC, IF, and related techniques.• Comparative evaluation of therapeutic responses across different cancer models and treatments.• Benchmarking against conventional viability assays and complementary imaging-based and functional assays.• Statistical analysis, assessment of measurement reproducibility, and contribution to scientific publications and collaborative research.
Qualifications

This position requires:

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree within a field relevant for the research theme of the position (i.e., biophysics, biomedical engineering, cancer biology, cell biology, biotechnology, quantitative bioimaging, physics, or computational biology), or a corresponding foreign doctoral degree recognised as equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree. If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. 
  • Fluency in English and good communication skills.  
  • At least two years of hands-on research experience in at least one of the following areas:- Quantitative live-cell imaging and analysis: Development or optimization of microscopy methods, image-processing workflows, and quantitative characterization of cellular behaviour.- Experimental in vitro drug-response studies: Independent design and execution of therapeutic perturbation experiments, drug-dosing regimens, and functional response assessments. 
  • Evidence of independent scientific contributions through publications, developed methods, analytical workflows, or research projects. 
  • Ability to conduct research independently and collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary environment. 

Desirable Qualifications

  • Demonstrated practical expertise in both quantitative live-cell imaging and experimental drug-response studies. 
  • Experience with tumor-on-chip platforms, patient-derived organoids, advanced 3D cancer models, or isolation and culture of challenging primary tumor samples. 
  • Experience with label-free microscopy, quantitative phase imaging, advanced image analysis or AI-based image analysis. 
  • Experience with molecular characterization techniques, including ICC, IF, or related methods. 
  • Research experience in cancer cell plasticity, migration, mechanobiology, or therapeutic resistance. 

During the assessment emphasis will be put on the candidate’s motivation, potential for research, and personal suitability for the position. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).

Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 

We offer
  • We offer the chance to work in a leading cancer biophysics area which provides an academic and innovation environment. We provide an opportunity to work in close collaboration with clinicians at UNN Hospital.
  • Involvement in an interesting research project with an international, interdisciplinary research environment, and good career opportunities including industry transition.
  • Access to state-of-the-art laboratories and imaging facilities.
  • Fantastic work environment and good remuneration within the stunning landscape of Tromsø.
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance, and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 

Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter (max 1 page): Explain your motivation for applying and your interest in the advertised position.
  • Project Plan (max. 2 pages): Outline how you would contribute to the project's research objectives, including relevant scientific questions, proposed experimental and analytical approaches, and a realistic timeline with key milestones.
  • Research Experience (max. 2 pages): Narratively describe how your skills and experience gained through published and unpublished research make you a strong fit for the project, highlighting your specific contributions, technical competencies, research independence, and areas for further development.
  • CV (must include a clear description of relevant research skills relevant and corresponding experience levels, max 4 pages)
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position.
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • List of publications (up to 10), stating which works you consider most important and relevant to the position.
  • PhD Thesis

If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.All documentation to be considered mustbe in a Scandinavian language or English. 

Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.

General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary with a gross annual salary of minimum NOK 650 000. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilize our location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately 18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta, Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT's activities. Participation, co-determination, transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous - closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments.

Read more about UiT's strategy towards 2030.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant (Oslo)
jobs.description:
What if your next tech role didn't make you choose between people and technology? At ConnectMyApps, Solutions Consultants work with both. We build integrations for client across Europe that make their business applications work together, across HR, finance, ERP, CRM and more. We're growing our Customer Solutions team and are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join us in Oslo.

What you'll do

You'll work across the whole customer journey, from first conversations and onboarding to solution design, implementation, testing and ongoing support. That includes:

→ Working out what the customer is trying to achieve, even before the requirements are technical

→ Exploring what customer and third-party systems can (and can't) do, and how their APIs let them talk to each other

→ Turning business needs into clear technical specifications

→ Using AI to help turn those specifications into reliable integrations, then reviewing, validating and refining

→ Leading test sessions with customers and stakeholders

→ Working closely with customers, partners and our team to make it all work in the real world

This isn't a traditional developer role. We want someone who thinks first and builds second: someone who can look at a problem, understand what's going on, ask the right questions, find a solution and explain it clearly to everyone involved. You don't need to be an experienced coder, but you should be curious about how technology works and willing to find your way around solution components and code.

What we're looking for

Someone who moves comfortably between people, business and technology. You:

→ Communicate and present well, and are comfortable in front of customers

→ Can turn business conversations into technical requirements, and explain technical ideas in plain language

→ Understand APIs and how systems work together

→ Think logically and enjoy solving problems

→ Pick up unfamiliar systems quickly

→ Have used or experimented with AI agents for coding and/or document generation

→ Enjoy variety: different systems, industries and problems

→ Are comfortable with fast pace and having to switch context between projects

→ Are a real team player

New graduates are welcome. We care more about potential, curiosity and mindset than years of experience.

Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language is a must. Other languages are a bonus.

Why ConnectMyApps?

A part of The Amesto Group, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry. We're a small team that changes the way companies work. Here you'll work directly with customers and see the impact of what you build.

Many of the tools and improvements we use today came from the team's own ideas. So, when you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it, and we want you to explore it. You won't just follow an established process. You'll help shape what our way of working looks like.

We foster a strong team spirit. We have regular team events, spend time together outside work and, importantly, enjoy each other's company. You won't be one small piece of a big puzzle. You might actually leave a mark.

Benefits

We offer competitive salary, pension, health insurance, career development, travel and hotel discounts, Ruter discounts, mobile phone packages, discounted lunch at an excellent canteen, and discounts at selected Oslo shops and services.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Position type: On-site

  • Level: Junior level

  • Requirements: Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language required

  • Education: University degree or similar

  • Work permit: Must have full residency/work permit for Norway.

Er du glad for leg, sang, fjollerier og hyggelige stunder? Og har du samtidig roen og tålmodigheden til at møde et barn med særlige behov? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Formålet med timeaflastning er at aflaste forældrene til et barn med nedsat fysisk- eller psykisk funktionsevne og give dem et pusterum. Udgangspunktet er altid samvær med barnet. Det kan være at passe barnet i hjemmet, lave aktiviteter eller at tage barnet med på små ture ud af hjemmet, typisk mens forældrene ikke er til stede i hjemmet.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er fyldt 18 år og kan fremvise ren straffe- og børneattest.
  • Er omsorgsfuld, nærværende og har lyst til at skabe en god relation til Theo.
  • Er tålmodig og kan bevare roen, også når situationer bliver udfordrende.
  • Har forståelse for betydningen af struktur og forudsigelighed.
  • Er opmærksom på kropssprog og nonverbal kommunikation.
  • Har interesse for at arbejde med børn med særlige behov. Erfaring med autisme er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Kan komme til og fra familiens hjem i Ikast, eventuelt i egen bil.

 

Du skal ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du møder Theo med varme, nysgerrighed og forståelse – og har lyst til at lære ham at kende.

Stillingen er på op til 47,66 timer pr. måned og timerne vil være placeret enten på hverdage i løbet af ugen fra sidst på eftermiddagen eller i weekenderne. Jobbet som timeaflaster er ofte en sidebeskæftigelse, et fritids- eller studiejob.Det kan også være et fleksjob.

At være timeaflaster er en fantastisk mulighed for at hjælpe og gøre noget godt for andre.Mød Theo 

Theo er en dejlig dreng på 4 år, som elsker at fjolle, synge, lægge puslespil, bygge forhindringsbaner og tumle. Han holder af både aktive lege og hyggelige stunder, hvor der er plads til nærvær og sjov.

Theo har autisme og oplever verden på sin egen måde. Han bruger ikke talesprog, men kommunikerer gennem sit kropssprog, sine ansigtsudtryk og sine handlinger. Som aflaster får du mulighed for at lære hans signaler at kende og opbygge en god og tryg relation til ham.

Theo trives allerbedst med faste rutiner og genkendelige rammer. Når han ved, hvad der skal ske, giver det ham tryghed og overskud til at nyde dagens aktiviteter. Derfor har han brug for en voksen, der kan skabe struktur og forudsigelighed og møde ham i hans eget tempo.

Som alle andre børn kan Theo opleve situationer, hvor følelserne bliver store. Her har han brug for en rolig og tålmodig voksen, som kan hjælpe ham med at finde tilbage til trygheden – også når noget bliver svært.

I løbet af dagen har Theo brug for små pauser, hvor han blandt andet nyder at se musikvideoer eller spille små spil på sin tablet. Det hjælper ham med at finde ro og samle ny energi.

 

Hvad indebærer opgaven?

Som timeaflaster bliver din vigtigste opgave at skabe gode og meningsfulde oplevelser sammen med Theo og samtidig give hans forældre mulighed for aflastning i hverdagen.

Opgaven vil primært foregå i familiens hjem, hvor der også kan være andre familiemedlemmer og/eller en anden aflaster til stede i forbindelse med familiens øvrige børn.

Jeres tid sammen kan eksempelvis bestå af leg, sang, puslespil, bevægelsesaktiviteter og hyggelige stunder med udgangspunkt i Theos interesser og dagsform.

Du skal desuden kunne støtte Theo i de praktiske og personlige behov, han har i løbet af dagen.

Ansættelsesproces

Du ansøger om jobbet som timeaflaster via selvbetjeningsløsning nedenfor. Hvis dine kvalifikationer er relevante, kontakter familien dig for en samtale, så i sammen finder ud af om I er et ”match”. Efter evt. ansættelse, er det dig og familien, der aftaler din arbejdstid og aktiviteter. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat af Ikast-Brande kommune, hvor du aflønnes ud fra det konkrete forbrug af timer, som du løbende indberetter.

Lønnen er på 161,94 kr. pr. time. Tillæg for arbejde efter kl. 17 på hverdage samt i weekender. Der udbetales desuden feriepenge. 

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest på dig i forbindelse med ansættelse. 

Hvis du har brug for yderligere oplysninger:

I forhold til selve arbejdet i familiens hjem, kan du kontakte forældrene på telefonnummer 23 38 84 32. I forhold til ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte fagspecialist Heidi Lilholt Holm på mail: helil@ikast-brande.dk - tlf. 99605533.

Lovgivningen

Timeaflastning til børn gives efter barnets lov § 90 stk. 1, nr. 2, jf. servicelovens § 84 stk. 1.

Ansøgningsfrist

Hurtigst muligt!Der holdes løbende ansættelsessamtaler, som vil foregå i hjemmet hos forældrene efter aftale.

Expert Talent Pool Physical AI
jobs.description:
About the Role

Lead physical AI data capture programs that help robots learn from human movement and manipulation. You will set up capture systems, guide demonstrations, and uphold data quality across projects ranging from one week to several months.

What You'll Do

  • Set up and maintain teleoperation rigs using VR controllers, leader arms, and ROS or ROS 2, ensuring consistent demonstrations.

  • Design egocentric and manipulation capture systems, including camera placement, task scripts, and quality assurance protocols.

  • Operate motion capture and sensor systems such as OptiTrack, Vicon, IMUs, and LiDAR, and troubleshoot hardware in the field.

  • Plan scene recording, calibration, and data collection across multiple sites.

  • Design robot evaluation tasks, define success criteria, and develop scoring systems.

  • Train, mentor, and review operators and data capture technicians.

What We're Looking For

  • At least five years of hands-on experience in robotics operations, teleoperation, motion capture, sensor capture, lab work, autonomous vehicle testing, or precision hands-on trades.

  • Practical robotics or physical AI data capture experience, such as teleoperation, egocentric or manipulation recording, or robot evaluation.

  • Experience setting up and troubleshooting capture rigs, including ROS or ROS 2, VR teleoperation, motion capture systems, cameras, LiDAR, or IMUs.

  • Ability to design or run capture sessions with defined protocols and quality checks.

  • Fine manipulation skills and the ability to record remotely with provided equipment or travel for on-site projects; experience leading or training operators and running robot evaluations is useful.

Compensation & Benefits

$40 to $90 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Pay is for hours worked.

Location

Remote projects, with some on-site work. Some projects can be completed from home or your workplace using provided equipment. On-site locations vary by project.

jobs.title: Expert Talent Pool Feedback and Alignment
jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a remote expert network as a senior rater and reviewer, evaluating complex AI model outputs and helping calibrate other graders. Your work supports the development of high-quality, trustworthy AI systems across specialized fields.

What You'll Do

  • Rank and rate expert-level model answers using detailed rubrics and write clear rationales.

  • Evaluate steps in model reasoning across fields such as mathematics, coding, law, medicine, and finance.

  • Fact-check complex claims against primary sources and verify accuracy.

  • Assess answers against content policies, style guides, and edge cases.

  • Review other raters' work, calibrate standards, and develop or refine grading guidelines.

  • Assess search relevance and provide feedback in live sessions.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in rating, review, editing, fact-checking, trust and safety, or a relevant professional domain.

  • Native or near-native written English proficiency.

  • Experience grading or reviewing expert-level answers against rubrics, policies, or style guides.

  • Experience leading or reviewing other raters, such as as a QA lead, rubric owner, or reviewer of reviewers.

  • An advanced degree, professional license, or deep working expertise in the domain you grade.

  • Hands-on AI data annotation experience, search-quality rating, or experience writing and maintaining grader guidelines is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation is $50 to $120 per hour, depending on the project, field, and expertise level. Payment is based on hours worked.

Location

Fully remote. Projects typically run from one week to several months.

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description: Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.Your responsibilities:Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership TeamContribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function. Your background:Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controlsResults-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skillsStrong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organizationAbility to translate financial and operational insights into actions10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilitiesDigital mindset with proof record on digital innovationsYour benefits:Attractive compensation & benefitsEmployee Assistance Program GlobalParental Leave ProgramWe look forward to receiving your application. jobs.title: Mekanisk montør
jobs.description:
Vær med til at bygge robotløsninger fra montage og test til indkøring hos kunden. Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger en erfaren mekanisk montør, der kan samle, justere og teste de mekaniske dele i vores robot- og automationsløsninger. Du arbejder med kundetilpassede anlæg, hvor din faglighed og sans for detaljerne har betydning for, hvordan den samlede løsning fungerer.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for mekanisk montage og motiveres af at få maskiner og udstyr til at fungere i praksis.

  • Trives i et tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde, vidensdeling og faglig sparring er en del af arbejdet.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projektopgaver med skræddersyede automatiseringsløsninger efter kundernes behov.

Stillingen

Du bliver en del af vores projektteam, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer udvikler kundetilpassede robot- og automationsløsninger til industrien. I stillingen er du med i projektforløbet fra montage og test hos Danrobotics til idriftsættelse hos kunden. 

Du kan forvente en afvekslende arbejdsdag med tæt kontakt til både kunder, samarbejdspartnere og kollegaer. Som Mekanisk montør varetager du den fulde opgave med montage og samling af maskiner, robotter og udstyr. 

Eksempler på arbejdsopgaver:

  • Mekanisk montage af maskiner, robotter og anlæg.

  • Samling og justering af komponenter.

  • Fejlfinding, test og kvalitetssikring.

  • Konfigurering af systemparametre.

  • Kabeltræk og montering af stik.

  • Dokumentation og brug af IT-systemer i hverdagen.

  • På sigt opstart og indkøring af robotanlæg.

  • Bidrage med forbedringsforslag og være med til at indføre standarder inden for dit fagområde.

Jobbet omfatter kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere samt rejseaktivitet i begrænset omfang. Rejser med overnatning vil typisk være i forbindelse med opsætning, idriftsættelse eller service af robotløsninger hos kunder samt messeaktiviteter.

Din profil

Du trives i en mindre organisation, hvor der arbejdes i tværfaglige teams. Du er en teamplayer, men kan også arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar. Du arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst og tager ansvar for at følge dine opgaver til dørs. Du har øje for detaljerne og bevarer samtidig overblikket over den samlede montageopgave. Du lytter, får afklaret tekniske spørgsmål og bidrager til, at anlægget effektivt bliver klar til indkøring og aflevering hos kunden. 

Din faglighed: 

Du har erfaring med mekanisk montage af industrianlæg. Du er eksempelvis uddannet mekaniker, klejnsmed, automatikmontør, automationstekniker eller industrielektriker eller har en tilsvarende relevant faglig baggrund.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har teknisk forståelse og kan læse og anvende mekaniske tegninger.

  • Har forståelse for sikkerhedssystemer.

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk og engelsk.

  • Erfaring med robotløsninger er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

Vi tilbyder

Hos Danrobotics får du et afvekslende job med ansvar for dine egne montageopgaver og indflydelse på, hvordan de bliver løst. Du arbejder med forskellige robot- og automationsanlæg og får mulighed for at følge dit arbejde fra de enkelte komponenter til en samlet løsning.

Du får tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring med kolleger på tværs af virksomheden. Samtidig kan du bidrage med din praktiske erfaring til at forbedre vores løsninger og arbejdsmetoder.

Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse.

Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer.

Praktisk information

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Bodil Koertsen: bk@danrobotics.dk.

Du er velkommen til at ringe og høre nærmere om stillingen ved Bodil Koertsen, telefon +45 61 24 33 89.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Kort om Danrobotics

Danrobotics har hovedkontor i Middelfart, tæt på motorvejen, og et datterselskab i Neumünster, Tyskland. Vi leverer robotløsninger til industrien – fra simple automatiseringsopgaver til store, komplekse løsninger, der omfatter hele produktionslinjer. Derudover tilbyder vi service og vedligeholdelse af alle typer robotanlæg.

Vi er 38 engagerede medarbejdere, der brænder for at udvikler, installerer og servicerer værdiskabende løsninger inden for robotteknologi og automatisering til industrivirksomheder i både Danmark og udlandet. Vi samarbejder med nogle af branchens førende leverandører for at sikre vores kunder de bedste løsninger. Læs mere om Danrobotics her.

jobs.title: Konstruktør
jobs.description:
Tag ansvar for den mekaniske konstruktion fra løsningsforslag til færdigt tegningsgrundlag. Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger vi en erfaren konstruktør, der kan omsætte kundernes behov til gennemtænkte konstruktioner. Du arbejder med layout, gribeværktøjer og mekaniske løsninger, hvor dine tekniske valg får betydning for, hvordan det færdige anlæg fungerer hos kunden. 

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for udvikling af maskiner eller automatiseringsløsninger.

  • Trives med at indgå i et dynamisk og tværfagligt team, der har fokus på nye teknologier og tilfredse kunder – gennem tæt samarbejde, vidensdeling, kreativitet og innovation.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projektopgaver med skræddersyede automatiseringsløsninger efter kundens behov.

Stillingen

Som konstruktør får du ansvar for den mekaniske konstruktion i dine projekter. Du udvikler løsningen og udarbejder det tegnings- og dokumentationsgrundlag, der skal bruges til at fremstille, samle og vedligeholde den.

Du bliver en del af et projektteam og arbejder tæt sammen med fagspecialister og teknikere på tværs af virksomheden. Løsningerne udvikles i dialog med kunder, leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Du bidrager også med din konstruktionsfaglige viden i tilbudsfasen, hvor du drøfter løsningsmuligheder med salg.

Eksempler på dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Udvikle og konstruere maskiner og mekaniske dele til robot- og automationsløsninger.

  • Udarbejde layout og konstruere gribeværktøjer.

  • Udarbejde detailtegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

  • Reservedelslister og vedligeholdelsesplaner.

  • Prisbevidst indkøb af komponenter og opfølgning på leverancer.

  • Bidrage til teknisk afklaring og drøfte løsningsmuligheder med salg i tilbudsfasen.

En opgave kan eksempelvis være at udvikle et gribeværktøj til en kundes robotcelle og udarbejde det tegningsgrundlag, der skal bruges til fremstillingen.

Din profil

Du arbejder grundigt og tager ansvar for at følge dine konstruktionsopgaver til dørs. Du holder overblik, får afklaret tekniske spørgsmål og følger op på dine aftaler.
