I candidati che desiderano fare appello al diritto di precedenza previsto dalla legge specifica devono presentare la copia fotostatica del documento comprovante le modalità di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro (es.: il rapporto di lavoro non deve essere cessato per colpa del lavoratore né per risoluzione consensuale) nei casi in cui la precedenza dipenda dal tipo di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro.

Oltre alla documentazione prevista dal presente Bando, i candidati che fanno appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione in osservanza all'art. 101 della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri delle rispettive famiglie, altresì all’art. 47 della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patria sono tenuti a corredare la domanda di assunzione con la documentazione probatoria disciplinata dal Ministero dei difensori croati e indicata sul sito all'indirizzo:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

ovvero

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Oltre alla documentazione probatoria attestante il possesso dei requisiti richiesti, i candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi dell'articolo 48f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra devono allegare l’apposito provvedimento o certificato comprovante il riconoscimento della condizione a cui fa appello.

Oltre alla documentazione prevista dal presente Bando, i candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione in osservanza all'art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e assunzione in servizio delle persone con disabilità sono tenuti a corredare la domanda di assunzione con la documentazione probatoria atta a comprovare la condizione di persona diversamente abile.

I candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione contemplato dall'art. 22 della Legge costituzionale sui diritti delle minoranze nazionali non sono tenuti a comprovare la propria appartenenza alla minoranza nazionale.

Alla domanda di partecipazione al concorso devono essere allegati:

  • curriculum vitae,
  • copia fotostatica del documento attestante il possesso della cittadinanza croata o altro documento analogo (carta d’identità, passaporto, certificato di cittadinanza o libretto militare);
  • copia fotostatica del diploma attestante il possesso del titolo di studio richiesto, a seconda del criterio relativo alla qualifica professionale del posto di lavoro per il quale viene presentata la domanda (i candidati che hanno compiuto gli studi all’estero devono presentare il certificato di equipollenza nella Repubblica di Croazia);
  • registrazione elettronica (qualora l'assicurato abbia presentato richiesta in forma elettronica tramite le pagine utente dell'Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica), ovvero certificato riportante i dati del registro tenuto presso l’Istituto croato di assicurazione pensionistica e ottenibile direttamente presso gli sportelli di quest’ultimo, ovvero presso i rispettivi servizi circondariali (non antecedente a 30 giorni dalla data di pubblicazione del Bando nella Gazzetta Ufficiale);
  • copia fotostatica della documentazione comprovante l’esperienza lavorativa in mansioni corrispondenti per l'intero periodo indicato come requisito (provvedimento attestante l’assegnazione del posto di lavoro, contratto di lavoro o attestato rilasciato dal datore di lavoro riportante i seguenti dati: tipo di lavoro svolto dal candidato, profilo e livello del titolo di studio, periodo di servizio);
  • copia fotostatica del certificato attestante il superamento del livello prescritto dell’esame di Stato (qualora in possesso);
  • copia fotostatica del certificato di abilitazione professionale del ministro delle finanze per lo svolgimento delle attività di revisione interna nel settore pubblico (per il posto di revisore interno);
  • documento comprovante l’abilità nell’utilizzo del computer (certificato probatorio comprovante l’abilità nell’utilizzo del computer valevole nelle nazioni dell’UE, certificato probatorio comprovante l’abilitazione di Operatore informatico in applicazioni operative, corrispettiva pagella di scuola media superiore, indicazione dei voti a livello universitario o specialistico (università o scuola superiore) comprovante il superamento dell’esame di informatica o rispettivo attestato (certificato) rilasciato da enti autorizzati e comprovante il superamento del corso di informatica il cui piano di studi comprende le basi di informatica e lo studio del sistema operativo Windows, nella fattispecie Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook (posta elettronica) e applicazioni Internet,
  • dichiarazione sostitutiva sottoscritta di proprio pugno attestante la non sussistenza degli impedimenti previsti dagli artt. 15 e 16 della LIPT (autenticazione notarile non necessaria).

I candidati che allegano documenti in cui i dati personali non combaciano con quelli riportati nella domanda sono tenuti a fornire anche la prova della loro modifica (certificato di matrimonio, certificato di nascita, ecc).

Nella domanda di assunzione è necessario indicare le generalità del candidato (nome, cognome, residenza, n. telefono/cellulare, preferibile indirizzo di posta elettronica) e indicazione in merito al posto di lavoro per il quale concorre. La domanda di assunzione deve essere firmata di proprio pugno.

Le domande di assunzione possono essere integrate entro la scadenza indicata nel Bando.

Ai fini della valutazione del possesso dei requisiti previsti dal bando, farà fede la situazione in essere alla data di scadenza del termine per la presentazione delle domande.

Prima dell’adozione del provvedimento di assunzione in servizio, il candidato selezionato sarà invitato a presentare, entro un termine congruo, il certificato rilasciato dal tribunale competente attestante l’assenza di procedimenti penali in corso a proprio carico; il certificato medico di idoneità allo svolgimento delle mansioni inerenti alla posizione per la quale è stata disposta l’ammissione; gli originali, ai fini della consultazione, dei documenti comprovanti il possesso dei requisiti previsti per la partecipazione al concorso pubblico, già allegati alla domanda.

La mancata presentazione della documentazione sopra indicata sarà considerata quale rinuncia all’assunzione in servizio.

Le spese relative al rilascio del certificato di idoneità medica saranno a carico della Città, salvo in caso di rinuncia all’ammissione da parte del candidato.

Successivamente alla selezione e prima dell’emissione del provvedimento di assunzione in servizio, la Città provvederà d’ufficio alla verifica dell’eventuale sussistenza di cause ostative all’assunzione derivanti da condanne penali passate in giudicato ai sensi dell’articolo 15 della LIPT, nonché degli impedimenti previsti dall’articolo 16 della medesima legge.

È regolare la domanda che contiene tutti i dati e gli allegati indicati nel Bando, nella forma ivi prevista.

Le persone che non hanno presentato domanda nei termini o in forma regolare, ovvero che non soddisfano i requisiti formali previsti dal bando, non sono considerate candidate al concorso e la loro domanda non sarà esaminata; le stesse verranno informate per iscritto in merito. Avverso tale comunicazione non è ammesso alcun rimedio giuridico. I candidati che hanno presentato domanda incompleta non saranno invitati a integrarla.

I candidati che risulteranno in possesso dei requisiti concorsuali saranno convocati a sostenere una prova scritta, seguita da un colloquio di lavoro. Se il candidato non si presenta alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità, si considera che abbia ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso.

Le domande di assunzione vanno inviate in busta chiusa alla Città di Umag – Umago, Commissione per l’attuazione del concorso, Piazza Libertà 7, 52470 Umago, entro il termine perentorio di 15 giorni a contare dalla data di pubblicazione del presente Bando nella Gazzetta Ufficiale. Le domande devono essere sigillate in busta chiusa recante la dicitura “BANDO PER ASSUNZIONE (specificare posto di lavoro) - NON APRIRE”. È possibile altresì presentare le domande di assunzione direttamente di persona all'Ufficio protocollo-archivio, all'indirizzo Piazza Libertà 7 (Umago).

Il provvedimento di assunzione in servizio del candidato selezionato sarà pubblicato mediante avviso sul sito web ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago (www.umag.hr), entro e non oltre 60 giorni dalla data di scadenza per la presentazione delle domande di partecipazione al concorso pubblico. La pubblicazione si considera notificata decorsi otto giorni dalla data dell’avviso pubblico del suddetto provvedimento.

La descrizione delle mansioni inerenti alla posizione lavorativa oggetto del Bando, le informazioni relative alla retribuzione mensile, le modalità di svolgimento della verifica preliminare delle competenze e delle capacità, le competenze richieste per il superamento della stessa, nonché le fonti giuridiche e altre fonti utili alla preparazione, sono disponibili sul sito ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, www.umag.hr (sezione “Offerte di lavoro”).

La data e l'orario dell'esame verranno pubblicati all'albo pretorio della Città di Umag – Umago e sul sito ufficiale all’indirizzo www.umag.hr (sezione “Offerte di lavoro”), almeno cinque giorni prima della convocazione per la verifica.

CLASSE: 112-01/26-02/05 IL SINDACO

N. PROT.: 2163-9-03/17-26-1 f.to, Vili Bassanese

Umago, 9 novembre 2026

f.to, Valdi Buršić, dipl. ing. stroj.

I. COMPITI E MANSIONI

La descrizione dei lavori è riportata nel Regolamento sull'ordinamento interno dell'amministrazione cittadina (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 15/26), sistematizzazione dei posti di lavoro, disponibile sul sito della Città di Umag – Umago www.umag.hr,

link: https://umag.hr/informacije/sluzbene-novine-grada-umaga-umago-90

II. RETRIBUZIONE MENSILE

Visto il Regolamento di lavoro (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 3/23, 9/23, 22/23, 20/24 e 14/25), vista la Delibera sui coefficienti per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 2/25, 11/25 e 11/26), vista la Decisione sulla definizione della base lorda per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico dell’amministrazione civica della Città di Umag – Umago (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 13/25), lo stipendio base è pari al prodotto tra il coefficiente di complessità dei lavori e la base retributiva (800 euro lordi), con maggiorazione dello 0,5% per ogni anno di anzianità maturato. I coefficienti retributivi per i posti di lavoro di cui al presente Bando sono come segue: revisore interno (3,50); referente superiore per la pianificazione territoriale (2,45).

III. VERIFICA DELLE CONOSCENZE E DELLE CAPACITÀ DEI CANDIDATI

In conformità con l'articolo 22 della LIPT, i candidati che intendono partecipare al presente Bando e che soddisfano i requisiti formali stabiliti dallo stesso saranno sottoposti a una verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità dei candidati, la quale consisterà nella prova scritta e nel colloquio di lavoro. Il candidato che non si presenti alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità sarà considerato aver ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso pubblico.

Regole per lo svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità

I candidati devono presentarsi alla verifica muniti di un documento di identità valido.

Accertata la loro identità, si procederà alla distribuzione delle domande.

Per ciascuna parte della verifica delle conoscenze ai candidati vengono assegnati da 1 a 10 punti. Il colloquio si svolge esclusivamente con i candidati che abbiano ottenuto almeno il 50% dei punti nella prova scritta. Si considera che il candidato abbia superato il colloquio qualora ottenga un punteggio minimo di 5 punti.

Durante la verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità non è concesso:

- consultare testi od annotazioni;

- usare il telefono cellulare/smartphone o altri mezzi di telecomunicazione;

- abbandonare il luogo d'esame;

- comunicare con gli altri candidati o disturbarli in altro modo.

I candidati che trasgrediscono a quanto stabilito saranno allontanati dalla verifica in corso; pertanto, la Commissione non procederà alla correzione ed alla valutazione delle rispettive prove scritte.

Luogo e orario di svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità

Il luogo e l’orario di svolgimento della verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità, nonché l’elenco dei candidati che soddisfano i requisiti formali del Bando, saranno pubblicati sul sito web della Città di Umag – Umago o all’indirizzo www.umag.hr (pagina “Offerte di lavoro”) ed affissi all'albo pretorio in Piazza Libertà 7, piano terra, almeno 5 giorni prima della data della verifica.

Oltre al giorno e all'ora della prova, nella lista dei candidati saranno riportate rispettivamente le iniziali del candidato, l'anno di nascita e il luogo di residenza. Ulteriori estremi potranno essere inclusi qualora due o più candidati riportino dati identici.

IV. FONTI GIURIDICHE E ALTRI TESTI D'ESAME

Aree d’esame:

Revisore interno

jobs.title: OPERATER
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar a u skladu sa Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Ivan Bašić, dipl. ing. el. objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto: Operater

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Zahtijevana kvalifikacija: KV/SSS — završena trogodišnja strukovna škola ili srednja škola; Razine: 3., 4.1., 4.2. - Opće tehničko ili kemijsko usmjerenje prednost

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: Radno iskustvo u komunalnoj ili kemijskoj industriji je prednost

Vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Ostala znanja i vještine:

- znanja sukladno pozitivnoj zakonskoj regulativi i aktima Društva; fizička sposobnost za rad u pogonu

Plaća: Visina plaće utvrdit će se unutar pripadajućeg platnog razreda, ovisno o stručnim kvalifikacijama, radnom iskustvu, kompetencijama i drugim objektivnim kriterijima, sukladno važećim internim aktima Društva; Kandidati će prije pristupanja razgovoru biti obaviješteni o pripadajućem platnom razredu i predviđenom rasponu bruto plaće za navedeno radno mjesto.

Opis posla:

  • Svakodnevno održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša UPOV-a;
  • Rukovanje repromaterijalom i kemikalijama koje se koriste u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda;
  • Nadopuna kemikalija u spremnike prema radnim postupcima i uputama;
  • Dehidriranje otpadnog mulja u pogonu dehidracije;
  • Rutinski pogonski poslovi: pranje i čišćenje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača, mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana;
  • Skidanje korozije s opreme i zaštita odgovarajućim zaštitnim sredstvima;
  • Pomaganje kod redovitih remonta i popravaka opreme i crpki ;
  • Rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručnim ili daljinskim upravljanjem;
  • Kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i zamjena vreća za otpad po potrebi;
  • Pomoć oko čišćenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja;
  • Čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika;
  • Mjerenje koncentracije plinova prema radnim uputama;
  • Održavanje alata i opreme te hortikulture u krugu UPOV-a;
  • Sudjeluje, prema rasporedu, u radu dežurne službe i pripravnosti za obavljanje hitnih intervencija;

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme;
  3. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu;
  4. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije;

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o

profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo

prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o

civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata provest će se putem intervjua, tijekom kojeg će se procjenjivati poznavanje poslova i radnih zadataka iz opisa radnog mjesta.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Operater „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/

Rok za predaju prijava je 22.11.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično u svakoj fazi postupka, bez obveze navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: TEHNIČAR NA UPOV-U
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar a u skladu sa Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Ivan Bašić, dipl. ing. el. objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto: Tehničar na UPOV-u

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Zahtijevana kvalifikacija: KV/SSS/VKV — završena srednja škola strojarskog smjera; Razine: 3., 4.1., 4.2., 5. - Strojarski tehničar ili drugi srodan tehnički smjer

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 6 mjeseci radnog iskustva

Vozačka dozvola B kategorije, poželjno C kategorija

Ostala znanja i vještine:

- znanja sukladno pozitivnoj zakonskoj regulativi i aktima Društva; fizička sposobnost za rad s mehaničkom opremom

Plaća: Visina plaće utvrdit će se unutar pripadajućeg platnog razreda, ovisno o stručnim kvalifikacijama, radnom iskustvu, kompetencijama i drugim objektivnim kriterijima, sukladno važećim internim aktima Društva; Kandidati će prije pristupanja razgovoru biti obaviješteni o pripadajućem platnom razredu i predviđenom rasponu bruto plaće za navedeno radno mjesto.

Opis posla:

  • Kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda;
  • Rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručnim ili daljinskim upravljanjem; pokretanje i zaustavljanje crpki;
  • Rutinsko održavanje opreme: remont, servis, zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zasuna i opreme za pročišćavanje;
  • Praćenje intervala redovitih servisa strojarske opreme i pravovremena nabava rezervnih dijelova;
  • Kontrola nastanka korozije i zaštita crpki i opreme adekvatnim premazima
  • Rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama i nadopuna kemikalija u spremnike prema radnim postupcima;
  • Suradnja s Operaterom i Poslovođom UPOV-a u svakodnevnom radu
  • Sudjeluje, prema rasporedu, u radu dežurne službe i pripravnosti za obavljanje hitnih intervencija;

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme;
  3. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu;
  4. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o

profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo

prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o

civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata provest će se putem intervjua, tijekom kojeg će se procjenjivati poznavanje poslova i radnih zadataka iz opisa radnog mjesta.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Tehničar na UPOV-u „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/

Rok za predaju prijava je 22.11.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično u svakoj fazi postupka, bez obveze navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: Junior Marketing Consultant
jobs.description:
Junior Marketing Consultant 

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der trives i spændingsfeltet mellem datadrevet marketing og forretningsforståelse.

Studiz er bl.a. landets største platform for studierabat til verificerede studerende med mere end 400.000 medlemmer. Vores platform giver virksomheder mulighed for at opbygge en tidlig relation til fremtidens mest købestærke kundesegment. Se mere på www.studiz.dk.

Vi søger en eksekverende profil, der skal assistere vores CMO i hendes daglige arbejde. Vi er altså på jagt efter dig, der trives med at arbejde med hele processen – fra idé til implementering.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultaterne på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser.

  • Test og optimering: Opstille hypoteser, teste nye initiativer og evaluere effekten. Bruge resultaterne til løbende at forbedre vores aktiviteter og skabe bedre resultater for både partnere og brugere.

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Men vigtigst af alt handler det om, at du tør. Tør teste, stille spørgsmål og undersøge nye muligheder.

For os handler det mere om den rette profil og tilgang end om erfaring, da dit daglige arbejde vil foregå i tæt samarbejde med vores CMO.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger, er idérig og udadvendt og har en "Jeg skal vise dem"-attitude.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

  • Har forståelse for arbejdet med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Er nysgerrig på sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Trives med ansvar og frihed.

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på Studiz, menneskene bag (de studerende) og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.description:
Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff!

Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around!

We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home.

Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently.

Why Choose ShyftOff?

No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control.

  • 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home.
  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work.
  • You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability.
  • Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility.

Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

The Role

As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability.

One of our newest programs include:

Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around.

What you'll do:

  • Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions
  • Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely
  • Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call
  • Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure
  • Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems

Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground.

Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus

Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support.

What you'll do:

  • Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions
  • Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them
  • Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications
  • Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution

What Makes You a Fit (all programs)

  • Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm
  • Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously
  • Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once
  • Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
  • Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred

What You'll Need (all programs)

  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum)
  • A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Global Mobility Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models.



That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale.



This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own mobility, end to end
   
   - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks
   
   - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management
   
   - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources
   
   Power global expansion
   
   - Support our expansion into new markets by:
     
     - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations
     
     - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models
     
     - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets
   
   Build the partnerships and the program
   
   - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly
   
   - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy
   
   - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve
   
   Make it visible and make it automatic
   
   - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture
   
   - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions

 - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent

 - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments

 - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk

 - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely

 - You're comfortable with the compliance side of expansion: local employment law, entity setup, and employment models

 - You have excellent judgment and discretion, and your writing is concise enough to help partners move fast

 - You take ownership and run with it. You have real agency: you spot what needs to happen, act with urgency, and drive it to done without waiting to be asked

 - You know how to influence leaders. You bring data, a clear point of view, and a recommendation to senior stakeholders and help them make fast, confident decisions on mobility and expansion

 - You're direct and kind. You have strong opinions, loosely held, and you like to collaborate

 - Bonus: you've supported a company through its first international expansions or entities



Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If you're a builder at heart, share our values, and get excited about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 - $200,000.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
jobs.description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

 - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

 - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms.

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

 - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

 - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function.

 - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

 - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

 - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

 - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

 - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond.

 - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs.

 - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute
